alcohol-masculinity-mens-hidden-crisis.en:
The drunk man is one of India's most dependable jokes: the uncle swaying at a wedding, the neighbour the whole lane calls a bewda. He is also a patient, and almost nobody is treating him. India's National Mental Health Survey of 2015-16 found alcohol use disorder in 9% of men against 0.5% of women [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. For alcohol use disorders the treatment gap, the share of people who need care and are not getting it, was 86% [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. An illness this common and this untreated is neither a joke nor an excuse.

## The 9% versus 0.5% gap

The survey found a mental disorder in 13.9% of men against 7.5% of women. Depression and anxiety disorders were more common in women; alcohol is where the men's number pulls far ahead [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Men aged 30 to 49, the years in which a man is expected to carry a household, were the most affected. The survey is a decade old, so read these figures as a baseline rather than today's count.

Alcohol use disorder does not mean everyone who drinks. It means a pattern: needing more to get the same effect, failing to cut down, drinking in spite of damage to health, work or family, and feeling shaky, sleepless or anxious without it. Alcohol is a psychoactive substance that produces dependence [[who-alcohol]]. Once dependence sets in, "just stop" is advice the body cannot simply follow.

## Drinking instead of talking

Part of the gap is permission: drinking is tolerated in men in a way it rarely is in women. The rest is what boys are taught to do with distress.

A 2014 ICRW-UNFPA study in seven states classified 32% of the men it surveyed as holding "rigid" ideas of masculinity, 45% as moderate and only 23% as gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. A boy raised on "mard ko dard nahi hota" still feels fear, grief and failure. He has only been denied the words for them. Alcohol is the one remedy his world approves of: "ek peg le le, neend aa jayegi."

Imagine a 38-year-old site supervisor in Nagpur who has not been paid for three months and cannot tell his wife how frightened he is. He starts with two drinks to sleep. A year later he needs four, and his hands shake in the morning. His friends call it a mood, his mother a bad habit, his wife his nature. Nobody calls it an illness, so nobody thinks of a doctor.

## Who pays: partners, children and the 71% finding

In NFHS-5, 71% of women whose husbands often get drunk reported physical or sexual violence by their husband. Among women whose husbands do not drink, the figure was 23% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Read both numbers. The first says a home with a frequently drunk husband is far more dangerous for a woman. The second says nearly a quarter of women whose husbands do not drink reported violence too. This is a link, not proof that alcohol causes violence. Alcohol lowers restraint; it does not pick the target. A man who hits his wife when drunk, and never his employer, has already decided whom he is allowed to hurt. "He was drunk" is a description, not a defence.

> Treating his drinking is not the same as making her safe. Both have to happen, and her safety cannot wait for his recovery.

Alcohol harms people other than the person drinking [[who-alcohol]]: the wife who hides money for school fees, the child who learns to read the sound of the gate at night. Children carry violence at home forward. NFHS-5 found that women whose fathers beat their mothers were more than twice as likely to face spousal violence themselves, 58% against 25% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Why 86% go untreated

In the same survey, treatment gaps for mental disorders ranged from 28% to 83%. Alcohol use disorders, at 86%, were worse than any of them [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]].

Three things keep men out of treatment. The first is the label: a man with a heart problem is a patient, a man with a drinking problem is a sharabi. Families swing between scolding him and covering for him, and neither is care.

The second is masculinity. Asking for help means saying "I cannot control this", the one sentence a man raised on control is trained never to say. The third is that many families do not know treatment exists, so they try oaths, shame and advertised "nasha mukti" cures.

Calling heavy drinking a moral failure does not reduce it. It keeps the 86% where they are.

## Getting help: what treatment looks like and where to start

Alcohol use disorder can be treated [[who-alcohol]]. In practice, treatment has stages.

- **An honest assessment.** A doctor asks how much you drink, how often, and what happens when you stop. Give the real amounts; they have heard bigger ones.
- **Coming off alcohol safely.** If you drink heavily every day, do not stop suddenly on your own. Withdrawal can be medically dangerous, and a doctor can manage it with short-term medicines, sometimes with a few days in hospital.
- **Staying off.** Counselling over months, and for some people prescribed medicines that reduce craving. Never take such medicines, or slip them to someone else, without a doctor.
- **Relapse.** Slipping back is common. It is a reason to return to the doctor, not proof that treatment failed.

Where to start: Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock helpline on 14416, offers counselling to anyone in need [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. The psychiatry OPD of a government hospital or medical college treats alcohol dependence.

If you live with a man who drinks, you cannot cure him, and you are not the reason he drinks. Talk to him when he is sober, stop covering for him, and offer to go with him to the first appointment. If he is violent, call 112 in an emergency or the Women Helpline [[wcd-mission-shakti]].

An illness found in 9% of men is not a punchline. Treatment often starts with someone asking him, when he is sober, whether he wants help.
alcohol-masculinity-mens-hidden-crisis.hg:
Sharabi aadmi India ke sabse purane jokes mein se ek hai: shaadi mein jhoomte hue uncle, woh padosi jise poori gali bewda bulati hai. Lekin woh ek patient bhi hai, aur uska ilaaj lagbhag koi nahi kar raha. India ke National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein alcohol use disorder 9% men mein mila, jabki women mein 0.5% [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Alcohol use disorders ka treatment gap, yaani un logon ka hissa jinhe care chahiye par mil nahi rahi, 86% tha [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Jo bimari itni common ho aur itni untreated, woh na joke hai, na bahana.

## 9% versus 0.5% ka gap

Survey mein 13.9% men mein koi mental disorder mila, women mein 7.5%. Depression aur anxiety disorders women mein zyada the; men ka number jahan bahut aage nikal jaata hai, woh alcohol hai [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Sabse zyada affected 30 se 49 saal ke men the, yaani woh umar jab aadmi se poora ghar chalane ki ummeed ki jaati hai. Survey ek dashak purana hai, isliye in figures ko aaj ki ginti nahi, ek baseline ki tarah padhiye.

Alcohol use disorder ka matlab har peene wala insaan nahi hai. Iska matlab ek pattern hai: wahi asar paane ke liye pehle se zyada peena, kam karne ki koshish mein fail hona, health, kaam ya family ko nuksaan hone ke baad bhi peete rehna, aur na peene par haath kaanpna, neend na aana ya bechaini hona. Alcohol ek psychoactive substance hai jo dependence paida karta hai [[who-alcohol]]. Ek baar dependence ban jaaye, toh "bas chhod do" aisi salaah hai jise body yun hi nahi maan sakti.

## Baat karne ki jagah peena

Is gap ka ek hissa permission hai: men ka peena jis tarah bardaasht kiya jaata hai, women ka shayad hi kabhi kiya jaata hai. Baaki hissa yeh hai ki ladkon ko apni takleef ke saath kya karna sikhaya jaata hai.

2014 ki ICRW-UNFPA study ne saat states mein survey kiye gaye men mein se 32% ko masculinity ke "rigid" ideas wala, 45% ko moderate aur sirf 23% ko gender-equitable classify kiya [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. "Mard ko dard nahi hota" sunkar bada hua ladka bhi darr, dukh aur failure mehsoos karta hai. Use bas in feelings ke liye shabd nahi diye gaye. Uski duniya jis ek ilaaj ko manzoori deti hai, woh alcohol hai: "ek peg le le, neend aa jayegi."

Sochiye, Nagpur ka ek 38 saal ka site supervisor, jise teen mahine se salary nahi mili aur jo apni wife ko bata nahi paata ki woh kitna dara hua hai. Woh neend ke liye do drinks se shuru karta hai. Ek saal baad use chaar chahiye, aur subah uske haath kaanpte hain. Dost ise mood kehte hain, maa buri aadat, wife uska swabhaav. Koi ise bimari nahi kehta, isliye kisi ko doctor ka khayal nahi aata.

## Keemat kaun chukata hai: partners, bachche aur 71% wali finding

NFHS-5 mein, jin women ke husband aksar nashe mein hote hain, unme se 71% ne husband ke haathon physical ya sexual violence report kiya. Jin women ke husband nahi peete, unme yeh figure 23% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Dono numbers padhiye. Pehla kehta hai ki jis ghar mein husband aksar nashe mein hota hai, woh ghar aurat ke liye kahin zyada khatarnak hai. Doosra kehta hai ki jin women ke husband nahi peete, unme se bhi kareeb ek-chauthai ne violence report kiya. Yeh ek link hai, is baat ka proof nahi ki alcohol violence karwata hai. Alcohol rok-tok kam karta hai; nishana woh nahi chunta. Jo aadmi nashe mein apni wife par haath uthata hai, par apne boss par kabhi nahi, usne pehle hi tay kar rakha hai ki use kise chot pahunchane ki ijazat hai. "Woh nashe mein tha" ek description hai, defence nahi.

> Husband ke peene ka ilaaj aur wife ki safety ek hi cheez nahi hain. Dono zaroori hain, aur wife ki safety husband ki recovery ka intezaar nahi kar sakti.

Alcohol peene wale ke alawa doosron ko bhi nuksaan pahunchata hai [[who-alcohol]]: woh wife jo school fees ke paise chhupakar rakhti hai, woh bachcha jo raat ko gate ki awaaz se andaza lagana seekh jaata hai. Bachche ghar ki violence aage le jaate hain. NFHS-5 ne paaya ki jin women ke father unki mother ko maarte the, unke khud spousal violence jhelne ki sambhavna dugne se zyada thi, 58% banaam 25% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## 86% ka ilaaj kyun nahi hota

Usi survey mein mental disorders ke treatment gaps 28% se 83% ke beech the. Alcohol use disorders, 86% par, in sabse bure the [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]].

Teen cheezein men ko treatment se door rakhti hain. Pehli hai label: dil ki bimari wala aadmi patient hai, peene ki problem wala aadmi sharabi. Family kabhi use daantti hai, kabhi uski baat chhupati hai, aur dono mein se koi bhi care nahi hai.

Doosri hai masculinity. Madad maangne ka matlab hai yeh kehna ki "yeh mere control mein nahi hai", aur control par pale-badhe aadmi ko yahi ek sentence kabhi na bolne ki training mili hai. Teesri yeh ki bahut si families ko pata hi nahi ki treatment hota hai, isliye woh kasmein, sharm aur ads wale "nasha mukti" nuskhe aazmati hain.

Zyada peene ko moral failure kehne se woh kam nahi hota. Isse bas woh 86% wahin ke wahin rehte hain.

## Madad lena: treatment kaisa hota hai aur kahan se shuru karein

Alcohol use disorder ka ilaaj ho sakta hai [[who-alcohol]]. Practice mein treatment ke stages hote hain.

- **Imaandaar assessment.** Doctor poochhta hai ki aap kitna peete hain, kitni baar, aur band karne par kya hota hai. Sahi matra bataiye; unhone isse badi sun rakhi hain.
- **Alcohol safely chhodna.** Agar aap roz bahut zyada peete hain, toh akele achanak band mat kijiye. Withdrawal medically khatarnak ho sakta hai, aur doctor ise short-term dawaiyon se sambhaal sakta hai, kabhi-kabhi kuch din hospital mein rakhkar.
- **Alcohol se door rehna.** Mahinon tak counselling, aur kuch logon ke liye doctor ki likhi dawaiyan jo craving kam karti hain. Aisi dawaiyan doctor ke bina na khud lijiye, na kisi ko chupke se dijiye.
- **Relapse.** Dobara shuru ho jaana common hai. Yeh doctor ke paas wapas jaane ki wajah hai, is baat ka proof nahi ki treatment fail ho gaya.

Shuru kahan se karein: Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, round-the-clock helpline 14416, kisi bhi zarooratmand ko counselling deti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Kisi government hospital ya medical college ka psychiatry OPD alcohol dependence ka ilaaj karta hai.

Agar aap kisi peene wale aadmi ke saath rehte hain, toh aap use theek nahi kar sakte, aur uske peene ki wajah aap nahi hain. Jab woh hosh mein ho tab baat kijiye, uski baat chhupana band kijiye, aur pehle appointment par saath chalne ka offer dijiye. Agar woh violent hai, toh emergency mein 112 ya Women Helpline par call kijiye [[wcd-mission-shakti]].

Jo bimari 9% men mein mili, woh punchline nahi hai. Treatment aksar tab shuru hota hai jab koi usse, jab woh hosh mein ho, poochhta hai ki kya use madad chahiye.

asexuality-marriage-pressure-questions.en:
Imagine a 27-year-old in Indore. She has close friends and one past relationship. What she has never had is the pull towards sex that films, friends and wedding jokes assume in everyone. Her mother has shortlisted three "boys". Her aunt says she just hasn't met the right person. The family doctor offers to "check her hormones" before the wedding.

There is a word for how she is: asexual. None of the national surveys and crime tables this magazine draws on counts asexual people, but a marriage-centred culture has plenty to say to them. This Q&A is general information, not legal advice.

## What is asexuality, and what is it not?

Asexuality means feeling little or no sexual attraction. It is a sexual orientation, the "A" in LGBTQIA+, and it is not a disorder.

It is a range. Some asexual people, often called "ace", never feel sexual attraction. Some feel it rarely, or only after a deep emotional bond. Many want romance, a partner, children. Some do not.

It is not celibacy, which is a choice. It is not fear of sex, a low phase, or proof that something bad happened to you. And it describes attraction, not behaviour: an asexual person may or may not have sex, and is asexual either way.

## Is it a medical problem? When does a doctor help, and when is it a 'cure'?

A doctor helps when something has changed. If your desire has dropped sharply, comes with low mood or pain, or is causing you distress, see a doctor to check for a treatable cause [[who-sexual-health]].

A "cure" is something else: a doctor, "sexologist" or baba who treats a lifelong absence of sexual attraction as a fault to be repaired before the wedding. The test is whose distress is being treated. If you are at peace and only your family is upset, there is no patient in the room.

On paper, the law agrees. In June 2021 the Madras High Court directed that any attempt to medically "cure" or change the sexual orientation of LGBTQIA+ people be prohibited, with action including withdrawal of the licence of professionals involved [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. On 25 August 2022 the National Medical Commission told all state medical councils that conducting "conversion therapy" on LGBTQIA+ persons is professional misconduct [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 bars discrimination in mental health care on grounds that include sexual orientation [[indiacode-mhca-2017]].

Two limits. The Madras High Court order and the NMC letter came from a lesbian couple's case and speak of LGBTQIA+ people as a group; we found no ruling that tests them for an asexual person. And the NMC rule binds registered doctors, not babas or unregistered "sex clinics".

## I am asexual and my family wants me married. What are my options?

In Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018), the Supreme Court held that the right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. A right to choose is also a right to refuse.

In practice there are three paths. You can say no, or not yet. Your own income is what makes a "no" last.

You can marry someone who knows. Tell them before the engagement, in plain words: I do not feel sexual attraction, this will not change, here is what I can and cannot offer. Some asexual people marry each other, or find partners who want little or no sex.

Or you can stay silent and hope to "adjust". Families push this path, and it is the dangerous one. If a husband forces sex, Indian law does not call it rape: Exception 2 to Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) says sexual acts by a man with his own wife, if she is 18 or older, are not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The Supreme Court has not ruled on the challenge to that exception; as of 19 November 2026, the bench said it would fix the final hearing for 9 or 10 December 2026 [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

In NFHS-5 (2019-21), 12.2% of men aged 15-49, about one in eight, said a husband has the right to use force to have sex if his wife refuses. 72% rejected all four coercive responses the survey listed, down from 77% in NFHS-4 [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

> "You will adjust after marriage" asks an asexual woman to walk into the one relationship where Indian law does not treat forced sex as rape.

Asexual men face another version: mocked as "not man enough", sent to clinics for "weakness", blamed if a marriage is not consummated. The answer is the same: the truth before the wedding, not after.

## How do consent and compromise work with a partner who wants sex?

Section 63 of the BNS defines consent as an "unequivocal voluntary agreement" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Agreement, not surrender.

Some asexual people choose to have sex sometimes: for closeness, for a partner's happiness, to have a child. If that choice is free, it is consent, and nobody else gets to call it fake. If it is pulled out of you by sulking, guilt, relatives' taunts or "it is your duty", it is pressure. A partner's desire does not create a duty, in dating or in marriage.

Compromise has to run both ways. Couples with different levels of desire work out terms: how often, if at all, what touch is welcome, what each needs to feel loved. Neither the one who wants more nor the one who wants less is abnormal. Sometimes the honest result is that two people should not be together.

If a husband uses force or threats, a wife still has a route. The Domestic Violence Act, 2005 counts sexual abuse as domestic violence, and breaching a protection order is punishable with up to 1 year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 20,000, or both [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. In danger, call 112 [[mha-erss]].

## Where do I find people like me?

Usually online first. Search "asexual" or "ace" along with "India" or your city, and look for groups run by queer collectives. Share no money, photos or real name until you trust the people.

If you want a counsellor, ask in the first session what they think asexuality is. If the answer is a treatment plan, leave. Tele-MANAS, the free, round-the-clock mental health helpline, is on 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

You do not owe anyone a diagnosis, a trial run or a deadline. You are allowed to know yourself before your family does.
asexuality-marriage-pressure-questions.hg:
Sochiye, Indore mein 27 saal ki ek ladki hai. Uske kareebi dost hain aur ek purana relationship bhi raha hai. Jo cheez use kabhi feel nahi hui, woh hai sex ki taraf woh khinchaav jo films, dost aur shaadi wale jokes har kisi mein maan kar chalte hain. Uski mummy ne teen "ladke" shortlist kar liye hain. Bua kehti hain ki use bas abhi sahi insaan nahi mila. Family doctor shaadi se pehle uske "hormones check" karne ka offer dete hain.

Woh jaisi hai, uske liye ek shabd hai: asexual. Yeh magazine jin national surveys aur crime tables par bharosa karti hai, unme se koi bhi asexual logon ko nahi ginta, lekin shaadi ke ird-gird ghoomne wale samaaj ke paas unse kehne ko bahut kuch hai. Yeh Q&A general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Asexuality kya hai, aur kya nahi hai?

Asexuality ka matlab hai sexual attraction bahut kam ya bilkul feel na hona. Yeh ek sexual orientation hai, LGBTQIA+ ka "A", aur yeh koi disorder nahi hai.

Yeh ek range hai. Kuch asexual log, jinhe aksar "ace" kaha jaata hai, sexual attraction kabhi feel nahi karte. Kuch ko yeh bahut kam hoti hai, ya sirf gehre emotional bond ke baad. Bahut se log romance, partner aur bachche chahte hain. Kuch nahi chahte.

Yeh celibacy nahi hai, kyunki celibacy ek choice hai. Yeh sex ka darr nahi hai, koi low phase nahi hai, aur is baat ka saboot bhi nahi ki aapke saath kuch bura hua tha. Aur yeh attraction ke baare mein hai, behaviour ke baare mein nahi: ek asexual insaan sex kare ya na kare, woh dono haalat mein asexual hi hai.

## Kya yeh medical problem hai? Doctor kab madad karta hai, aur kab woh 'cure' ban jaata hai?

Doctor tab madad karta hai jab kuch badla ho. Agar aapki desire achanak bahut kam ho gayi hai, saath mein low mood ya pain hai, ya isse aap pareshan hain, toh doctor ko dikhaiye taaki treatable cause check ho sake [[who-sexual-health]].

"Cure" alag cheez hai: koi doctor, "sexologist" ya baba jo zindagi bhar se sexual attraction na hone ko aisi kharabi maan le jise shaadi se pehle theek karna hai. Test yeh hai ki ilaaj kiski pareshani ka ho raha hai. Agar aap sukoon mein hain aur pareshan sirf aapki family hai, toh us kamre mein koi patient hai hi nahi.

Kaagaz par law bhi yahi kehta hai. June 2021 mein Madras High Court ne direction diya ki LGBTQIA+ logon ki sexual orientation ko medically "cure" karne ya badalne ki har koshish par rok lage, aur isme shaamil professionals par action ho, jisme licence wapas lena bhi shaamil hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. 25 August 2022 ko National Medical Commission ne sabhi state medical councils ko bataya ki LGBTQIA+ persons par "conversion therapy" karna professional misconduct hai [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ka Section 21 mental health care mein discrimination ko rokta hai, aur uske grounds mein sexual orientation bhi shaamil hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]].

Do limits bhi hain. Madras High Court ka order aur NMC ka letter ek lesbian couple ke case se aaye aur LGBTQIA+ logon ki baat ek group ki tarah karte hain; humein aisi koi ruling nahi mili jo inhe kisi asexual insaan ke case mein test karti ho. Aur NMC ka rule registered doctors par lagu hota hai, babas ya unregistered "sex clinics" par nahi.

## Main asexual hoon aur family meri shaadi karwana chahti hai. Mere paas kya options hain?

Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Chunne ka haq mana karne ka haq bhi hai.

Practically teen raaste hain. Aap "na" keh sakte hain, ya "abhi nahi". Aapki apni kamai hi aapki "na" ko tikaye rakhti hai.

Aap aise insaan se shaadi kar sakte hain jise sab pata ho. Engagement se pehle saaf shabdon mein bataiye: mujhe sexual attraction feel nahi hoti, yeh badlega nahi, aur is rishte mein mujhse kya mil sakta hai aur kya nahi. Kuch asexual log aapas mein shaadi karte hain, ya aise partners dhoondh lete hain jinhe sex bahut kam ya bilkul nahi chahiye.

Ya aap chup reh kar "adjust" ho jaane ki umeed kar sakte hain. Families isi raaste par dhakelti hain, aur yahi sabse khatarnaak hai. Agar pati sex ke liye zabardasti kare, toh Indian law use rape nahi kehta: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki aadmi ke apni patni ke saath sexual acts, agar patni 18 ya usse zyada umar ki hai, rape nahi hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Is exception ko di gayi challenge par Supreme Court ne abhi tak faisla nahi diya hai; 19 November 2026 tak ki sthiti yeh thi ki bench ne final hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko fix karne ki baat kahi thi [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-49 saal ke 12.2% aadmiyon ne, yaani lagbhag har aath mein se ek ne, kaha ki agar patni mana kare toh pati ko sex ke liye force use karne ka haq hai. 72% ne survey mein diye gaye chaaron coercive responses ko reject kiya, jabki NFHS-4 mein yeh 77% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

> "Shaadi ke baad adjust ho jaogi" ek asexual aurat se kehta hai ki woh us ek rishte mein chali jaye jahan Indian law zabardasti ke sex ko rape nahi maanta.

Asexual aadmiyon ke saath iska doosra roop chalta hai: "mard nahi ho" ke taane, "kamzori" ke naam par clinics ke chakkar, aur shaadi consummate na ho toh saara ilzaam unhi par. Jawab wahi hai: sach shaadi se pehle bataiye, baad mein nahi.

## Jis partner ko sex chahiye, uske saath consent aur compromise kaise chalte hain?

BNS ka Section 63 consent ko "unequivocal voluntary agreement" kehta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yaani raazi hona, haar maan lena nahi.

Kuch asexual log kabhi-kabhi sex karna khud chunte hain: closeness ke liye, partner ki khushi ke liye, ya bachche ke liye. Agar yeh choice free hai, toh yeh consent hai, aur kisi aur ko ise fake kehne ka haq nahi. Agar yeh roothne, guilt, rishtedaaron ke taanon ya "yeh tumhara farz hai" se nikalwayi gayi hai, toh yeh pressure hai. Partner ki desire se aap par koi duty nahi ban jaati, na dating mein, na shaadi mein.

Compromise dono taraf se hona chahiye. Jin couples mein desire ka level alag hota hai, woh apni terms khud tay karte hain: kitni baar, ya bilkul nahi, kaunsa touch theek hai, aur har ek ko pyaar mehsoos karne ke liye kya chahiye. Na zyada chahne wala abnormal hai, na kam chahne wala. Kabhi-kabhi imaandaar nateeja yeh hota hai ki do logon ko saath nahi rehna chahiye.

Agar pati force ya dhamki use kare, toh patni ke paas phir bhi ek raasta hai. Domestic Violence Act, 2005 sexual abuse ko domestic violence maanta hai, aur protection order todne par 1 saal tak ki jail, Rs 20,000 tak ka fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Khatre mein 112 call kijiye [[mha-erss]].

## Mujhe apne jaise log kahan milenge?

Aksar sabse pehle online. "Asexual" ya "ace" ke saath "India" ya apne shehar ka naam search kijiye, aur queer collectives ke chalaye hue groups dhoondhiye. Jab tak logon par bharosa na ho jaye, paise, photos ya apna asli naam share mat kijiye.

Agar aap counsellor chahte hain, toh pehle hi session mein poochiye ki unke hisaab se asexuality kya hai. Agar jawab mein treatment plan mile, toh wahan se chale aaiye. Tele-MANAS, free aur chaubees ghante chalne wali mental health helpline, 14416 par hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Aap par kisi ko diagnosis, trial run ya deadline dene ka koi karz nahi hai. Aapko apne aap ko apni family se pehle jaan lene ka poora haq hai.

breakup-safety-plan-stalking-threats.en:
Imagine a 20-year-old student in Indore ending a relationship of eight months. Her boyfriend knows her Instagram password, sees her live location and has photos she once sent him. This guide is for the breakups that do not end with a blocked number: the ex who keeps calling, waits at the hostel gate, or says he will "show everyone". The plan is to make the ending short, safe and on record.

## Before you end it: timing, place and a trusted person

You need a safety plan if your partner already checks your phone, turns up uninvited, has threatened you or themselves, or if you are simply afraid of how they will react. Trust that fear. It is information.

Tell one person before you tell your partner: a friend, a sibling, a flatmate, a parent. Tell them when, where, and when you will message them afterwards. In NFHS-5, 77% of women aged 18-49 who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. A controlling partner relies on that silence.

Choose the setting for safety, not politeness. A call or a message is a legitimate way to end things with someone who frightens you. If you meet, pick a public place in daylight and keep it short. Say it once: "This relationship is over. Please do not contact me." Refuse a "last meeting" alone in their room or yours. You do not owe closure to someone you are afraid of.

## Untangling: shared accounts, keys, money and locations

Do this the same day.

- **Passwords and shared accounts:** change email first, then Instagram, WhatsApp and UPI. Log out every other device, and leave shared food-delivery and cab accounts that show your address.
- **Location:** stop live location sharing on WhatsApp and Google Maps, and leave any family-sharing group.
- **Money and belongings:** settle dues by UPI, and collect your things through a friend or in a public place.
- **The door:** if they had a key, tell your landlord or PG owner. Ask flatmates, the warden or the guard not to let them in.

## If they follow, message or turn up: what Section 78 covers

A breakup is the clear "no" the law looks for. Under Section 78 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), a man who follows a woman, keeps contacting her despite a clear indication that she is not interested, or monitors her use of the internet commits stalking. The punishment is up to three years in prison on a first conviction and up to five on a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Police registered 9,865 stalking cases in 2024, or 1.4 per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is a fraction of the following and pestering that never reaches a police station.

So build the record from day one. After your one clear message, do not reply again: even an angry reply is the contact he wants. Keep a dated log of calls, messages, new accounts and every time he appears at your college, office or lane, and save screenshots where he cannot reach them.

If he turns up at your door or follows you, do not step out to "talk". Call 112 [[mha-erss]]. To report, go to any police station, wherever it happened (a Zero FIR), and take your free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A woman's stalking complaint must be recorded by a woman officer [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Expect a long road: courts convicted in 25.2% of the stalking trials they completed in 2024, and 52,273 cases were still pending at year end [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The FIR's first job is protection: a record, and an officer he must answer to.

One gap. By its wording, stalking under the BNS can only be committed by a man against a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. If you are a man, or your ex is a woman, or the relationship is queer, threats can still be reported as criminal intimidation, and 112 and the cybercrime helpline work for everyone. If you are under 18, tell a trusted adult and call Child Helpline 1098 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

## If they threaten to leak images: the two-hour takedown and 1930

The most common threat after a breakup needs no one at your door: "I still have your photos." Know three things.

First, the law is on your side even if you sent the photo yourself. Under Section 77 of the BNS, sharing a woman's private image without her consent is voyeurism even if she agreed to it being taken, with one to three years in prison on a first conviction [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Section 66E of the IT Act punishes sharing an image of any person's private area without consent, whatever their gender, with up to three years [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Second, the clock runs against the platform. Since 20 February 2026, platforms must remove nude, sexual or morphed images of a person within two hours of that person's complaint, down from 24 hours [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Third, do not negotiate, pay or send anything more. Screenshot the threat with the username and date. Call the cybercrime helpline 1930 or file at cybercrime.gov.in [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], and report the account to the platform.

## When an ex threatens to hurt themselves

"If you go, I will do something to myself." Take it seriously, and do not carry it alone. The person may be in real distress, or may be using your fear to keep you. You do not have to work out which: the response is the same.

Say: "I am worried about you, and I am getting you help." Then tell someone who can be with them in person: a parent, a sibling, a flatmate. Give them the number of Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline, 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. If you think they are in immediate danger, call 112.

Do not go to them alone, and do not take the breakup back. Staying out of fear treats no one's distress; it teaches both of you that the threat works. You can care whether someone is safe and still leave. If the weeks after leave you anxious or sleepless, 14416 is for you too.

A safe ending is not a cruel one. It is short, someone else knows about it, and it is written down.
breakup-safety-plan-stalking-threats.hg:
Imagine karo, Indore mein ek 20 saal ki student hai jo aath mahine ka relationship khatam kar rahi hai. Uske boyfriend ko uska Instagram password pata hai, woh uski live location dekhta hai, aur uske paas woh photos hain jo usne kabhi bheji thi. Yeh guide un breakups ke liye hai jo ek blocked number par khatam nahi hote: woh ex jo call karta rehta hai, hostel gate par intezaar karta hai, ya kehta hai ki "sabko dikha dunga". Plan yeh hai ki ending chhoti ho, safe ho aur record par ho.

## Khatam karne se pehle: timing, jagah aur ek bharosemand insaan

Tumhe safety plan chahiye agar tumhara partner pehle se tumhara phone check karta hai, bina bulaye aa jaata hai, tumhe ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ki dhamki de chuka hai, ya agar tumhe bas is baat ka darr hai ki woh kaise react karega. Us darr par bharosa karo. Woh information hai.

Partner ko batane se pehle kisi ek insaan ko batao: dost, bhai-behen, flatmate ya parent. Unhe batao ki kab, kahan, aur uske baad tumhara message unhe kab tak aa jaayega. NFHS-5 mein, 18-49 saal ki jin women ne physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, unme se 77% ne na kabhi help maangi thi, na kisi ko bataya tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Controlling partner isi khamoshi par tika hota hai.

Jagah safety dekh kar chuno, politeness dekh kar nahi. Jis insaan se tumhe darr lagta hai, usse call ya message par rishta khatam karna bilkul jaayaz hai. Agar milna hi hai, toh din ke waqt koi public place chuno aur baat chhoti rakho. Ek baar bolo: "Yeh relationship khatam hai. Please mujhse contact mat karna." Uske ya apne room mein akele "last meeting" se mana kar do. Jis insaan se tumhe darr lagta hai, use closure dena tumhari zimmedari nahi hai.

## Alag hona: shared accounts, chaabi, paise aur location

Yeh sab usi din karo.

- **Passwords aur shared accounts:** pehle email ka password badlo, phir Instagram, WhatsApp aur UPI ka. Baaki sab devices se log out karo, aur un shared food-delivery aur cab accounts se nikal jao jinme tumhara address dikhta hai.
- **Location:** WhatsApp aur Google Maps par live location sharing band karo, aur kisi bhi family-sharing group se nikal jao.
- **Paise aur saamaan:** hisaab UPI se chukao, aur apna saamaan kisi dost ke zariye ya public place mein wapas lo.
- **Darwaaza:** agar unke paas chaabi thi, toh landlord ya PG owner ko batao. Flatmates, warden ya guard se kaho ki unhe andar na aane dein.

## Agar woh peechha kare, message kare ya ghar aa jaaye: Section 78 kya cover karta hai

Breakup wahi saaf "na" hai jo law dhoondhta hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 78 ke under, jo man kisi woman ka peechha karta hai, uske saaf mana karne ke baad bhi baar-baar contact karta hai, ya uske internet use par nazar rakhta hai, woh stalking karta hai. Saza pehli conviction par teen saal tak ki jail hai, aur dobara conviction par paanch saal tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Police ne 2024 mein stalking ke 9,865 cases register kiye, yaani har ek lakh women par 1.4 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh us peechha karne aur pareshaan karne ka ek chhota sa hissa hai jo kabhi police station tak pahunchta hi nahi.

Isliye pehle din se record banao. Apne ek saaf message ke baad dobara reply mat karo: gusse wala reply bhi wahi contact hai jo woh chahta hai. Calls, messages, naye accounts aur har us baar ka date ke saath log rakho jab woh tumhare college, office ya gali mein dikhe, aur screenshots aisi jagah save karo jahan woh pahunch na sake.

Agar woh tumhare darwaaze par aa jaaye ya peechha kare, toh "baat karne" bahar mat jao. 112 par call karo [[mha-erss]]. Report karne ke liye kisi bhi police station jao, chahe ghatna kahin bhi hui ho (Zero FIR), aur FIR ki free copy zaroor lo [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Woman ki stalking complaint ek woman officer ko hi record karni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Yeh maan kar chalo ki raasta lamba hai: 2024 mein courts ne stalking ke jitne trials poore kiye, unme se 25.2% mein conviction hui, aur saal ke end tak 52,273 cases pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. FIR ka pehla kaam protection hai: ek record, aur ek officer jise use jawaab dena padega.

Ek gap bhi hai. BNS ki wording ke hisaab se stalking sirf ek man hi ek woman ke khilaaf kar sakta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Agar tum man ho, ya tumhari ex woman hai, ya relationship queer hai, toh bhi dhamkiyon ko criminal intimidation ke taur par report kiya ja sakta hai, aur 112 aur cybercrime helpline sabke liye kaam karti hain. Agar tum 18 se kam ho, toh kisi bharosemand adult ko batao aur Child Helpline 1098 par call karo [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Agar woh images leak karne ki dhamki de: do ghante ka takedown aur 1930

Breakup ke baad ki sabse aam dhamki ke liye kisi ko tumhare darwaaze par aane ki zaroorat nahi padti: "Tumhari photos ab bhi mere paas hain." Teen baatein jaan lo.

Pehli, law tumhare saath hai, chahe photo tumne khud bheji ho. BNS ke Section 77 ke under, kisi woman ki private image uske consent ke bina share karna voyeurism hai, chahe usne image lene ke liye haan kaha ho, aur pehli conviction par ek se teen saal ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. IT Act ka Section 66E kisi bhi insaan ke private area ki image bina consent ke share karne par teen saal tak ki saza deta hai, chahe uska gender kuch bhi ho [[indiacode-it-act-2000]].

Doosri, ghadi platform ke khilaaf chalti hai. 20 February 2026 se platforms ko kisi insaan ki nude, sexual ya morphed images us insaan ki complaint ke do ghante ke andar hatani hoti hain; pehle yeh limit 24 ghante thi [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Teesri, negotiate mat karo, paise mat do aur kuch aur mat bhejo. Dhamki ka screenshot username aur date ke saath lo. Cybercrime helpline 1930 par call karo ya cybercrime.gov.in par complaint file karo [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]], aur us account ko platform par report karo.

## Jab ex khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ki dhamki de

"Agar tumne mujhe chhoda, toh main apne saath kuch kar lunga." Ise seriously lo, aur ise akele mat uthao. Ho sakta hai woh insaan sach mein takleef mein ho, ya ho sakta hai woh tumhare darr ka istemaal tumhe rokne ke liye kar raha ho. Tumhe yeh pata lagane ki zaroorat nahi ki sach kya hai: dono mein response same hai.

Bolo: "Mujhe tumhari fikr hai, aur main tumhare liye help bula raha/rahi hoon." Phir kisi aise insaan ko batao jo khud unke paas ja sake: parent, bhai-behen ya flatmate. Unhe Tele-MANAS ka number do, jo Health Ministry ki free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline hai: 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Agar tumhe lage ki woh abhi khatre mein hain, toh 112 par call karo.

Unke paas akele mat jao, aur breakup wapas mat lo. Darr ke maare ruke rehne se kisi ki takleef ka ilaaj nahi hota; isse dono yahi seekhte hain ki dhamki kaam karti hai. Tum kisi ki safety ki fikr karte hue bhi rishta chhod sakte ho. Agar breakup ke baad ke hafte tumhe anxious rakhein ya neend na aaye, toh 14416 tumhare liye bhi hai.

Safe ending cruel ending nahi hoti. Woh chhoti hoti hai, kisi aur ko uska pata hota hai, aur woh likhi hui hoti hai.

can-a-drunk-person-consent.en:
Alcohol runs through young Indian social life: the sangeet, the hostel terrace, the office party, the first date at a bar. So does the excuse that comes with it. "We were both drunk." "She was drinking too." "I don't remember." The law, the Supreme Court and the data point the same way: alcohol can take away a person's ability to consent, and it never takes away the other person's responsibility. Here are straight answers to the questions people actually ask. This is general information, not legal advice.

## What does the law say about intoxication and consent?

Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) makes sex rape when it happens without a woman's consent; when she said yes while intoxication, or a substance the man gave her or had someone give her, left her unable to understand what she was agreeing to; and when she is unable to communicate consent at all [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A woman who is asleep, passed out or drifting in and out cannot communicate anything.

The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes lists the belief that a woman's drinking invites sexual contact as a false stereotype [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. And since 2013, a survivor's character or past sexual experience has been irrelevant in law to whether she consented [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. Her drinking does not make her "that kind of woman"; we take that myth apart in a separate story.

There is a gap. Section 63 protects only women, and the BNS has no counterpart to IPC Section 377, so an adult man or transgender person assaulted while drunk has no rape law to turn to [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Under 18, every gender is covered by POCSO, and no one under 18 can consent, drunk or sober.

## How drunk is too drunk to say yes?

The law sets no number of drinks. The question is whether the person understands what is happening and can choose and say so. Signs that the answer is no: slurred speech, stumbling, vomiting, confusion about where they are, eyes closing, not responding, asking the same thing twice. A yes said at ten does not survive passing out at midnight.

Tipsy is not the same as incapacitated, but the line is hard to see from outside, and a wrong guess harms someone else. So the working rule is simple: if you have to ask yourself whether they are too drunk, they are. Wait until both of you are sober.

If you are the friend, watch for the person who stays sober while refilling one glass, or who keeps steering someone away from the group. Stay with a drunk friend and get them home safely.

## We were both drinking: who is responsible?

The person who starts or continues a sexual act is responsible for making sure there is a clear yes. Being drunk yourself does not change that, and nothing in Section 63 makes an exception for a man who was drinking too [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. "I was drunk too" explains a bad decision. It does not excuse it.

"I don't remember" works the same way. A blackout does not erase what happened. And on the other side, not remembering does not mean she agreed. It can be a sign that she could not.

## I think my drink was spiked. What now?

Feeling far drunker than your drinks explain, sudden dizziness, confusion or big gaps in memory can mean a drink was spiked. It happens to people of every gender. Tell someone you trust and do not leave alone. Call 112 if someone cannot be woken or is breathing strangely.

Go to a hospital the same day and tell the doctor you suspect spiking, so they can check you and record it as early as possible. If you were raped, Section 397 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) requires every hospital, public or private, to give you first aid or treatment at once and free of cost, and to inform the police; under Section 184, no medical examination can be done without your consent [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Two medicines run on a clock. HIV-prevention medicine (PEP) must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after exposure, and is taken for 28 days [[who-pep]]. Emergency contraception works up to 5 days after unprotected sex, sooner is better, the copper IUD is the most effective option, and it is not an abortion [[who-ec]]. Our 72-hour plan after a sexual assault covers evidence, the FIR and One Stop Centres step by step.

## Isn't alcohol to blame?

Alcohol is part of the picture. In NFHS-5, 71% of women whose husbands often get drunk reported physical or sexual violence by them, against 23% of women whose husbands do not drink [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. That is an association, not proof that alcohol causes violence: many men who drink never hurt anyone, and men who never drink also abuse.

The National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 found alcohol use disorder in 9% of Indian men against 0.5% of women, and a treatment gap of 86% for alcohol use disorders [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. That is a health crisis that deserves treatment. It is not a defence.

What alcohol does not do is plant the belief that a woman owes sex. That belief exists sober: in NFHS-5, 12.2% of men said a husband has the right to use force if his wife refuses [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. If your drinking brings anger or blackouts, Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free counselling [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. And if a friend tells you something happened while they were drunk, believe them, and help them reach care.
can-a-drunk-person-consent.hg:
Alcohol young Indians ki social life mein har jagah hai: shaadi ka sangeet, hostel ki chhat, office party, ya bar mein pehli date. Aur iske saath aata hai ek excuse. "Hum dono ne pi rakhi thi." "Woh bhi toh pi rahi thi." "Mujhe kuch yaad nahi." Law, Supreme Court aur data, teeno ek hi baat kehte hain: alcohol kisi ki consent dene ki capacity chheen sakta hai, par saamne wale ki responsibility kabhi nahi chheenta. Yahan un sawaalon ke seedhe jawab hain jo log asal mein poochte hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Nashe aur consent par law kya kehta hai?

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 sex ko rape maanta hai jab woh woman ki consent ke bina ho. Tab bhi, jab usne yes aise waqt bola jab nashe ki wajah se woh samajh hi nahi paa rahi thi ki kis cheez ke liye haan bol rahi hai, chahe nasha alcohol ka ho ya kisi aisi cheez ka jo aadmi ne khud ya kisi aur ke through use di ho. Aur tab bhi, jab woh consent communicate hi na kar sake [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Jo woman so rahi hai, behosh hai, ya baar-baar hosh kho rahi hai, woh kuch bhi communicate nahi kar sakti.

Supreme Court ki 2023 wali gender stereotypes handbook is belief ko false stereotype kehti hai ki woman ka drink karna sexual contact ka invitation hai [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Aur 2013 se law mein yeh bhi clear hai ki consent ke sawaal par survivor ka character ya uska past sexual experience matter nahi karta [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. Drink karne se koi "waisi ladki" nahi ban jaati; is myth par humne ek alag story mein baat ki hai.

Ek gap bhi hai. Section 63 sirf women ko protect karta hai, aur BNS mein IPC Section 377 jaisa koi section nahi hai. Isliye agar kisi adult man ya transgender insaan ke saath nashe ki haalat mein sexual assault ho, toh uske liye koi rape law nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 18 se kam umar mein har gender ko POCSO protect karta hai, aur 18 se kam ka koi bhi consent nahi de sakta, chahe drunk ho ya sober.

## Kitna drunk 'too drunk' hai?

Law mein drinks ki koi ginti fix nahi hai. Asli sawaal yeh hai ki kya woh insaan samajh raha hai ki kya ho raha hai, aur kya woh apni marzi choose karke bata sakta hai. Yeh signs batate hain ki jawab no hai: slurred speech, ladkhadana, ulti, yeh na samajh paana ki woh kahan hai, aankhein band hona, response na dena, ek hi baat do baar poochna. Raat das baje bola gaya yes, aadhi raat ko behosh hone ke baad yes nahi rehta.

Tipsy hona aur hosh kho dena ek baat nahi hai. Par bahar se yeh fark samajhna mushkil hai, aur galat andaaze ki keemat kisi aur ko chukani padti hai. Isliye ek simple rule yaad rakho: agar tumhe khud se poochna pad raha hai ki kahin zyada drunk toh nahi, toh zyada hi hai. Dono ke sober hone tak ruko.

Agar tum dost ho, toh us insaan par nazar rakho jo khud sober rehkar kisi ek ka glass baar-baar bhar raha hai, ya use group se door le jaane ki koshish kar raha hai. Drunk dost ke saath raho aur use safely ghar pahunchao.

## Dono ne pi rakhi thi: responsible kaun?

Jo insaan sexual act shuru karta hai ya aage badhata hai, uski responsibility hai ki clear yes mile. Khud drunk hone se yeh responsibility nahi badalti, aur Section 63 mein us aadmi ke liye koi exception nahi hai jisne khud bhi pi rakhi thi [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. "Maine bhi pi rakhi thi" ek galat decision ki wajah bata sakta hai. Use excuse nahi bana sakta.

"Mujhe yaad nahi" bhi aise hi kaam karta hai. Blackout se jo hua woh mit nahi jaata. Aur doosri taraf, agar use yaad nahi, toh iska matlab yeh nahi ki woh agree thi. Ho sakta hai woh agree karne ki haalat mein hi na rahi ho.

## Lagta hai meri drink spike hui thi. Ab kya karun?

Agar jitna piya usse kahin zyada nasha lage, achanak chakkar aaye, confusion ho ya raat ke bade-bade hisse yaad na rahein, toh ho sakta hai drink spike hui ho. Yeh kisi bhi gender ke saath ho sakta hai. Kisi trusted insaan ko batao aur akele mat niklo. Agar koi jagane par na uthe ya ajeeb tarah se saans le raha ho, toh 112 call karo.

Usi din hospital jao aur doctor ko clearly batao ki tumhe spiking ka shak hai, taaki woh jitni jaldi ho sake check karke ise record kar sakein. Agar tumhare saath rape hua hai, toh Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 397 kehta hai ki har hospital, government ho ya private, tumhe turant aur free mein first aid ya treatment dega, aur police ko inform karega. Section 184 ke under tumhari consent ke bina koi medical examination nahi ho sakta [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

Do dawaaon ke liye time bahut important hai. HIV rokne wali dawa (PEP) jitni jaldi ho sake shuru honi chahiye, 72 ghante ke baad nahi, aur yeh 28 din tak leni hoti hai [[who-pep]]. Emergency contraception unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak kaam karta hai, aur jitna jaldi lo utna better. Copper IUD sabse effective option hai, aur yeh abortion nahi hai [[who-ec]]. Sexual assault ke baad ke 72 ghante ka poora plan, yaani evidence, FIR aur One Stop Centres, humne ek alag story mein step-by-step bataya hai.

## Kya saara dosh alcohol ka hai?

Alcohol is kahani ka ek hissa zaroor hai. NFHS-5 mein, jin women ke husband aksar drunk rehte hain, unmein se 71% ne husband se physical ya sexual violence jheli. Jinke husband nahi peete, unmein yeh 23% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh ek association hai, proof nahi ki alcohol hi violence karwata hai: bahut se peene wale kabhi kisi ko hurt nahi karte, aur kabhi na peene wale bhi abuse karte hain.

National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein 9% Indian men mein alcohol use disorder mila, jabki women mein sirf 0.5% mein. Aur alcohol use disorders ka treatment gap 86% tha, yaani itne logon tak ilaaj pahuncha hi nahi [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Yeh ek health crisis hai jiska ilaaj hona chahiye. Par yeh koi defence nahi hai.

Alcohol ek kaam nahi karta: woh yeh soch paida nahi karta ki woman ko sex "dena hi padega". Yeh soch sober rehte hue bhi hoti hai. NFHS-5 mein 12.2% men ne kaha ki agar wife mana kare, toh husband ko force karne ka haq hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Agar tumhari drinking gusse ya blackouts tak pahunch rahi hai, toh Tele-MANAS (14416) par free counselling milti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Aur agar koi dost bataye ki nashe ki haalat mein uske saath kuch hua, toh uski baat par yakeen karo aur use help tak pahunchao.

consent-in-arranged-marriage-first-night.en:
Consider a couple in Jaipur. They met four times before the wedding, twice with parents in the room. On the wedding night the room is decorated, cousins tease them at the door, and everyone assumes they know what happens next. Neither has been taught much about sex. Neither has said a word to the other about it.

This is the "first night" script. This explainer is about the first two years of a marriage: where the script comes from, what the surveys and the law say, and what couples and families can do instead. It is general information, not legal advice.

## The 'first night' script and where it comes from

The script rests on one idea: the wedding was the yes, so everything after it, including that night, is already agreed. It puts pressure on both people. The bride is expected to go along. The groom is expected to "prove" himself, sometimes with relatives waiting for news in the morning.

It also rests on silence. In NFHS-5 (2019-21), only 54.4% of young women aged 15-24 knew where to get a condom, against 87.3% of young men [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Many brides walk into that room knowing less about contraception than the man they have just married.

In some homes the expectation goes further: blood on the sheet as proof of virginity. That proof is a myth. The hymen cannot show whether someone has had sex, and in 2022 the Supreme Court called the "two-finger" test a practice with "no scientific basis" [[theprint-sc-two-finger-test-2022]].

## What the surveys say about the first years of marriage

The NFHS-5 report notes that "a large proportion of spousal violence begins early in marriage". Among currently married women who had married only once, 11.2% had first faced physical or sexual violence from their husband within two years of the wedding, and 20.9% within five [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Sexual violence is part of that. Among ever-married women, 6.3% reported sexual violence by their husband, and 4.6% said he had physically forced them to have intercourse when they did not want to [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Of ever-married women who had faced sexual violence from anyone, 82% named their current husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Men's answers show the belief behind it. In the same survey, 12.2% of men aged 15-49, about one in eight, said a husband has the right to use force to have sex if his wife refuses, and 19.2% said he may get angry and reprimand her [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Women answered the violence questions face to face, so the true figures are likely higher. And most of it stays inside the house: only 11.3% of women abused only by their current husband had ever sought help [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Marriage and consent: what the Verma Committee said and the law still says

After the 2012 Delhi gang rape, the Justice J.S. Verma Committee reported on 23 January 2013 and recommended deleting the marital rape exception [[thehindu-verma-2013]]. Parliament did not take that advice.

Today, Exception 2 to Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) still says sex by a man with his own wife, if she is 18 or older, is not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. As of 19 November 2026 the Supreme Court had not ruled on the challenge to that exception; it has said it will fix the final hearing on 9 or 10 December 2026 [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]]. In December 2024 the Union government told the Rajya Sabha it had no proposal to criminalise marital rape, pointing instead to the Domestic Violence Act and BNS sections including Section 85 on cruelty [[scroll-no-proposal-marital-rape-2024]].

Some things are already settled. If the bride is under 18, there is no exception: since the Supreme Court's Independent Thought ruling of 11 October 2017, sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. That is not a rare case: in provisional NFHS-6 data for 2023-24, 20.1% of women aged 20-24 had been married before 18 [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. An adult wife is not without protection either. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 counts sexual abuse, meaning sexual conduct that abuses, humiliates, degrades or violates a woman's dignity, as domestic violence [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. And under a 2022 Supreme Court ruling, a wife pregnant from forced sex by her husband can seek an abortion up to 24 weeks as a rape survivor, without an FIR [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Conversations to have before the wedding

The answer to a script is a conversation, ideally before the wedding, alone, as two adults.

- **Take the deadline away.** "We don't have to do anything on the first night. We will go at our own pace."
- **Ask what worries them.** Pain, fear of "failing", fear of pregnancy and plain embarrassment are all normal to talk about. If sex hurts, stop. Pain is a reason to see a doctor, not something to push through.
- **Agree how to say stop.** "Not tonight" should end the matter, with no sulking, guilt or force.
- **Talk about children and contraception.** When, whether, and which method. With no method, about 85 in 100 women become pregnant within a year [[who-fp]].
- **Notice the reaction.** If a question about consent is met with mockery or "after marriage, you are mine", take it seriously. In NFHS-5, 59% of women who were afraid of their husband most of the time had faced spousal violence, against 15% of women who were never afraid [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## When the pressure comes from the family

Often the pressure is not only from the husband. Relatives ask for "good news" within months, joke at the bedroom door or ask about the sheets. A couple can answer together: "That is between us." Grooms are under pressure too, to perform, to produce a child, to show they are in charge. Taking time protects both partners.

If force has already happened, it is not "adjustment", and it is not the wife's fault. The Women Helpline and One Stop Centres can help: 926 One Stop Centres were operating by March 2026 and had assisted more than 13 lakh women [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]]. If you are a parent, the most protective sentence you can say to a daughter before her wedding is: "You can always come home and tell us."
consent-in-arranged-marriage-first-night.hg:
Socho, Jaipur ka ek couple. Shaadi se pehle dono sirf chaar baar mile, jinmein se do baar parents bhi kamre mein the. Shaadi ki raat kamra saja hua hai, cousins darwaze par chhed rahe hain, aur sab maan kar chal rahe hain ki aage kya hona hai. Dono mein se kisi ko sex ke baare mein theek se kuch nahi sikhaya gaya. Dono ne is baare mein aapas mein ek shabd bhi baat nahi ki.

Yahi hai "suhaagraat" ki bani-banayi script. Yeh explainer shaadi ke pehle do saal ke baare mein hai: yeh script kahan se aati hai, surveys aur law kya kehte hain, aur couples aur families iski jagah kya kar sakte hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Suhaagraat ki script, aur yeh aati kahan se hai

Yeh script ek soch par tiki hai: shaadi hi haan thi, toh uske baad sab kuch, us raat samet, pehle se agreed hai. Isse dono par pressure aata hai. Dulhan se ummeed hoti hai ki woh chupchaap maan jaaye. Dulhe se ummeed hoti hai ki woh khud ko "prove" kare, kai baar rishtedaar subah khabar ka intezaar bhi kar rahe hote hain.

Yeh script chuppi par bhi tiki hai. NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 15-24 saal ki sirf 54.4% young women ko pata tha ki condom kahan milta hai, jabki young men mein yeh 87.3% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Kai dulhanein us kamre mein jaati hain toh unhe contraception ke baare mein apne pati se bhi kam pata hota hai.

Kuch gharon mein baat aur aage jaati hai: virginity ke saboot ke taur par chaadar par khoon dekhna. Yeh "saboot" ek myth hai. Hymen se yeh pata nahi chal sakta ki kisi ne sex kiya hai ya nahi, aur 2022 mein Supreme Court ne "two-finger" test ko aisa practice bataya jiska "no scientific basis" hai [[theprint-sc-two-finger-test-2022]].

## Shaadi ke shuru ke saalon ke baare mein surveys kya kehte hain

NFHS-5 report khud kehti hai ki "a large proportion of spousal violence begins early in marriage". Jin currently married women ki sirf ek baar shaadi hui thi, unmein se 11.2% ne shaadi ke do saal ke andar pehli baar pati ki physical ya sexual violence jheli, aur 20.9% ne paanch saal ke andar [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Ismein sexual violence bhi shaamil hai. Ever-married women mein se 6.3% ne pati ki sexual violence report ki, aur 4.6% ne kaha ki pati ne unke na chahne par bhi physically force karke sex kiya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Jin ever-married women ne kisi se bhi sexual violence jheli thi, unmein se 82% ne apne current pati ka naam liya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Mardon ke jawab iske peeche ki soch dikhate hain. Isi survey mein 15-49 saal ke 12.2% mardon ne, yaani lagbhag har aath mein se ek ne, kaha ki agar wife mana kare toh pati ko force karke sex karne ka haq hai, aur 19.2% ne kaha ki use gussa karne aur daantne ka haq hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Women ne violence ke sawaalon ke jawab aamne-saamne diye the, isliye asli numbers shayad isse zyada hain. Aur zyada tar baat ghar ke andar hi reh jaati hai: jin women ke saath sirf current pati ne violence ki, unmein se sirf 11.3% ne kabhi help maangi [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Shaadi aur consent: Verma Committee ne kya kaha aur law aaj bhi kya kehta hai

2012 ke Delhi gang rape ke baad Justice J.S. Verma Committee ne 23 January 2013 ko report di aur marital rape exception hatane ki recommendation ki [[thehindu-verma-2013]]. Parliament ne yeh advice nahi maani.

Aaj bhi Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki agar wife 18 saal ya usse badi hai, toh pati ka uske saath sex rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 19 November 2026 tak Supreme Court ne is exception ke challenge par faisla nahi diya tha; court ne kaha hai ki final hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko fix karega [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]]. December 2024 mein Union government ne Rajya Sabha mein kaha tha ki marital rape ko crime banane ka uska koi proposal nahi hai, aur iski jagah Domestic Violence Act aur BNS ke kuch sections ki taraf ishaara kiya, jinmein cruelty wala Section 85 bhi hai [[scroll-no-proposal-marital-rape-2024]].

Kuch baatein pehle se settled hain. Agar dulhan 18 se chhoti hai, toh koi exception nahi: 11 October 2017 ke Supreme Court ke Independent Thought faisle ke baad se, 18 se kam umar ki wife ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. Aur yeh koi rare case nahi: NFHS-6 (2023-24) ke provisional data mein 20-24 saal ki 20.1% women ki shaadi 18 se pehle ho chuki thi [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Adult wife bhi bina protection ke nahi hai. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 sexual abuse ko, yaani aisa koi bhi sexual behaviour jo aurat ko humiliate kare, neecha dikhaye ya uski dignity ko thes pahunchaye, domestic violence maanta hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Aur 2022 ke Supreme Court ke ek faisle ke mutabik, agar pati ki zabardasti se wife pregnant hui hai, toh woh rape survivor ke taur par 24 hafte tak abortion karwa sakti hai, bina FIR ke [[sc-x-v-principal-secretary-2022]].

## Shaadi se pehle zaroori baatein

Script ka jawab hai baatcheet, aur iska sabse achha waqt hai shaadi se pehle, akele mein, do samajhdaar adults ki tarah.

- **Deadline hata do.** "Pehli raat kuch bhi karna zaroori nahi hai. Hum apni speed se chalenge."
- **Poocho ki unhe kis baat ki chinta hai.** Dard ka darr, "fail" hone ka darr, pregnancy ka darr ya bas sharm, in sab par baat karna bilkul normal hai. Agar sex mein dard ho, toh ruk jao. Dard doctor ko dikhane ki wajah hai, sehte rehne ki cheez nahi.
- **Rukne ka tareeka tay karo.** "Aaj nahi" ke baad baat wahin khatam honi chahiye, bina ruthne, taano ya zabardasti ke.
- **Bachchon aur contraception par baat karo.** Kab, chahiye ya nahi, aur kaunsa method. Bina kisi method ke, 100 mein se lagbhag 85 women ek saal ke andar pregnant ho jaati hain [[who-fp]].
- **Reaction dekho.** Agar consent ke sawaal par mazaak udaya jaaye, ya kaha jaaye ki "shaadi ke baad tum meri ho", toh ise halke mein mat lo. NFHS-5 mein jo women zyada tar waqt apne pati se darti thi, unmein se 59% ne spousal violence jheli thi, jabki jo kabhi nahi darti thi unmein yeh 15% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Jab pressure family se aaye

Aksar pressure sirf pati se nahi aata. Rishtedaar kuch hi mahino mein "good news" poochne lagte hain, kamre ke darwaze par mazaak karte hain ya chaadar ke baare mein poochte hain. Couple milkar jawab de sakta hai: "Yeh hum dono ke beech ki baat hai." Dulhon par bhi pressure hota hai: perform karne ka, jaldi bachcha karne ka, yeh dikhane ka ki ghar mein unki chalti hai. Waqt lena dono partners ko bachata hai.

Agar zabardasti ho chuki hai, toh yeh "adjustment" nahi hai, aur ismein wife ki koi galti nahi hai. Women Helpline aur One Stop Centres madad kar sakte hain: March 2026 tak 926 One Stop Centres chal rahe the aur 13 lakh se zyada women ki madad kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]]. Agar aap parents hain, toh shaadi se pehle beti se yeh zaroor kahiye: "Tum kabhi bhi ghar aakar humein bata sakti ho." Yeh ek line uski sabse badi hifaazat hai.

consent-in-practice-ask-check-stop.en:
In 1978 the Supreme Court acquitted two policemen accused of raping a minor girl inside a police station, reversing the Bombay High Court, which had convicted them (AIR 1979 SC 185). The judges noted that "no marks of injury were found" on the girl, described the alleged intercourse as "a peaceful affair" and concluded it was "not proved to amount to rape" [[sc-tukaram-maharashtra-1978]]. No injuries, a quiet encounter, so no rape: that was the logic. We tell the full story of the case in a separate case file. Today Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) says the opposite in plain words. A woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The law has moved. Many hostel rooms, parked cars and late-night chats have not.

This matters most to young adults. Of the 29,742 victims police recorded under the rape head in 2024, 19,489 were women aged 18 to 30 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In 96.8% of rape cases that year, the accused was someone the survivor knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. We have checked five common dating myths against the law in another story. This guide is about what to actually do: how to ask, how to read the answer, and how to stop.

## What 'unequivocal' and 'voluntary' mean outside a courtroom

Since the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013, Indian law has defined consent as "an unequivocal voluntary agreement": a woman shows, by words, gestures or any other communication, that she is willing to take part in the specific sexual act [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. Turn those legal words into three everyday tests.

Is it clear? If you are wondering whether they want this, you do not have a yes yet. Is it free? They must be able to say no without paying for it: no sulking, no breakup threat, no risk to their job, marks or place to stay. Is it about this? A yes to kissing is not a yes to sex, a yes on Friday is not a yes on Saturday, and a yes with a condom is not a yes without one.

Section 63 is written about a man and a woman. The habits apply to every couple, including two men, two women or a transgender partner.

## Silence, freezing and a reluctant 'okay' are not a yes

Fear does not always look like fear. Some people freeze: they go still, stop talking and wait for it to end. The 1978 judgment treated an encounter that left no marks as "a peaceful affair"; the 2013 amendment reversed that logic by saying that not resisting is not, on its own, consent [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes also rejects the idea that a genuine survivor must cry incessantly, and the belief that rapists are usually strangers [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

So read the signals. No answer. A body gone stiff. A face turned away, a hand pulled back, a nervous laugh, tears. "I don't know." "Maybe later." "Fine, whatever," after the third ask. None of these is clear, and none is free. Each one is a reason to stop and ask, never a reason to carry on.

## How to ask and check in without killing the mood

Plenty of films still sell a hero who wins by refusing to take no for an answer, and with him the idea that asking kills the mood. In real life a question takes two seconds: "Do you want to?" "Is this okay?" "Should we slow down?" "Want to stop?"

Ask before each new step, not once at the start of the evening. Make no easy to say. "We can just watch something instead" tells the other person that refusing will cost them nothing. Watch the body as well as the words; if the words say yes and the body says no, stop and ask again. If someone is too drunk to answer clearly, the answer is no. We answer the alcohol questions in a separate Q&A.

Chats follow the same rules. A yes to sexting is not a yes to meeting, and agreeing to send a photo is not agreeing to have it forwarded.

## Changing your mind midway, and hearing someone else change theirs

A yes is not a contract. People change their minds because something hurts, because they feel scared, because they remember something, or for no reason at all. Saying "I want to stop" does not make anyone a tease or a liar, and nobody owes an explanation for it.

If you are the one who hears it, stop straight away. Do not ask why, do not bargain for "just one minute", and do not punish the other person with silence the next day. Sulking after a no is pressure, and pressure turns the next yes into giving in.

## If you think you crossed a line

Many people still picture a rapist as a stranger, the stereotype the Supreme Court's handbook rejects. Police data points the other way: in most rape cases the accused is someone the survivor knew, such as a friend, a partner or a neighbour [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. So the question to ask is not "Am I that kind of person?" but "Did I have a clear yes?"

If you think you went ahead without a clear yes, stop now. Do not message the other person asking them to say it was fine; that is pressure again. Listen if they want to talk, give space if they want space, and apologise without a "but". Then get help to understand why it happened. Tele-MANAS (14416) offers free counselling [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

If it happened to you, it was not your fault, even if you froze, said nothing or knew the person well. If it was recent, see a doctor quickly: medicine that prevents HIV must start within 72 hours [[who-pep]]. This guide is general information, not legal advice.
consent-in-practice-ask-check-stop.hg:
1978 mein Supreme Court ne un do policewalon ko bari kar diya jin par ek minor ladki ke saath police station ke andar rape ka aarop tha (AIR 1979 SC 185). Bombay High Court ne unhe saza di thi, Supreme Court ne woh faisla palat diya. Judges ne note kiya ki ladki ke body par chot ka koi nishaan nahi mila ("no marks of injury were found"), kathit intercourse ko "a peaceful affair" kaha, aur nateeja nikala ki yeh "not proved to amount to rape" [[sc-tukaram-maharashtra-1978]]. Logic yeh tha: chot nahi, sab shaanti se hua, toh rape nahi. Is case ki poori kahani humne ek alag case file mein batayi hai. Aaj Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 seedhe words mein bilkul ulta kehta hai: agar koi woman physically resist nahi karti, toh sirf is wajah se use consenting nahi maana ja sakta [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Law aage badh gaya hai. Par bahut saare hostel rooms, parked cars aur late-night chats abhi wahin atke hain.

Yeh sabse zyada young adults ka issue hai. 2024 mein police ne rape head mein 29,742 victims record kiye, aur unmein se 19,489 women 18 se 30 saal ki thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us saal 96.8% rape cases mein accused koi jaan-pehchaan wala tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Dating ke paanch common myths ko humne ek doosri story mein law ke against check kiya hai. Yeh guide practical hai: kaise poochna hai, jawab ko kaise padhna hai, aur kaise rukna hai.

## 'Unequivocal' aur 'voluntary' ka matlab, courtroom ke bahar

Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 ke baad se Indian law consent ko "an unequivocal voluntary agreement" kehta hai: woman words, gestures ya kisi bhi aur communication se dikhati hai ki woh us specific sexual act ke liye willing hai [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. In legal words ko roz ki life ke teen simple tests mein badal lo.

Pehla test: kya yes clear hai? Agar tum abhi bhi soch rahe ho ki saamne wala chahta hai ya nahi, toh tumhare paas yes nahi hai. Doosra test: kya yes free hai? Woh bina kuch khoye no bol sake: na sulking, na breakup ki dhamki, na job, marks ya rehne ki jagah ka koi risk. Teesra test: kya yes isi cheez ke liye hai? Kiss ke liye yes, sex ke liye yes nahi hai. Friday ka yes, Saturday ka yes nahi hai. Condom ke saath yes, bina condom ke yes nahi hai.

Section 63 ek man aur ek woman ke baare mein likha gaya hai. Par yeh habits har couple par apply hoti hain, chahe do men hon, do women hon, ya partner transgender ho.

## Silence, freeze ho jaana aur bemann wala 'okay', yes nahi hain

Darr hamesha darr jaisa nahi dikhta. Kuch log darr mein freeze ho jaate hain: hilna band, bolna band, bas wait karte hain ki yeh jaldi khatam ho jaaye. 1978 ke judgment ne jis encounter mein chot ka nishaan nahi tha, use "a peaceful affair" maana tha; 2013 ke amendment ne yeh logic palat diya aur kaha ki resist na karna, sirf is wajah se, consent nahi hai [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. Supreme Court ki 2023 wali gender stereotypes handbook bhi is idea ko galat maanti hai ki asli survivor lagataar roti hi rehti hai. Aur is belief ko bhi galat maanti hai ki rapists zyada tar strangers hote hain [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Toh signals padho. Koi jawab nahi. Body stiff ho gayi. Chehra doosri taraf mud gaya, haath peeche khinch gaya, nervous hasi, ya aansu. "Pata nahi." "Shayad baad mein." Teesri baar poochne par "Theek hai, jo karna hai karo." Inmein se kuch bhi clear nahi hai, aur kuch bhi free nahi hai. Har signal rukne aur poochne ki wajah hai, aage badhne ki kabhi nahi.

## Mood kharab kiye bina kaise poochho aur check-in karo

Bahut si filmein aaj bhi aise hero ko dikhati hain jo 'no' ko maanta hi nahi aur end mein jeet jaata hai, aur unke saath yeh soch bhi bechti hain ki poochne se mood kharab ho jaata hai. Real life mein ek sawaal do second leta hai: "Tumhara mann hai?" "Yeh okay hai?" "Thoda slow karein?" "Ruk jaayein?"

Har naye step se pehle poochho, sirf shaam ki shuruaat mein ek baar nahi. No bolna easy banao. "Chalo, koi movie dekh lete hain" jaisi ek line bata deti hai ki mana karne ki koi keemat nahi hai. Words ke saath body bhi dekho. Agar words yes bolein aur body no, toh ruko aur phir se poochho. Agar koi itna drunk hai ki clearly jawab na de sake, toh jawab no hai. Alcohol wale sawaalon ke jawab humne ek alag Q&A mein diye hain.

Chats par bhi yahi rules hain. Sexting ke liye yes, milne ke liye yes nahi hai. Photo bhejne ki haan, use aage forward karne ki haan nahi hai.

## Beech mein mann badalna, aur kisi aur ka mann badalna sunna

Yes koi contract nahi hai. Log beech mein mann badalte hain: kabhi dard hota hai, kabhi darr lagta hai, kabhi kuch yaad aa jaata hai, aur kabhi bas mann nahi rehta. "Mujhe rukna hai" bolne se koi tease ya jhootha nahi ban jaata, aur iske liye kisi ko explanation dene ki zaroorat bhi nahi.

Agar tum sunne wale ho, toh usi pal ruk jao. 'Kyun' mat poochho, "bas ek minute" ka bargain mat karo, aur agle din silence se saza bhi mat do. No ke baad sulking bhi pressure hai, aur pressure agle yes ko haar maan lene mein badal deta hai.

## Agar tumhe lagta hai ki tumne line cross ki

Bahut log aaj bhi rapist ko ek stranger ki tarah imagine karte hain, aur Supreme Court ki handbook isi stereotype ko galat kehti hai. Police data ulti taraf ishara karta hai: zyada tar rape cases mein accused survivor ka jaan-pehchaan wala hota hai, jaise dost, partner ya padosi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isliye khud se yeh mat poochho ki "Kya main waisa insaan hoon?" Yeh poochho: "Kya mujhe clear yes mila tha?"

Agar tumhe lagta hai ki tum clear yes ke bina aage badhe, toh abhi ruko. Doosre insaan ko message karke unse yeh mat kehlwao ki "sab theek tha"; woh phir se pressure hai. Woh baat karna chahein toh suno, space chahein toh space do, aur sorry bolo, bina kisi "but" ke. Phir kisi ki help se samjho ki aisa kyun hua. Tele-MANAS (14416) par free counselling milti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

Agar yeh tumhare saath hua, toh isme tumhari koi galti nahi hai, chahe tum freeze ho gaye the, kuch bol nahi paaye, ya us insaan ko achhe se jaante the. Agar haal hi mein hua hai, toh jaldi doctor ke paas jao: HIV rokne wali dawa 72 ghante ke andar shuru honi chahiye [[who-pep]]. Yeh guide general information hai, legal advice nahi.

conversion-therapy-india-loophole.en:
Imagine a 19-year-old in Madurai whose parents find messages from her girlfriend. Over one month they take her to three places: a psychiatrist in the city, a clinic run by an alternative-medicine practitioner, and a faith healer two districts away. All three promise a "cure". Only the first is breaking a written rule. Since 25 August 2022, a registered doctor who tries to change a person's sexuality commits professional misconduct [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. For the other two, we could find no specific rule on this at all. No national data shows where Indian families take their children to be "fixed". The rules show exactly where the protection ends.

## What the Madras High Court ordered in 2021

The rule began with a petition filed by a lesbian couple. In June 2021, in *S. Sushma v. Commissioner of Police*, Justice N. Anand Venkatesh of the Madras High Court directed that any attempt to medically "cure" or change the sexual orientation or gender identity of LGBTQIA+ people be prohibited. Professionals who took part were to face action, up to withdrawal of their licence to practise [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. The same order asked for sensitisation of police, the judiciary, schools and health workers, and the court kept the case open to monitor compliance.

Read the direction closely and one word carries the weight: *medically*. The order targets professionals with licences, which a regulator can take away. That made the rule enforceable. It also drew its boundary.

Being queer is not an illness, and between consenting adults it has not been a crime since the Supreme Court read down Section 377 on 6 September 2018 [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. There is nothing for a doctor to treat.

## The NMC letter and who it binds

The National Medical Commission did not act on its own. It wrote to all state medical councils only after the High Court directed it to, in an order of 8 July 2022. Its letter of 25 August 2022 said that carrying out "conversion therapies" to alter the sexuality of LGBTQIA+ persons "will be considered professional misconduct" [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. That places it under the 2002 professional-conduct regulations that bind every registered medical practitioner.

So a psychiatrist, a general physician or an endocrinologist who offers to change someone's orientation can be reported to the state medical council, which can act against their registration. That is a real penalty: a doctor's livelihood depends on that registration.

But the letter is not a law passed by Parliament or a state legislature, and it creates no crime. Nobody goes to jail under it. And it cannot reach anyone who is not on a medical register.

## Outside the rule: faith healers, alternative medicine and 'counsellors'

State medical councils register doctors of modern medicine. Practitioners of Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha or homoeopathy are regulated separately, and the NMC letter does not bind them. We found no equivalent rule from those regulators in the material we could verify. A baba, a faith healer or a self-styled "counsellor" with no professional registration answers to no council at all. If a family pays one of them to "fix" a son or daughter, there is no licence to withdraw.

Parliament has written a harsh new offence about forced identity, but in the opposite direction. Under the 2026 amendment to the transgender law, kidnapping an adult and causing grievous hurt to force them to assume a transgender identity carries rigorous imprisonment of 10 years to life [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. There is no matching offence for forcing someone to stop being gay, lesbian, bisexual or trans.

What is left is general criminal law. If a "cure" involves beating, locking someone up or threats, those are crimes whoever commits them.
