Voluntarily causing hurt, for example, is punishable under Section 115(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita with up to one year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 10,000, or both [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Those sections punish the violence, not the "cure". And they depend on a young person, often still living at home, going to the police about their own family.

## The committee that was asked, and the silence since

There was a chance to close the gap nationally. On 16 April 2024, after the Supreme Court's same-sex marriage judgment, the Centre set up a six-member committee chaired by the Cabinet Secretary. Its terms include measures to ensure that queer persons are not subjected to "involuntary medical treatments, surgeries, etc.", including modules on their mental health [[gazette-queer-committee-order-2024]]. A rule from that level could cover everyone who sells a "cure", not just doctors.

More than two and a half years later, we could find no published report from it. India's strongest protection against conversion practices is still one High Court's 2021 order, and a regulator's letter that exists because that court pushed for it.

## How to complain, and to whom

This is general information, not legal advice.

- **A registered doctor:** write to the state medical council where the doctor is registered. Give the name, the registration number if it is on a prescription, dates, and copies of prescriptions or messages, and refer to the NMC letter of 25 August 2022 [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].
- **Mental health care that treated your orientation as the illness:** Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 bars discrimination in mental health care on any basis, naming sexual orientation [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. Complain in writing to the hospital and, if the professional is a registered doctor, to the state medical council as well.
- **An alternative-medicine practitioner:** there is no specific rule, but you can still write to the board or council that registered them.
- **Force, confinement or threats:** call 112. If the person is under 18, call the Child Helpline on 1098.

If the pressure is wearing you down, Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free and round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Nothing about who you are needs curing.
conversion-therapy-india-loophole.hg:
Socho, Madurai ki ek 19 saal ki ladki hai, jiske parents ko uski girlfriend ke messages mil jaate hain. Ek mahine mein woh use teen jagah le jaate hain: shehar ke ek psychiatrist ke paas, ek alternative-medicine practitioner ke clinic mein, aur do district door ek faith healer ke paas. Teeno "cure" ka vaada karte hain. Lekin sirf pehla wala kisi likhe hue rule ko tod raha hai. 25 August 2022 se, agar koi registered doctor kisi ki sexuality badalne ki koshish karta hai, toh yeh professional misconduct hai [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. Baaki do ke liye humein is baare mein koi khaas rule mila hi nahi. Koi national data nahi batata ki Indian families apne bachchon ko "theek" karwane kahan le jaati hain. Par rules saaf dikhate hain ki protection kahan khatam hoti hai.

## 2021 mein Madras High Court ne kya order diya

Yeh rule ek lesbian couple ki petition se shuru hua. June 2021 mein, *S. Sushma v. Commissioner of Police* case mein, Madras High Court ke Justice N. Anand Venkatesh ne order diya ki LGBTQIA+ logon ka sexual orientation ya gender identity medically "cure" karne ya badalne ki har koshish par rok lage. Jo professionals isme shaamil hon, unke khilaaf action ho, jisme practice ka licence wapas lena bhi shaamil hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. Isi order mein police, judiciary, schools aur health workers ko sensitise karne ko bhi kaha gaya, aur court ne compliance par nazar rakhne ke liye case khula rakha.

Order dhyaan se padho toh ek word sabse bhaari hai: *medically*. Order un professionals ko target karta hai jinke paas licence hai, jo ek regulator chheen sakta hai. Isi se rule ko lagu karna mumkin hua. Aur isi ne uski boundary bhi kheench di.

Queer hona koi bimaari nahi hai. 6 September 2018 ko Supreme Court ne Section 377 ko read down kiya, aur tab se consent wale adults ke beech yeh crime bhi nahi hai [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. Doctor ke paas treat karne ke liye kuch hai hi nahi.

## NMC ka letter aur woh kis par lagu hota hai

National Medical Commission ne khud se kadam nahi uthaya. Usne saari state medical councils ko tabhi likha jab High Court ne 8 July 2022 ke order mein use aisa karne ko kaha. 25 August 2022 ke letter mein likha tha ki LGBTQIA+ logon ki sexuality badalne ke liye "conversion therapies" karna "will be considered professional misconduct" [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. Isse yeh 2002 ke professional-conduct regulations ke under aa gaya, jo har registered medical practitioner par lagu hote hain.

Yaani agar koi psychiatrist, general physician ya endocrinologist kisi ka orientation badalne ki baat kare, toh uski complaint state medical council mein ho sakti hai, aur council uske registration par action le sakti hai. Yeh asli saza hai: doctor ki rozi-roti usi registration par tiki hoti hai.

Lekin yeh letter Parliament ya kisi state assembly ka banaya law nahi hai, aur isse koi crime nahi banta. Iske under koi jail nahi jaata. Aur jo kisi medical register par hai hi nahi, us tak yeh pahunch hi nahi sakta.

## Rule ke bahar: faith healers, alternative medicine aur 'counsellors'

State medical councils modern medicine ke doctors ko register karti hain. Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha ya homoeopathy ke practitioners ka regulation alag hota hai, aur NMC ka letter un par lagu nahi hota. Jo material hum verify kar paaye, usme un regulators ka aisa koi rule humein nahi mila. Koi baba, faith healer ya khud ko "counsellor" kehne wala insaan, jiska koi professional registration nahi hai, kisi council ko jawab-deh nahi hai. Agar family unme se kisi ko beta ya beti "theek" karne ke paise deti hai, toh chheenne ke liye koi licence hai hi nahi.

Parliament ne forced identity par ek sakht naya offence likha hai, lekin ulti direction mein. Transgender law mein 2026 ke amendment ke under, kisi adult ko kidnap karke aur grievous hurt pahuncha kar use transgender identity apnane par majboor karne ki saza 10 saal se lekar umar qaid tak ki rigorous imprisonment hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Lekin kisi ko gay, lesbian, bisexual ya trans hona chhodne par majboor karne ke liye aisa koi offence nahi hai.

Bachta hai general criminal law. Agar "cure" mein maar-peet, kisi ko band karke rakhna ya dhamkiyan shaamil hain, toh yeh crime hain, chahe koi bhi kare. Jaise, jaan-boojhkar hurt pahunchane par Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ki Section 115(2) ke under ek saal tak ki jail, Rs 10,000 tak ka fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Par yeh sections violence ki saza dete hain, "cure" ki nahi. Aur yeh tabhi kaam aate hain jab ek young insaan, jo aksar abhi bhi ghar par hi rehta hai, apni hi family ke khilaaf police ke paas jaaye.

## Jis committee se kaha gaya, aur uske baad ki chuppi

National level par yeh gap band karne ka ek mauka tha. 16 April 2024 ko, same-sex marriage par Supreme Court ke judgment ke baad, Centre ne Cabinet Secretary ki chairmanship mein chhe members ki ek committee banayi. Uske terms mein yeh bhi hai ki queer logon par "involuntary medical treatments, surgeries, etc." na hon, aur unki mental health par modules bhi shaamil hon [[gazette-queer-committee-order-2024]]. Us level ka rule har us insaan ko cover kar sakta tha jo "cure" bechta hai, sirf doctors ko nahi.

Dhaai saal se zyada ho gaye, aur humein is committee ki koi published report nahi mili. Conversion practices ke khilaaf India ki sabse mazboot protection aaj bhi ek High Court ka 2021 ka order hai, aur ek regulator ka letter jo sirf isliye maujood hai kyunki us court ne zor diya.

## Complaint kaise karein, aur kisse

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

- **Registered doctor:** jis state medical council mein doctor registered hai, wahan likhit complaint karo. Naam, prescription par likha registration number, dates, aur prescriptions ya messages ki copies do, aur NMC ke 25 August 2022 ke letter ka hawala do [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].
- **Mental health care jisne tumhare orientation ko hi bimaari maana:** Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ki Section 21 mental health care mein kisi bhi basis par discrimination par rok lagati hai, aur sexual orientation ka naam leti hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. Hospital mein likhit complaint karo, aur agar woh professional registered doctor hai, toh state medical council mein bhi.
- **Alternative-medicine practitioner:** koi khaas rule nahi hai, phir bhi jis board ya council ne unhe register kiya hai, use likh sakte ho.
- **Zabardasti, band karke rakhna ya dhamkiyan:** 112 par call karo. Agar insaan 18 se kam umar ka hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

Agar yeh pressure tumhe tod raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai aur 24x7 chalta hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Tum jo ho, usme kuch bhi "theek" karne layak nahi hai.

dating-consent-myths-checked-against-law.en:
In 2024, police in India registered 29,536 rape cases. In 28,597 of them, the accused was someone the survivor knew. The largest group, 13,879 cases, were friends, online friends, live-in partners "on pretext of marriage" or separated husbands [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) points the same way: among never-married women who reported sexual violence, 16% named a current or former boyfriend, and only 5% named a stranger [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

These are only the cases that reached a police station or a surveyor. Behind many of them sit dating scripts that young Indians pick up from friends, films and porn. Here are five, checked against two yardsticks: Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), India's rape law since 1 July 2024 [[air-new-criminal-laws-2024]], and the Supreme Court's Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes, released on 16 August 2023 to stop judges reasoning from myths [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Myth 1: "She came back to my room, so she agreed"

Coming over is a yes to coming over. Section 63 defines consent as "an unequivocal voluntary agreement", shown by words, gestures or other communication, to "the specific sexual act" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Unequivocal means there is no doubt about it. An open door, a cab ride home or "come up for chai" does not pass that test.

The Supreme Court's handbook makes the same point about clothes. It calls it a false stereotype that a woman's clothing, drinking or smoking invites sexual contact, and says a man who touches a woman without consent "must not be permitted to take the defence that the woman invited his touch by dressing in a particular way" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Swap "dressing" for "visiting" and the logic holds. Alcohol does not rescue the argument either: under Section 63, a yes given while a woman is intoxicated is not valid consent, and sex with a woman who cannot communicate consent is rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myth 2: "We kissed, so the rest was agreed"

The law's phrase is "the specific sexual act". A kiss is consent to a kiss. Every new step needs its own yes, and either person can stop at any point.

Silence does not fill the gap. Since 2013, the rape law has said that a woman who does not physically resist is not, for that reason alone, consenting [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]], and the BNS kept those words [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A person may freeze, go quiet or go along because refusing feels unsafe. The handbook is blunt: "There is no 'correct' or 'appropriate' way in which a survivor or victim behaves" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Consider a hypothetical. A 20-year-old in Lucknow kisses her boyfriend at his flat, then pulls back and goes quiet when he goes further. He reads her silence as shyness. The law reads it as the absence of an unequivocal yes. Knowing the law is half the job; the other half is the habit of asking, checking in and stopping.

## Myth 3: "A yes last week is a yes tonight"

Consent is not a season pass. It is given to a specific act, at a specific time, by a person who can say no the next time.

Evidence law says the same. When Parliament rewrote rape law in 2013, it added Section 53A to the Evidence Act: in a rape trial, a woman's character or her "previous sexual experience with any person" is not relevant to whether she consented [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. "Any person" includes the accused himself. Having had sex with someone before proves nothing about tonight.

The handbook also calls it a myth that a genuine survivor never speaks to the accused again [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Staying in the same friend group, or even replying to his messages, does not rewrite what happened.

## Myth 4: "'No' means try harder"

Films sell the hero who wears her down. The law has another name for it. Repeatedly following or contacting a woman despite her clear lack of interest is stalking under Section 78 BNS, punishable with up to 3 years in prison, and up to 5 on a repeat conviction [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 9,865 stalking cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

A yes that arrives after the twentieth ask, the sulking and the "if you loved me" messages is not the voluntary agreement Section 63 describes. If the pressure involves private photos, note this: under Section 77 BNS, sharing a woman's private image without her consent is a crime even if she agreed to the photo being taken [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myth 5: "It cannot be assault if we are dating"

This is the myth the data breaks most completely. In 2024, 13,879 rape cases named friends, online friends, partners or separated husbands, against 2,134 that named family members [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. NCRB puts "promise of marriage" cases in the same group, so the numbers cannot say how many began with a date. Worldwide, WHO's 2018 estimates found that 1 in 4 young women aged 15-24 who had been in a relationship had already faced violence from a partner by their mid-twenties [[who-vaw-estimates-2021]]. Even the handbook notes that "very often men sexually assault or rape a woman known to them in some capacity" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Section 63 has no exception for boyfriends. The only relationship it exempts is marriage to a wife aged 18 or older [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A boyfriend, a fiancé or an ex has no such cover.

Consent matters in every relationship, including between two men or with a transgender partner. Section 63 protects women only, and since the BNS dropped Section 377 there is no specific offence for non-consensual penetrative sex against an adult man or transgender person [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The gap is in the law, not in the harm.

If any of this describes something that happened to you, it was not your fault. Most women carry it alone: in NFHS-5, 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Telling one person you trust is a real first step.
dating-consent-myths-checked-against-law.hg:
2024 mein India mein police ne rape ke 29,536 cases darj kiye. Inmein se 28,597 cases mein accused koi aisa tha jise survivor pehle se jaanti thi. Sabse bada group, yaani 13,879 cases, dost, online dost, "shaadi ke bahane" saath rehne wale live-in partners ya alag reh rahe patiyon ka tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) bhi yahi kehta hai: jin unmarried women ne sexual violence jheli, unmein se 16% ne apne current ya ex boyfriend ka naam liya. Stranger ka naam sirf 5% ne liya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Yeh sirf woh cases hain jo police station ya survey walon tak pahunche. Inmein se bahut se cases ke peeche dating ki kuch ghisi-piti scripts hoti hain, jo young Indians doston, films aur porn se seekhte hain. Yahan aisi paanch baatein hain, do kasautiyon par check ki hui. Pehli, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63, jo 1 July 2024 se India ka rape law hai [[air-new-criminal-laws-2024]]. Doosri, Supreme Court ki "Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes", jo 16 August 2023 ko aayi taaki judges purani galat soch ke basis par faisle na karein [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Myth 1: "Woh mere room mein aayi, matlab raazi thi"

Room mein aane ki haan sirf room mein aane ki haan hai. Section 63 consent ko define karta hai "an unequivocal voluntary agreement" ke roop mein, yaani saaf aur apni marzi se di gayi haan. Yeh haan words, gestures ya kisi aur tarah se di ja sakti hai, par "the specific sexual act" ke liye honi chahiye [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Unequivocal ka matlab hai ki koi shak na ho. Khula darwaza, ghar tak cab mein saath aana, ya "upar aao, chai peete hain", inmein se kuch bhi is test ko pass nahi karta.

Supreme Court ki handbook kapdon ke baare mein yahi baat kehti hai. Woh is soch ko galat stereotype bataati hai ki aurat ke kapde, uska drink karna ya smoke karna sexual contact ka invitation hai. Handbook kehti hai ki jo aadmi bina consent kisi aurat ko chhoota hai, use yeh defence lene nahi dena chahiye ki aurat ne apne kapdon se use bulaya tha [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. "Kapdon" ki jagah "room mein aana" rakh do, logic wahi rehta hai. Alcohol ka bahana bhi nahi chalta: Section 63 ke under, nashe ki haalat mein di gayi haan valid consent nahi hai, aur jo aurat consent communicate hi nahi kar sakti, uske saath sex rape hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myth 2: "Kiss kiya tha, toh aage ke liye bhi haan thi"

Law ke words hain "the specific sexual act". Kiss ki haan sirf kiss ki haan hai. Har naye step ke liye nayi haan chahiye, aur dono mein se koi bhi kabhi bhi ruk sakta hai.

Chup rehna bhi haan nahi hai. 2013 se rape law mein likha hai ki agar aurat ne physically resist nahi kiya, toh sirf is wajah se use raazi nahi maana jaayega [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]], aur BNS ne bhi yahi words rakhe hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Kai baar insaan freeze ho jaata hai, chup ho jaata hai, ya bas saath chalta rehta hai, kyunki mana karna safe nahi lagta. Handbook seedha kehti hai ki survivor ke behave karne ka koi "sahi" ya "appropriate" tareeka nahi hota [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Ek hypothetical socho. Lucknow ki ek 20 saal ki ladki apne boyfriend ke flat par use kiss karti hai, phir jab woh aage badhta hai toh peeche hat jaati hai aur chup ho jaati hai. Ladka uski chuppi ko sharm samajhta hai. Law use saaf haan ki kami maanta hai. Law jaanna aadha kaam hai; baaki aadha hai poochne, beech-beech mein check-in karne aur rukne ki aadat.

## Myth 3: "Pichhle hafte haan kaha tha, toh aaj bhi haan hai"

Consent koi season pass nahi hai. Yeh ek specific act ke liye, ek specific time par di jaati hai, aur agli baar wahi insaan na bhi keh sakta hai.

Evidence law bhi yahi kehta hai. 2013 mein jab Parliament ne rape law badla, tab Evidence Act mein Section 53A joda gaya: rape trial mein aurat ka character ya "previous sexual experience with any person" yeh decide karne mein relevant nahi hai ki usne consent diya ya nahi [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. "Any person" mein accused khud bhi aata hai. Pehle kisi ke saath sex kiya ho, toh usse aaj raat ke baare mein kuch prove nahi hota.

Handbook is soch ko bhi myth bataati hai ki "asli" survivor accused se phir kabhi baat nahi karti [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]]. Same friend group mein rehna, ya uske messages ka reply de dena, jo hua use badal nahi deta.

## Myth 4: "Uski 'na' ka matlab hai, aur try karo"

Films mein hero tab tak peeche pada rehta hai jab tak heroine maan na jaaye. Law iska alag naam rakhta hai. Agar koi aurat saaf bata chuki hai ki use interest nahi hai, phir bhi uska baar-baar peecha karna ya contact karna Section 78 BNS ke under stalking hai. Iski saza 3 saal tak ki jail hai, aur repeat conviction par 5 saal tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 2024 mein police ne stalking ke 9,865 cases darj kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Beesvi baar poochne ke baad, ruthne ke baad, ya "agar tum mujhse pyaar karti ho toh..." wale messages ke baad mili haan woh voluntary agreement nahi hai jiski baat Section 63 karta hai. Agar is pressure mein private photos ki baat bhi aa rahi hai, toh yeh jaan lo: Section 77 BNS ke under kisi aurat ki private photo uski marzi ke bina share karna crime hai, chahe photo khinchwane ke liye usne haan kaha ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myth 5: "Hum date kar rahe hain, toh yeh assault ho hi nahi sakta"

Data is myth ko sabse zyada todta hai. 2024 mein rape ke 13,879 cases mein accused dost, online dost, partner ya alag reh rahe pati the, jabki family members ke khilaaf aise cases 2,134 the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. NCRB "promise of marriage" wale cases bhi isi group mein ginta hai, isliye in numbers se pata nahi chalta ki kitne cases kisi date se shuru hue. Duniya bhar mein, WHO ke 2018 estimates kehte hain ki 15-24 saal ki jo young women kisi relationship mein reh chuki thi, unmein se har 4 mein se 1 apne mid-twenties tak partner violence jhel chuki thi [[who-vaw-estimates-2021]]. Khud handbook maanti hai ki "very often men sexually assault or rape a woman known to them in some capacity" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

Section 63 mein boyfriends ke liye koi exception nahi hai. Sirf ek rishte ko chhoot mili hai: pati ko, agar wife 18 saal ya usse badi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Boyfriend, fiance ya ex, kisi ko aisi koi chhoot nahi hai.

Consent har relationship mein zaroori hai, chahe do mardon ke beech ho ya kisi transgender partner ke saath. Section 63 sirf aurton ko protect karta hai, aur BNS se Section 377 hatne ke baad kisi adult aadmi ya transgender person ke saath non-consensual penetrative sex ke liye koi specific offence nahi bacha [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Kami law mein hai, dard mein nahi.

Agar inmein se kuch bhi tumhare saath hua hai, toh usmein tumhari koi galti nahi thi. Zyada tar aurtein yeh bojh akele uthati hain: NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki 77% aurton ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko batana ek asli pehla step hai.

dating-violence-friends-partners-ncrb-da.en:
In 2024, police in India registered 13,879 rape cases in which the accused was a "friend, online friend or live-in partner on pretext of marriage" or a separated husband [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is the biggest group of known accused in the National Crime Records Bureau's (NCRB) offender table, ahead of family friends, neighbours, employers and other known persons (12,584) and family members (2,134).

Much of the world calls this dating violence: abuse by a boyfriend, girlfriend or partner who is not a spouse, from stalking and threats to beatings and rape. India's crime records have no head for it, its national family health survey measures partner violence mainly by husbands, and school sex education that could name its warning signs has been banned in several states. Here is what the numbers show, what they lump together and what a policy would need.

## The biggest box in NCRB's offender table

Of 29,536 rape cases registered in 2024, 28,597 (96.8%) named an accused the survivor knew [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Our breakdown of the full offender table covers every group; this story stays with the largest.

The survivors were young. Of 29,742 victims recorded under the rape head, 19,489 were aged 18 to 30 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. But NCRB counts victims by age and cases by relationship, in separate tables, so nobody can say how many of the 13,879 cases involved young couples. The system is not built to see that.

## What 'friend, online friend or partner' hides

The box holds at least four different relationships: a boyfriend, a man met on Instagram, a live-in partner who promised marriage and a husband living apart. NCRB cannot separate them, so promise-of-marriage cases are invisible inside it [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Since July 2024, sex by deceit or a false promise of marriage that does not amount to rape has its own offence, Section 69 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), with up to 10 years in prison [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. It logged 1,325 cases in its first six months [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The counting rules hide more. NCRB records each FIR once, under its most serious offence [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. If a partner stalked, threatened and then raped a woman, the stalking and threats vanish from the record.

Violence between partners that stops short of rape carries no relationship tag at all. Police registered 9,865 stalking cases in 2024, and NCRB's cyber-crime tables separately list 1,224 cases of cyber stalking or bullying of women and 370 of cyber blackmail or threats [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. These counts carry no relationship tag, so nobody can say how many of the accused were boyfriends or exes.

## Teenagers in the same box: POCSO's 22,308

The same category dominates child sexual abuse data. Of 44,126 cases of penetrative sexual assault under the POCSO Act in 2024, 22,308 (50.6%) named a friend, online friend or live-in partner "on pretext of marriage" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Family members were the accused in 3,658 cases, and unknown accused in just 1,492.

Sexual activity with anyone under 18 is an offence whatever the "consent"; the age below which a girl's consent does not count was raised from 16 to 18 in 2013 [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. So the 22,308 mixes cases that need very different responses: an adult who groomed a 14-year-old online, a teenage boyfriend who used force, and romantic relationships between adolescents, which POCSO treats as offences below 18 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The data cannot tell them apart. Our story on POCSO's offender table covers why "stranger danger" fails children; here, the point is that in national data, teenage relationships, consensual or abusive, appear only as police cases.

## Dating violence is more than rape: what surveys add

Surveys catch some of what police miss. In the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21), never-married women who reported sexual violence named a current or former boyfriend in 16% of cases, and a stranger in only 5% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The base was small, so read the shares loosely.

But the survey's best-known partner-violence figure is about marriage: 31.9% of ever-married women have faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from a husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. That number says nothing about an unmarried 19-year-old whose boyfriend reads her messages, decides whom she meets and threatens to leak her photos.

Global estimates show the scale of that blind spot. WHO estimates that 23.3% of ever-married or partnered girls aged 15 to 19 worldwide have already faced physical or sexual violence from a partner [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Its earlier 2018 estimates, not directly comparable, found that 1 in 4 young women aged 15 to 24 who had been in a relationship had faced partner violence by their mid-twenties [[who-vaw-estimates-2021]]. Most of it is never reported: in NFHS-5, 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## What a dating-violence policy would look like

**Count it.** NCRB could split the 13,879 box into boyfriends, online contacts, live-in partners and separated husbands, and record the relationship for stalking, threats, cyber crimes and hurt. The next NFHS could ask never-married young adults about control and emotional abuse.

**Teach it.** In September 2024 the Supreme Court recommended comprehensive sex education that gives young people a clear understanding of consent [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]]. After a 2007 backlash, somewhere between six and 12 states banned or refused to run India's school Adolescence Education Programme, depending on whose count you use [[reprodhealth-plesons-jharkhand-cse-2020]]. A channel exists: under the School Health and Wellness Programme, whose curriculum was launched in February 2020, two teachers in every government and government-aided school are to be trained to teach health themes, including interpersonal relationships, for an hour a week [[pib-school-health-ambassador-curriculum-2020]]. The warning signs of a controlling relationship belong in that hour.

**Name it in law.** The Domestic Violence Act, 2005 is mainly a civil law, offering protection, residence and maintenance orders, and it was written for abuse at home [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. A young woman stalked by a boyfriend she has never lived with is likely to have to rely on the criminal law. Young men and queer adults have less still: under the BNS, rape, stalking and sexual harassment are offences only by a man against a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Until then, help exists. 926 One Stop Centres (Sakhi) were open across India in March 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]], and online abuse can be reported at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. This is general information, not legal advice.
dating-violence-friends-partners-ncrb-da.hg:
2024 mein India mein police ne rape ke 13,879 aise cases register kiye jinme accused "friend, online friend ya pretext of marriage pe live-in partner" tha, ya alag reh raha pati [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ki offender table mein known accused ka yeh sabse bada group hai, family friends, padosi, employers aur doosre jaan-pehchaan walon (12,584) aur family members (2,134) dono se aage.

Duniya ke kai desh ise dating violence kehte hain: boyfriend, girlfriend ya aise partner ka abuse jisse shaadi nahi hui, stalking aur dhamkiyon se lekar maar-peet aur rape tak. India ke crime records mein iske liye koi alag head nahi hai, national family health survey partner violence ko zyada tar patiyon ke context mein naapta hai, aur jo school sex education iske warning signs sikha sakti thi, use kai states mein ban kiya gaya. Chalo dekhte hain ki numbers kya dikhate hain, kya ek saath mila dete hain, aur policy mein kya chahiye.

## NCRB ki table ka sabse bada box

2024 mein rape ke 29,536 cases register hue. Inme se 28,597 (96.8%) mein accused koi aisa tha jise survivor pehle se jaanti thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Poori offender table ka har group hamare ek doosre article mein khola gaya hai; yeh story sirf sabse bade box pe ruki hai.

Survivors zyada tar young thi. Rape head mein darj 29,742 victims mein se 19,489 ki umar 18 se 30 saal thi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Lekin NCRB victims ko umar se aur cases ko rishte se, alag-alag tables mein ginta hai, isliye koi nahi bata sakta ki 13,879 mein se kitne cases young couples ke the. System yeh dekhne ke liye bana hi nahi hai.

## 'Friend, online friend ya partner' ke peeche kya chhupa hai

Is box mein kam se kam chaar alag rishte hain: boyfriend, Instagram pe mila koi aadmi, shaadi ka vaada karke saath rehne wala live-in partner, aur alag reh raha pati. NCRB inhe alag nahi kar sakta, isliye shaadi ke vaade wale cases iske andar dikhte hi nahi [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. July 2024 se dhokhe se ya shaadi ka jhootha vaada karke bana sexual relation, agar rape ki category mein na aaye, toh ek alag offence hai: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 69, jisme 10 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Pehle chhe mahine mein iske 1,325 cases darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ginti ke rules aur bhi chhupa dete hain. NCRB har FIR ko sirf ek baar ginta hai, uske sabse serious offence ke naam pe [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Agar kisi partner ne pehle stalking ki, dhamkaya aur phir rape kiya, toh record se stalking aur dhamkiyan gayab ho jaati hain.

Rape se kam wali partner violence pe toh rishte ka koi tag hi nahi hota. 2024 mein police ne stalking ke 9,865 cases darj kiye, aur NCRB ki cyber crime tables alag se women ke against cyber stalking ya bullying ke 1,224 cases aur cyber blackmail ya dhamki ke 370 cases dikhati hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In counts ke saath rishte ka koi tag nahi hai, isliye koi nahi bata sakta ki inme se kitne accused boyfriend ya ex the.

## Usi box mein teenagers bhi: POCSO ke 22,308

Bachchon ke sexual abuse ke data mein bhi yahi category sabse aage hai. 2024 mein POCSO Act ke under penetrative sexual assault ke 44,126 cases mein se 22,308 (50.6%) mein accused dost, online dost ya "pretext of marriage" pe live-in partner tha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Family members 3,658 cases mein accused the, aur unknown accused sirf 1,492 mein.

18 se kam umar ke kisi ke saath bhi sexual activity offence hai, "consent" ho ya na ho; jis umar se kam pe ladki ka consent nahi maana jaata, use 2013 mein 16 se badha ke 18 kiya gaya tha [[prs-madhavan-sexual-offences-2013]]. Isliye 22,308 mein bahut alag tarah ke cases mile hue hain: koi adult jisne online 14 saal ke bachche ko groom kiya, koi teenage boyfriend jisne zabardasti ki, aur teenagers ke aapas ke romantic rishte, jinhe POCSO 18 se kam umar mein offence maanta hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Data inme farak nahi kar paata. "Stranger danger" wali seekh bachchon ke kaam kyun nahi aati, yeh POCSO ki offender table pe hamari story mein hai; yahan point yeh hai ki national data mein teenage rishte, consensual hon ya abusive, sirf police cases ke roop mein dikhte hain.

## Dating violence sirf rape nahi: surveys kya batate hain

Jo police tak nahi pahunchta, uska kuch hissa surveys pakad lete hain. National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) mein jin women ki kabhi shaadi nahi hui aur jinhone sexual violence report ki, unme se 16% ne current ya ex-boyfriend ka naam liya, aur stranger ka sirf 5% ne [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh group chhota tha, isliye in numbers ko rough andaaza maano.

Lekin is survey ka sabse jaana-maana partner-violence number shaadi ke baare mein hai: 31.9% ever-married women pati ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jhel chuki hain [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh number us 19 saal ki unmarried ladki ke baare mein kuch nahi batata jiska boyfriend uske messages padhta hai, decide karta hai ki woh kisse mile, aur uski photos leak karne ki dhamki deta hai.

Global estimates dikhate hain ki yeh blind spot kitna bada hai. WHO ka estimate hai ki duniya bhar mein 15 se 19 saal ki married ya partnered ladkiyon mein se 23.3% partner ki physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki hain [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Uske 2018 ke purane estimates, jinse seedha comparison nahi ho sakta, batate the ki 15 se 24 saal ki jo young women kisi relationship mein rahi, unme se har 4 mein se 1 mid-twenties tak partner ki violence jhel chuki thi [[who-vaw-estimates-2021]]. Zyada tar violence kabhi report hi nahi hoti: NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77% women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Dating violence pe policy kaisi honi chahiye

**Gino.** NCRB 13,879 wale box ko boyfriends, online contacts, live-in partners aur alag reh rahe patiyon mein baant sakta hai, aur stalking, dhamki, cyber crime aur maar-peet ke cases mein bhi rishta record kar sakta hai. Agla NFHS unmarried young adults se bhi control aur emotional abuse ke baare mein pooch sakta hai.

**Padhao.** September 2024 mein Supreme Court ne recommend kiya ki young logon ko comprehensive sex education mile, jisse unhe consent ki saaf samajh ho [[sc-just-rights-for-children-alliance-2024]]. 2007 ke backlash ke baad, alag-alag counts ke hisaab se 6 se 12 states ne India ka school Adolescence Education Programme ban kiya ya chalane se mana kar diya [[reprodhealth-plesons-jharkhand-cse-2020]]. Ek raasta pehle se hai: School Health and Wellness Programme, jiska curriculum February 2020 mein launch hua, ke under har government aur government-aided school mein do teachers ko training milni hai, taaki woh hafte mein ek ghanta health themes padhayein, jinme interpersonal relationships bhi shaamil hain [[pib-school-health-ambassador-curriculum-2020]]. Controlling relationship ke warning signs usi ek ghante mein padhaye jaane chahiye.

**Law mein naam do.** Domestic Violence Act, 2005 zyada tar ek civil law hai, jo protection, residence aur maintenance orders deta hai, aur yeh ghar ke andar ke abuse ke liye likha gaya tha [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Jis young woman ka peecha aisa boyfriend kare jiske saath woh kabhi nahi rahi, use shayad criminal law ka hi sahara lena padega. Young ladkon aur queer adults ke paas isse bhi kam hai: BNS mein rape, stalking aur sexual harassment sirf tab offence hain jab koi aadmi kisi woman ke saath kare [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Tab tak help maujood hai. March 2026 tak poore India mein 926 One Stop Centres (Sakhi) khule the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]], aur online abuse ki complaint cybercrime.gov.in pe ya 1930 pe ki ja sakti hai [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

emotional-abuse-myths-young-relationship.en:
Consider a 22-year-old in Pune. Her partner has never raised a hand. He reads her messages, calls her friends "cheap", mocks her weight in front of others and says he will hurt himself if she ever leaves. When she finally tells a cousin, the reply comes fast: "At least he doesn't hit you."

That reply is the first myth, and it is everywhere. India's National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) counts emotional violence alongside physical and sexual violence, and finds that 31.9% of ever-married women have faced at least one of them from a husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. WHO's global estimate, that 25.8% of ever-married or partnered women aged 15-49 have faced partner violence, counts only physical and sexual violence; psychological abuse and controlling behaviour are not part of that indicator [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. The abuse that leaves no mark is the abuse counted least. Here are five myths that keep it hidden.

## Myth 1: "If there are no bruises, it is not abuse"

**Truth:** Abuse is a pattern of power. Insults, humiliation, threats, isolation and control can leave a person frightened and shrinking without a single bruise.

Indian law already looks beyond bruises. The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 is mainly a civil law, offering protection, residence and maintenance orders, and its idea of domestic violence is not limited to physical harm: it counts as sexual abuse, for example, any sexual conduct that humiliates, degrades or violates a woman's dignity [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Under Sections 85 and 86 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), cruelty by a husband or his relatives includes wilful conduct likely to drive a woman to suicide or cause her grave injury, punishable with up to 3 years in prison [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Neither law asks for a bruise. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Myth 2: "Jealousy proves love"

**Truth:** Jealousy is a feeling. What someone does with it is a choice. Demanding passwords and live location, reading messages, accusing you of cheating and cutting you off from friends do not measure love. They measure control.

Some of it is a crime. When a man keeps following or contacting a woman despite her clear lack of interest, it can be stalking under Section 78 of the BNS, with up to 3 years in prison for a first conviction and up to 5 for a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 9,865 stalking cases in 2024, and NCRB does not record how many involved a partner [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Our 12-question relationship self-check lists the everyday signs.

## Myth 3: "'I'll hurt myself if you leave' shows how much they care"

**Truth:** A threat of self-harm used to stop someone from leaving makes them responsible for another person's life so that they stay. That is coercion, even when the distress behind it is real. Both can be true, and neither means you must stay.

Take the threat seriously without carrying it alone. If someone is in immediate danger, call 112 [[mha-erss]]. Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock mental health helpline on 14416, offers counselling to anyone, including the person who is worried [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Fear of the police should not stop that call: the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 presumes that a person who attempts suicide is under severe stress, bars punishing them and obliges the government to provide care [[indiacode-mhca-2017]], and the BNS has no general offence of attempted suicide [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myths 4 and 5: "Every couple has rough patches" and "I'm only being honest"

**Truth:** Every couple argues. Not every couple is afraid. The test is fear: does one person plan their words, clothes and friendships around the other's temper? In NFHS-5, 59% of women who were afraid of their husband most of the time had faced spousal violence, against 15% of women who were never afraid [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Fear and violence travel together. A rough patch passes; a pattern of fear settles in.

"I'm only being honest" is the usual cover for constant criticism. Honest feedback is occasional and specific, and it leaves you free to disagree. Contempt is relentless: your body, your mind, your family, your friends, often in front of others, followed by "can't you take a joke?" Over time it can make a person doubt their own memory and judgement, which is what people mean by gaslighting.

## Why the numbers miss it, and where to get help

The data misses emotional abuse three times over. WHO's global indicator leaves it out [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. NFHS-5's emotional-violence figures are about husbands, so a controlling boyfriend is invisible in them [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. And WHO notes that short violence modules inside broader health surveys, the kind NFHS uses, draw less disclosure than dedicated surveys [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Most women never tell: in NFHS-5, 77% of women who had faced physical or sexual violence had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

The cost is not small. Partner violence is the fourth leading cause of poor health among women worldwide, measured in disability-adjusted life years, according to estimates cited by WHO [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. Police registered 1,20,227 cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives in 2024, the largest category of crimes against women [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and dating partners have no equivalent offence. Our explainer on NFHS-5's one-in-three figure shows how far survey and police numbers drift apart.

If this sounds like your relationship, start small. Tell one person you trust. Keep a private record of incidents, with dates and screenshots, somewhere your partner cannot reach. Call Tele-MANAS on 14416 to talk it through, or walk into one of the 926 One Stop Centres (Sakhi) open across India in March 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]]. If you are the friend being told, do not say "at least he doesn't hit you". Say "I believe you".
emotional-abuse-myths-young-relationship.hg:
Socho, Pune mein ek 22 saal ki ladki hai. Uske partner ne kabhi haath nahi uthaya. Lekin woh uske messages padhta hai, uski saheliyon ko "cheap" bolta hai, sabke saamne uske weight ka mazaak udaata hai, aur kehta hai ki agar woh chhod ke gayi toh woh khud ko hurt kar lega. Jab woh aakhirkaar apni cousin ko batati hai, toh turant jawaab aata hai: "Kam se kam maarta toh nahi."

Yahi jawaab pehla myth hai, aur yeh har jagah sunai deta hai. National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) physical aur sexual violence ke saath emotional violence ko bhi ginta hai, aur iske hisaab se 31.9% ever-married women ne pati se inme se kam se kam ek tarah ki violence jheli hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. WHO ka global estimate kehta hai ki 15 se 49 saal ki married ya partnered 25.8% women partner violence jhel chuki hain, lekin yeh estimate sirf physical aur sexual violence ginta hai; psychological abuse aur controlling behaviour is indicator mein shaamil hi nahi [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Jo abuse nishaan nahi chhodta, wahi sabse kam gina jaata hai. Yeh rahe paanch myths jo ise chhupaye rakhte hain.

## Myth 1: "Chot ka nishaan nahi, toh abuse nahi"

**Sach:** Abuse power ka ek pattern hai. Insults, humiliation, dhamkiyan, sabse kaat dena aur control, yeh sab bina ek bhi nishaan chhode insaan ko dara hua aur chhota feel kara sakte hain.

Indian law bhi chot ke nishaan se aage dekhta hai. Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 zyada tar ek civil law hai, jo protection, residence aur maintenance orders deta hai, aur iski domestic violence ki samajh sirf physical chot tak seemit nahi: jaise, yeh aise kisi bhi sexual behaviour ko sexual abuse maanta hai jo woman ko humiliate kare, neecha dikhaye ya uski dignity ko thes pahunchaye [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 85 aur 86 ke under pati ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty mein aisa jaan-boojh ke kiya gaya behaviour bhi aata hai jo woman ko suicide ki taraf dhakel de ya use serious nuksaan pahunchaye, aur isme 3 saal tak ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Dono mein se koi bhi law chot ka nishaan nahi maangta. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Myth 2: "Jealousy pyaar ka saboot hai"

**Sach:** Jealousy ek feeling hai. Us feeling ke saath koi kya karta hai, woh uski choice hai. Passwords aur live location maangna, messages padhna, cheating ka ilzaam lagana aur doston se kaat dena pyaar ka measure nahi hai. Yeh control ka measure hai.

Inme se kuch cheezein crime bhi hain. Agar koi aadmi saaf mana hone ke baad bhi kisi woman ka peecha karta rahe ya baar-baar contact kare, toh yeh BNS ke Section 78 ke under stalking ho sakta hai, jisme first conviction pe 3 saal tak aur dobara karne pe 5 saal tak ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 2024 mein police ne stalking ke 9,865 cases darj kiye, aur inme se kitne partner ke against the, yeh NCRB record nahi karta [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Roz ke signs hamare 12 sawaalon wale relationship self-check mein diye gaye hain.

## Myth 3: "'Chhoda toh khud ko hurt kar lunga' ka matlab hai bahut pyaar"

**Sach:** Chhod ke jaane se rokne ke liye self-harm ki dhamki saamne wale ko kisi aur ki jaan ka zimmedaar bana deti hai, taaki woh ruka rahe. Yeh coercion hai, chahe uske peeche ka dard sachcha ho. Dono baatein ek saath sach ho sakti hain, aur dono mein se kisi ka matlab yeh nahi ki tumhe rukna hi padega.

Dhamki ko seriously lo, par uska bojh akele mat uthao. Agar kisi ki jaan ko turant khatra ho, toh 112 pe call karo [[mha-erss]]. Tele-MANAS 14416 Health Ministry ki free, 24x7 mental health helpline hai, aur yahan koi bhi baat kar sakta hai, woh bhi jo kisi aur ke liye pareshaan hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Police ke darr se yeh call mat roko: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 maanta hai ki suicide attempt karne wala insaan severe stress mein hota hai, use saza dene se rokta hai aur government pe uski care ki zimmedari daalta hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]], aur BNS mein suicide attempt ab general offence nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

## Myth 4 aur 5: "Har couple mein bura phase aata hai" aur "Main toh bas honest hoon"

**Sach:** Har couple mein behas hoti hai. Lekin har couple mein koi ek doosre se darta nahi hai. Asli test darr hai: kya ek insaan apne words, kapde aur dostiyan doosre ke gusse ko dekh ke decide karta hai? NFHS-5 mein jo women zyada tar time apne pati se darti thi, unme se 59% spousal violence jhel chuki thi, jabki kabhi na darne wali women mein yeh 15% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Darr aur violence saath-saath chalte hain. Bura phase guzar jaata hai; darr ka pattern jam jaata hai.

"Main toh bas honest hoon" aksar lagataar criticism ka bahana hota hai. Honest feedback kabhi-kabhaar hota hai, kisi khaas baat pe hota hai, aur tumhe disagree karne ki chhoot deta hai. Contempt lagataar chalta hai: tumhari body, tumhari samajh, tumhari family, tumhare dost, aksar doosron ke saamne, aur phir "joke bhi nahi samajhti?" Dheere-dheere insaan apni yaaddasht aur judgement pe hi shak karne lagta hai. Isi ko gaslighting kehte hain.

## Numbers ise kyun miss karte hain, aur help kahan milegi

Data emotional abuse ko teen tarah se miss karta hai. Pehla, WHO ka global indicator ise ginta hi nahi [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Doosra, NFHS-5 ke emotional violence ke figures patiyon ke baare mein hain, isliye controlling boyfriend inme dikhta hi nahi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Teesra, WHO kehta hai ki jab violence ke sawaal kisi bade health survey ka chhota sa hissa hote hain, jaisa NFHS mein hai, toh log kam khul ke batate hain; sirf violence pe kiye gaye surveys mein zyada baatein saamne aati hain [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Zyada tar women kisi ko batati hi nahi: NFHS-5 mein physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77% women ne na kabhi help maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Iski keemat chhoti nahi hai. WHO ke quote kiye gaye estimates ke hisaab se duniya bhar mein women ki kharab health ki chauthi sabse badi wajah partner violence hai, jise disability-adjusted life years (DALY) mein naapa jaata hai [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. 2024 mein police ne pati ya uske rishtedaaron ki cruelty ke 1,20,227 cases darj kiye, jo women ke against crimes ki sabse badi category hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]], lekin dating partners ke liye aisa koi offence hai hi nahi. Survey aur police ke numbers mein kitna gap hai, yeh NFHS-5 ke "har teen mein se ek" wale figure pe hamare explainer mein hai.

Agar yeh tumhare rishte jaisa lagta hai, toh chhote step se shuru karo. Kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko batao. Har incident ko date aur screenshots ke saath aisi jagah likh ke rakho jahan partner na pahunch sake. Baat karne ke liye Tele-MANAS ko 14416 pe call karo, ya March 2026 tak poore India mein khule 926 One Stop Centres (Sakhi) mein se kisi mein jao [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-03]]. Aur agar tumhari koi dost tumhe yeh sab bataye, toh mat bolo "kam se kam maarta toh nahi". Bolo, "Mujhe tumhari baat pe yakeen hai."

fathers-chores-gender-equal-sons.en:
Ask an Indian parent where a boy learns how to treat women and you will hear about friends, films and phones. A survey of 9,205 men in seven Indian states points somewhere closer: the house he grew up in. Men whose fathers had done household chores were two times more likely to hold gender-equitable attitudes, and men who had frequently faced discrimination as children were four times more likely to be violent to a partner [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Boys are rarely taught masculinity in words. They work it out by watching who gets up to make the tea.

## What 9,205 men told researchers about their childhoods

The study, published in 2014 by the International Center for Research on Women (ICRW) and UNFPA, surveyed 9,205 men and 3,158 women aged 18 to 49 in Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

The adult picture was bleak: 60% of the men said they had at some point acted violently against a wife or partner, counting emotional and economic violence, and 52% of the women had experienced some form of violence [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Read the childhood findings with care. This is seven states, not the country, and men were recalling their own childhoods. A survey like this shows what goes together, not what causes what. But every finding points the same way, and the National Family Health Survey shows the same inheritance from the women's side.

## Chores, decisions and the father effect

Two things in a boy's home went with a more equal man, and one with a more violent one [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

| What he grew up with | What the survey found in the man |
|---|---|
| A father who did household chores | 2 times more likely to be gender-equitable |
| Parents who made decisions jointly | 1.4 times more likely to be gender-equitable |
| Frequent discrimination as a child | 4 times more likely to be violent to a partner |

Neither of the first two involves a speech about respecting women. Imagine a ten-year-old in Kanpur on a Sunday morning. His mother has been in the kitchen since six. His father asks for tea from the sofa, and the boy's sister is sent to fetch it. Nobody has told him that housework is women's work, or that his time matters more than hers. Nobody needed to.

Now change one detail. The father is rolling the rotis, and the parents settle the school-fee question together at the table. The boy has still been told nothing. He has learned something else.

Chores are rarely the only difference between such homes, and a survey cannot untangle them all. But one figure suggests which Sunday most boys watch: 66% of the men said they had more say than their partner on important decisions [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

## How violence passes down: the 58% finding

The National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) shows how harm is inherited. Among women whose fathers beat their mothers, 58% had faced violence from their own husbands. Among women whose fathers did not, the figure was 25% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

That is not a flaw in those women. A girl in that house is handed a definition of normal: this is what a wife is expected to bear. This NFHS figure is about women, so it measures the daughters. Her brother grew up in the same house, watching the same thing.

> A boy is not told what a husband is allowed to do. He is shown.

The men's side is the table's last row: frequent discrimination as a boy, four times the likelihood of violence against a partner as a man [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

None of this is destiny. Many women who grew up with violence do not face it in marriage, and a boy who was humiliated need not repeat it as a man. A hard childhood explains a pattern. It does not excuse an adult's choice.

## Rigid, moderate, equitable: where Indian men sit

The researchers sorted men into three groups by their attitudes and behaviour on gender. They classed 32% as "rigid". Another 45% were moderate. Only 23% were gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

The middle group is the largest and the easiest to hide in. Picture the father who would never raise his hand and is proud of his daughter's marks, but has not washed a plate in years. His son is watching that too.

Women carry the script too: 76% of men and 81% of women in the survey said it was very important to have at least one son [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. A boy prized for being a boy, and excused from the chores his sister does, learns his rank early.

Time alone is not fixing this. In NFHS-5, 44% of men said a husband is justified in beating his wife in at least one of seven situations, up from 42% in 2015-16, while agreement among women fell from 52% to 45% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## What parents can model, starting this week

The lever is ordinary and already in your hands.

- **Fathers, own a chore.** One daily job that is yours, not "helping", done where the children can see.
- **Decide together, out loud.** Let children hear their mother's view carry weight on money and school.
- **Same rules for sons and daughters:** chores, curfews, food, fees and praise.
- **No hitting, no humiliation,** of their mother or of them. If it has happened, say in front of them that it was wrong.
- **No father at home?** The study asked about fathers, but an uncle, grandfather or older brother at the sink teaches the same thing.

If you are the child in a house where your father hits your mother, it is not your fault and not your job to stop it alone. If you are under 18, call Child Helpline 1098, which is linked to the emergency number 112 [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

If you are a young man who grew up with the first kind of Sunday, you were shown one way to be a man, not the only one. What your own children watch will be up to you.
fathers-chores-gender-equal-sons.hg:
Kisi Indian parent se poochhiye ki ladka auraton ke saath pesh aana kahan seekhta hai, toh jawab milega: dost, filmein aur phone. Saat Indian states ke 9,205 aadmiyon ka ek survey kahin zyada paas ki jagah dikhata hai: woh ghar jisme woh bada hua. Jin aadmiyon ke pita ghar ka kaam karte the, unme gender-equitable soch hone ke chances do guna the, aur jin aadmiyon ne bachpan mein aksar bhed-bhaav jhela tha, unke partner ke saath violence karne ke chances chaar guna the [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Ladkon ko mardangi shabdon mein kam hi sikhayi jaati hai. Woh yeh dekhkar khud samajh lete hain ki chai banane kaun uthta hai.

## 9,205 aadmiyon ne researchers ko apne bachpan ke baare mein kya bataya

Yeh study 2014 mein International Center for Research on Women (ICRW) aur UNFPA ne publish ki thi. Isme Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, Punjab, Haryana, Odisha, Madhya Pradesh aur Maharashtra ke 18 se 49 saal ke 9,205 aadmiyon aur 3,158 auraton ka survey hua [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Bade hone ke baad ki tasveer kadwi thi: 60% aadmiyon ne maana ki unhone kabhi na kabhi patni ya partner ke saath violence ki thi, jisme emotional aur economic violence bhi gini gayi, aur 52% auraton ne kisi na kisi tarah ki violence jheli thi [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Bachpan wali findings ko dhyan se padhiye. Yeh saat states ka survey hai, poore desh ka nahi, aur aadmi apna bachpan yaad karke bata rahe the. Aisa survey yeh dikhata hai ki kaun si cheezein saath-saath chalti hain, yeh nahi ki kaun kiski wajah hai. Phir bhi har finding ek hi disha mein ishaara karti hai, aur National Family Health Survey wahi virasat auraton ki taraf se dikhata hai.

## Ghar ka kaam, faisle aur 'father effect'

Ladke ke ghar ki do cheezein zyada barabari maanne wale aadmi ke saath judi milin, aur ek cheez zyada violent aadmi ke saath [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

| Bachpan mein ghar par kya tha | Survey ne bade hue aadmi mein kya paaya |
|---|---|
| Pita ghar ka kaam karte the | Gender-equitable hone ke chances 2 guna |
| Maa-baap milkar faisle lete the | Gender-equitable hone ke chances 1.4 guna |
| Bachpan mein aksar bhed-bhaav jhela | Partner ke saath violence ke chances 4 guna |

Pehli do cheezon mein "auraton ki izzat karo" wala koi bhashan nahi hai. Sochiye, Kanpur mein ek das saal ka ladka hai, Sunday ki subah. Uski maa chhe baje se kitchen mein hai. Papa sofe par baithe chai maangte hain, aur chai laane ladke ki behen ko bheja jaata hai. Kisi ne use nahi bataya ki ghar ka kaam auraton ka kaam hai, ya uska time uski behen ke time se zyada keemti hai. Batane ki zaroorat hi nahi padi.

Ab bas ek cheez badal dijiye. Papa rotiyan bel rahe hain, aur school ki fees ka faisla maa-baap table par saath baithkar kar rahe hain. Ladke ko ab bhi kuch bataya nahi gaya. Par usne kuch aur seekh liya hai.

Aise gharon mein fark aksar sirf ghar ke kaam ka nahi hota, aur ek survey un sab ko alag-alag nahi kar sakta. Par ek figure batata hai ki zyada tar ladke kaun sa Sunday dekhte hain: 66% aadmiyon ne kaha ki zaroori faislon mein unki baat partner se zyada chalti hai [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

## Violence agli peedhi tak kaise pahunchti hai: 58% wali finding

National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) dikhata hai ki nuksaan bhi virasat mein milta hai. Jin auraton ke pita unki maa ko maarte the, unme se 58% ne apne pati ki violence jheli thi. Jin auraton ke pita aisa nahi karte the, unme yeh 25% tha [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Yeh un auraton ki koi kami nahi hai. Us ghar ki ladki ko 'normal' ki ek definition thama di jaati hai: patni se yahi sehne ki ummeed hoti hai. NFHS ka yeh figure auraton ke baare mein hai, isliye yeh betiyon ko naapta hai. Uska bhai bhi usi ghar mein bada hua, wahi sab dekhte hue.

> Ladke ko bataya nahi jaata ki pati ko kya-kya karne ki chhoot hai. Use dikhaya jaata hai.

Aadmiyon wala pehlu table ki aakhri line mein hai: bachpan mein aksar bhed-bhaav, aur bade hokar partner ke saath violence ke chaar guna chances [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Isme se kuch bhi kismat nahi hai. Violence ke beech badi hui bahut si auratein apni shaadi mein violence nahi jheltin, aur jis ladke ko zaleel kiya gaya, uske liye bada hokar wahi dohrana zaroori nahi. Mushkil bachpan ek pattern ko samjhata hai. Woh kisi adult ki choice ka bahaana nahi banta.

## Rigid, moderate, equitable: Indian aadmi kahan khade hain

Researchers ne aadmiyon ko gender ke baare mein unki soch aur bartaav ke hisaab se teen groups mein baanta. 32% ko "rigid" maana gaya. 45% moderate the. Sirf 23% gender-equitable nikle [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Beech wala group sabse bada hai, aur usme chhupna sabse aasaan hai. Us pita ko sochiye jo kabhi haath nahi uthayega aur beti ke marks par garv karta hai, par jisne barson se ek plate nahi dhoyi. Uska beta yeh bhi dekh raha hai.

Yeh script auratein bhi dhoti hain: survey mein 76% aadmiyon aur 81% auraton ne kaha ki kam se kam ek beta hona bahut zaroori hai [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Jis ladke ko sirf ladka hone ki wajah se sar-aankhon par rakha jaata hai, aur un kaamon se chhoot milti hai jo uski behen karti hai, woh apna 'darja' jaldi seekh leta hai.

Sirf waqt guzarne se yeh theek nahi ho raha. NFHS-5 mein 44% aadmiyon ne kaha ki saat mein se kam se kam ek situation mein pati ka patni ko maarna sahi hai, jo 2015-16 mein 42% tha, jab ki auraton mein yeh sahmati 52% se ghatkar 45% ho gayi [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Parents kya karke dikha sakte hain, isi hafte se

Tareeka maamooli hai aur pehle se aapke haath mein hai.

- **Fathers, ek kaam apna banaiye.** Roz ka ek kaam jo aapka ho, "help" nahi, aur wahan kiya jaaye jahan bachche dekh sakein.
- **Faisle saath mein, sabke saamne lijiye.** Bachche sunein ki paise aur school ke maamlon mein unki maa ki raay ka wazan hai.
- **Beton aur betiyon ke liye ek jaise rules:** ghar ka kaam, ghar lautne ka time, khana, fees aur tareef.
- **Na maar, na zillat,** na unki maa ki, na unki. Agar aisa hua hai, toh unke saamne kahiye ki woh galat tha.
- **Ghar mein pita nahi hain?** Study ne pita ke baare mein poochha tha, par sink par khade chacha, dada ya bade bhaiya bhi wahi sabak dete hain.

Agar aap us ghar ke bachche hain jahan papa mummy ko maarte hain, toh yeh aapki galti nahi hai, aur ise akele rokna aapka kaam nahi hai. Agar aap 18 se kam ke hain, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, jo emergency number 112 se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

Agar aap ek young aadmi hain jo pehle wale Sunday ke saath bade hue, toh aapko mard hone ka ek tareeka dikhaya gaya tha, iklauta tareeka nahi. Aapke apne bachche kya dekhenge, yeh aap tay karenge.

handling-rejection-without-harassment-gu.en:
Imagine a 20-year-old in Indore. He has liked a classmate for a year. He finally tells her, and she says no, kindly and clearly. By midnight he has typed and deleted a dozen messages. His friends have one piece of advice: girls always say no the first time, keep at it.

What he does in the next two weeks matters more than the year before it. Police registered 9,865 stalking cases in India in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], and those are only the ones that reached an FIR. This guide is for the person who was turned down. It is general information, not legal advice.

## Rejection hurts: what is normal to feel

Hurt, embarrassment, anger, replaying the conversation, not wanting to eat, checking her profile again and again: all of this is ordinary. None of it means you are weak, or that you were wronged.

Say accurately what happened. You asked a question. She answered it. Her no tells you what she wants. It is not a verdict on your worth, and it is not an insult that needs a reply. She does not owe you a reason, a second conversation or a friendship to make you feel better.

Feelings are not the problem. The problem starts when feelings are handed to her to manage.

## Why 'try harder' is not romance

Many films tell some version of the same story: he follows her, she refuses, he keeps going, she gives in. Friends repeat it, and add a second lesson: a man who accepts a no has lost face.

That idea of manhood is common. In a 2014 survey of men in seven Indian states, 32% were classed as holding "rigid" ideas of masculinity, and only 23% as gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. If your friends are pushing you to keep trying, they may be repeating a script, not giving you advice.

Look at it from her side. After the second, fifth and tenth attempt she is no longer deciding whether she likes you. She is deciding which route to take to college, whether to tell her parents and risk losing her phone or her freedom to go out, and whether you are dangerous. A yes that comes after that is not a yes. It is tiredness or fear.

## The line you must not cross: following, messaging, turning up

In broad terms, Section 78 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita treats it as stalking when a man keeps following a woman, or keeps contacting her or trying to, after she has clearly shown she is not interested. Keeping watch on her internet, email or other electronic communication can count too. The punishment is up to 3 years in prison on a first conviction and up to 5 years on a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

In ordinary life that covers things many men think are harmless:

- waiting outside her class, hostel, office or bus stop "by chance";
- messaging from a new number or account after she has blocked you;
- sending friends, or her friends, to "convince" her;
- sending gifts or turning up at her home.

Threats and "revenge" are separate crimes. In 2024 police recorded 1,224 cases of cyber stalking or bullying of women, 370 of cyber blackmail or threats, 293 of defamation or morphing and 114 of fake profiles [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Spreading stories about her "character" in a group chat belongs on the same list.

Courts convicted in 25.2% of the stalking trials they completed in 2024, and 52,273 stalking cases were still pending at the end of the year [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Read that from her side: she reported it and is still waiting. Read it from yours: a criminal case can sit on your life for years, whatever its ending.

At the far end, police recorded "love affairs" as the motive in 1,391 murders in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The label is broad: it does not separate a man who killed a woman for refusing him from a family that killed a couple, and NCRB does not say how many began with a no.

Section 78 is written for a man pursuing a woman, but the rule here is for everyone: a woman who will not stop messaging an ex, or a man who keeps turning up at another man's hostel, causes the same fear.

## What to do with anger and humiliation

- **Reply once, or not at all.** "Okay. Thank you for telling me." Then stop.
- **Mute and unfollow.** This is for you. Every time you check her profile you restart the hurt.
- **Do not stay "friends" as a strategy.** If you are waiting for her to change her mind, it is not friendship.
- **Tell one person the truth:** "I was rejected and I am taking it badly." Choose someone who will not say "keep trying".
- **Look after the basics.** Sleep, food, exercise, your work. The sharpest part of this does pass.

If friends mock you for backing off, that is about them. Accepting a no is the harder thing, and the decent one.

## When to talk to someone, and who

Get help if you notice any of these: you cannot stop checking where she is; you are planning to "bump into" her; you imagine punishing her; you have not slept or eaten properly for days; or you are thinking of hurting yourself.

Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's helpline on 14416, is free, open round the clock and offers counselling to anyone in need [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. A college counsellor, a teacher or an older sibling are also good places to start. If you think you might hurt yourself or someone else right now, call 112.

Telling her "I will harm myself if you don't reply" is not love. It is pressure on her, and a sign that you need support today. Say that sentence to a counsellor, not to her.

If you have already crossed the line, stop today. Do not send a long apology; one more unwanted message is still an unwanted message. The apology is the silence.
handling-rejection-without-harassment-gu.hg:
Socho, Indore ka ek 20 saal ka ladka. Ek saal se use apni ek classmate pasand hai. Aakhir woh use bata deta hai, aur woh na keh deti hai, pyaar se aur saaf-saaf. Aadhi raat tak woh darjan bhar messages type karke delete kar chuka hai. Doston ke paas ek hi salaah hai: ladkiyan pehli baar hamesha na hi bolti hain, lage raho.

Agle do hafton mein woh jo karega, woh pichhle ek saal se zyada maayne rakhta hai. 2024 mein India mein police ne stalking ke 9,865 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur yeh sirf woh hain jo FIR tak pahunche. Yeh guide us insaan ke liye hai jise na sunni padi. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Rejection dukhta hai: kya feel karna normal hai

Dard, sharmindagi, gussa, us baat-cheet ko baar-baar dimaag mein chalana, khaane ka mann na hona, uski profile baar-baar check karna: yeh sab aam hai. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum kamzor ho, ya tumhare saath kuch galat hua hai.

Jo hua, use sahi shabdon mein kaho. Tumne ek sawaal poocha. Usne jawab de diya. Uski na batati hai ki woh kya chahti hai. Yeh tumhari value par koi faisla nahi hai, aur yeh koi beizzati bhi nahi hai jiska jawab dena zaroori ho. Woh tumhe na koi wajah dene ki zimmedaar hai, na doosri baat-cheet ki, na tumhe achha feel karwane ke liye dosti ki.

Feelings problem nahi hain. Problem tab shuru hoti hai jab un feelings ko sambhalne ka bojh us par daal diya jaata hai.

## 'Aur koshish karo' romance kyun nahi hai

Bahut si films kisi na kisi roop mein ek hi kahani sunati hain: woh uska peechha karta hai, woh mana karti hai, woh lagaa rehta hai, woh maan jaati hai. Dost yahi dohraate hain, aur ek doosra sabak jod dete hain: jo mard na maan leta hai, uski naak kat gayi.

Mardaangi ki yeh soch aam hai. 2014 mein saat Indian states ke mardon ke ek survey mein 32% ko masculinity ke "rigid" ideas wala maana gaya, aur sirf 23% ko gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Agar tumhare dost tumhe lage rehne ko keh rahe hain, toh ho sakta hai woh salaah nahi de rahe, bas ek script dohra rahe hain.

Ise uski taraf se dekho. Doosri, paanchvi aur dasvi koshish ke baad woh yeh tay nahi kar rahi hoti ki tum use pasand ho ya nahi. Woh yeh tay kar rahi hoti hai ki college kis raaste se jaaye, parents ko bataye ya nahi, kyunki batane par phone ya bahar aane-jaane ki azaadi chhin sakti hai, aur yeh ki tum khatarnaak ho ya nahi. Uske baad jo haan aati hai, woh haan nahi hoti. Woh thakaan hoti hai, ya darr.

## Woh line jo tumhe paar nahi karni: peechha karna, message karna, pahunch jaana

Moti baat yeh hai ki Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ki Section 78 ise stalking maanti hai jab koi mard kisi aurat ka peechha karta rahe, ya use baar-baar contact kare ya karne ki koshish kare, jabki woh saaf dikha chuki ho ki use interest nahi hai. Uske internet, email ya kisi aur electronic communication par nazar rakhna bhi isme aa sakta hai. Saza: pehli conviction par 3 saal tak ki jail, aur dobara conviction par 5 saal tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Roz ki zindagi mein isme woh cheezein aati hain jinhe bahut se ladke harmless samajhte hain:

- uski class, hostel, office ya bus stop ke bahar "ittefaq se" intezaar karna;
- block hone ke baad naye number ya naye account se message karna;
- apne doston ko, ya uske doston ko, use "manaane" bhejna;
- gifts bhejna ya uske ghar pahunch jaana.

Dhamkiyan aur "badla" alag crimes hain. 2024 mein police ne auraton ki cyber stalking ya bullying ke 1,224 cases, cyber blackmail ya dhamki ke 370, defamation ya morphing ke 293 aur fake profiles ke 114 cases record kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Group chat mein uske "character" ke baare mein kahaniyan phailana bhi isi list mein aata hai.

2024 mein courts ne stalking ke jitne trials poore kiye, unme se 25.2% mein conviction hui, aur saal ke end tak stalking ke 52,273 cases pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Ise uski taraf se padho: usne report kiya aur woh ab tak intezaar kar rahi hai. Apni taraf se padho: ek criminal case saalon tak tumhari zindagi par baitha reh sakta hai, anjaam chahe jo ho.

Is raaste ke aakhri sire par, police ne 2024 mein 1,391 murders mein motive "love affairs" likha [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh label bahut chauda hai: yeh us mard ko, jisne mana karne par aurat ko maar diya, us family se alag nahi karta jisne ek couple ko maar diya, aur NCRB yeh nahi batata ki inme se kitne ek "na" se shuru hue.

Section 78 aurat ka peechha karne wale mard ke liye likhi gayi hai, lekin yahan ka rule sabke liye hai: jo aurat apne ex ko message karna band nahi karti, ya jo mard kisi doosre mard ke hostel baar-baar pahunch jaata hai, woh bhi wahi darr paida karte hain.

## Gusse aur beizzati ke ehsaas ka kya karein

- **Ek baar reply karo, ya bilkul nahi.** "Theek hai. Batane ke liye thank you." Phir ruk jao.
- **Mute aur unfollow karo.** Yeh tumhare apne liye hai. Har baar jab tum uski profile check karte ho, dard dobara shuru ho jaata hai.
- **Strategy ke taur par "dost" mat bane raho.** Agar tum uske mann badalne ka intezaar kar rahe ho, toh woh dosti nahi hai.
- **Kisi ek insaan ko sach batao:** "Mujhe reject kiya gaya hai aur main ise theek se nahi le pa raha." Aisa insaan chuno jo "lage raho" nahi bolega.
- **Basics ka dhyaan rakho.** Neend, khaana, exercise, apna kaam. Iska sabse tez hissa guzar jaata hai.

Agar dost peechhe hatne par tumhara mazaak udayein, toh yeh unke baare mein batata hai. Na ko maan lena zyada mushkil kaam hai, aur sahi bhi wahi hai.

## Kab kisi se baat karni chahiye, aur kisse

Madad lo agar tum inme se kuch bhi notice karo: tum yeh check karna rok nahi pa rahe ki woh kahan hai; tum usse "achanak takra jaane" ka plan bana rahe ho; tum use saza dene ke baare mein sochte ho; kai dinon se theek se soye ya khaaye nahi ho; ya khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ka khayal aa raha hai.

Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki helpline 14416, free hai, din-raat khuli hai aur har zaroorat-mand ko counselling deti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. College counsellor, teacher ya bada bhai-behen bhi shuru karne ke liye achhi jagah hain. Agar lage ki tum abhi khud ko ya kisi aur ko nuksaan pahuncha sakte ho, toh 112 par call karo.

Use yeh kehna ki "reply nahi kiya toh main khud ko kuch kar lunga" pyaar nahi hai. Yeh us par pressure hai, aur is baat ka sign hai ki tumhe aaj hi support chahiye. Yeh baat counsellor se kaho, usse nahi.

Agar tum line pehle hi paar kar chuke ho, toh aaj hi ruk jao. Lamba apology mat bhejo; ek aur unwanted message bhi unwanted message hi hota hai. Tumhari chuppi hi apology hai.

housewives-suicide-india-ncrb-data.en:
In 2022, 25,309 women recorded by police as housewives died by suicide in India. That was 52.5% of the 48,172 women who died by suicide that year, and 14.8% of all suicides [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. Student suicides, which draw far more headlines, numbered 13,044 in the same year [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. The count for housewives was almost twice that. There is no national conversation about them, perhaps because these deaths happen in the one place India treats as private.

## One suicide in seven: where housewives sit in NCRB's table

The figures come from Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India, the annual report the National Crime Records Bureau compiles from police records. It counted 1,70,924 suicides in 2022 [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. Men were 71.8% of them [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-snapshots]], and that needs its own attention.

Look at how the table sorts people. Among men, the largest group was daily wage earners. Among women, it was housewives [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. Daily wage earners, a mostly male group, accounted for 45,185 deaths, or 26.4% of the total; housewives accounted for about one in seven [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. Men are filed by how they earn. Women are filed by the house they keep.

These are counts, not rates. A very large share of Indian women are recorded as homemakers, so a big count partly reflects a big group. What the table shows is where the largest number of women's deaths are, and so where prevention has to reach.

NCRB's later reports put total suicides at 1,71,418 in 2023 and 1,70,746 in 2024 [[theprint-ncrb-adsi-2024]]. The housewives' count for those years could not be confirmed against a second source, so this story stays with the 2022 tables.

## What "family problems" can mean

For each death, police record a cause. In 2022, family problems other than marriage-related ones accounted for 31.7% of all suicides, illness for 18.4% and marriage-related problems for 4.8% [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-snapshots]]. Those shares cover everyone, not only women. The person who died cannot give it, so the entry depends on what police are told afterwards. When a married woman dies in her husband's home, the people explaining her death may be the people she lived with.

"Housewife" hides as much as "family problems" does. It sits in the occupation column, but it comes with no wage, no fixed hours, no leave and no colleagues. Many women enter it by moving into another family's home, away from their own parents and friends. Money, a phone and permission to go out may all be in someone else's hands. The Supreme Court's 2023 handbook on gender stereotypes replaces "housewife" with "homemaker" [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

What surveys do record is violence. In NFHS-5, 31.9% of ever-married women said they had faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from their husband [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Of women who had faced physical or sexual violence from anyone, 77.2% had never sought help or told anyone [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

The National Mental Health Survey of 2015-16 found nearly 1% of adults at high suicidal risk, and 1.14% among women [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Its summary adds that half of the people at high risk had no other mental disorder. Distress is not always an illness inside one person. Sometimes it is a response to the life around her.

Consider this situation. A 28-year-old in Kanpur, married five years, lives with her husband's family. She has a degree she has never used and no bank account in her own name. When she told her mother that her husband hits her, she was told every marriage needs adjustment, so she stopped mentioning it. Nothing in her week would appear in any record. Every part of it is something another person could change.

## Abetment cases: when the law sees a link to cruelty

Sometimes police link a woman's death to how she was treated. In 2024 they registered 4,220 cases of abetment of suicide of women, involving 4,284 victims, under Sections 107 and 108 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita or, for offences before 1 July 2024, Sections 305 and 306 of the IPC. The count was 4,963 in 2022 and 4,825 in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

In 2022, when 48,172 women died by suicide, police registered roughly one abetment case for every ten deaths. That does not mean cruelty lay behind one death in ten; suicide rarely has a single cause. It means police opened a criminal case in roughly one death in ten. The two counts come from different NCRB reports, so treat the ratio as a rough guide.

The law can also act before a death. Sections 85 and 86 of the BNS punish cruelty by a husband or his relatives with up to 3 years in prison and a fine, and define cruelty to include wilful conduct likely to drive a woman to suicide [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 1,20,227 cruelty cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Isolation is not destiny: what helps

The World Health Organization is clear that suicides are preventable [[who-suicide]]. For a woman at home, prevention mostly looks like ordinary contact and a real way out.
