| roz 137 | auratein aur ladkiyan jinhe 2024 mein partner ya family member ne maar daala |
| 0.2% har saal | 20 saal mein partner violence mein average giraavat |
| 0.2% | 2022 mein global development aid ka woh hissa jo prevention par kharch hua |

## 840 million: zindagi bhar ki ginti

WHO ke 2023 estimates ke mutabik kareeb 840 million auraton aur ladkiyon ne, yaani lagbhag 3 mein se 1 ne, zindagi mein kam se kam ek baar intimate partner se physical ya sexual violence, ya kisi aur se sexual violence jheli hai [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. Yeh 15 saal aur usse upar ki auraton ka 30.4% hai, aur 15-49 saal ki auraton ka 31.6% [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]].

Sirf partner violence ki baat karein toh yeh 15 saal aur usse upar ki kareeb 682 million auratein hain, yaani un auraton ka 24.7% jinki kabhi shaadi hui ya jinka kabhi partner raha [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Kareeb 263 million auraton par kisi aise insaan ne sexual assault kiya jo unka partner nahi tha [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. Kuch auratein dono groups mein hain.

Do caveats. Partner-violence wala indicator sirf physical aur sexual violence ginta hai; psychological abuse aur controlling behaviour isme nahi aate. Aur WHO kehta hai ki saare surveys violence ko asal se kam hi dikhate honge, kyunki bahut si auratein kabhi batati hi nahi [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. 840 million ko kam se kam wali ginti samjho.

## 31% aur 22.4%: South Asia aur India

Duniya bhar mein 15-49 saal ki ever-married ya partnered auraton mein se 25.8% ne kam se kam ek baar pati ya male partner se physical ya sexual violence jheli hai. Southern Asia mein, yaani UN ke us region mein jisme India aata hai, yeh figure 31% hai, jo kisi bhi region ke sabse oonche figures mein se hai [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]].

WHO har desh ke liye ek modelled estimate bhi nikalta hai. India ke liye yeh hai: 15-49 saal ki ever-married ya partnered auraton mein 29.9% ne zindagi mein kabhi, aur 22.4% ne pichhle 12 mahinon mein. Pichhle saal wala figure India ko un 33 countries aur territory mein rakhta hai jahan yeh rate sabse ooncha hai. Us group mein Afghanistan ke alawa South Asia ka koi aur desh nahi hai. Isi age group ka global past-year average 13.7% hai [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]].

Pichhle saal wala number zyada batata hai. Lifetime figure mein woh violence bhi aati hai jo saalon pehle khatam ho chuki. 12 mahine wala figure un gharon ki baat karta hai jahan yeh abhi ho rahi hai. Socho, kisi bhi Indian shehar ki ek gali, jisme 50 se kam umar ki nau shaadi-shuda auratein rehti hain. WHO ke estimate ke hisaab se, average mein unme se kareeb do ne pichhle saal apne pati se physical ya sexual violence jheli.

Caveats: yeh survey data par bane ek statistical model ka output hai, isliye yeh India ki NFHS reports se bilkul match nahi karega, aur iski uncertainty range 17.4% se 27.7% tak hai. Ise India ke liye WHO ke pehle wale estimate se compare bhi nahi kiya ja sakta [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]].

Zyada tar auratein kisi official jagah tak pahunchti hi nahi. NFHS-5 mein, jin Indian auraton ne physical ya sexual violence jheli thi, unme se sirf 14% ne kabhi madad maangi, aur 77% ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Roz 137: sabse jaanleva anjaam

2024 mein kareeb 50,000 auraton aur ladkiyon ko unke intimate partners ya family ke doosre members ne maar daala. Yeh us saal jaan-boojhkar maari gayi saari auraton aur ladkiyon ka kareeb 60% hai, yaani average roz 137 [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]].

2024 mein duniya ke homicide victims mein 80% mard aur ladke the, lekin male victims mein se sirf 11% ko partner ya family member ne maara [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]]. Jis mard ki hatya hui, use aam taur par family ke bahar ke kisi insaan ne maara. Jis aurat ki hatya hui, use aam taur par uski apni family ke kisi insaan ne maara.

Ek caveat: 2024 ka figure 2023 ke estimate 51,100 se kam hai, lekin report kehti hai ki yeh fark is baat se aaya ki kin countries ne data diya, asli giraavat se nahi [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]].

Jahan countries aisi hatyaon ka data nahi deti, wahan UN apna estimate dowry death aur honour killing jaise related offences se banata hai, jahan national law inhe define karta hai [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2024]]. Indian law dowry death ko define karta hai, aur police ne 2024 mein aise 5,737 cases record kiye, yaani roz kareeb 16 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 0.2% har saal: badlaav ki raftaar

Pichhle 20 saal mein auraton par partner violence average sirf kareeb 0.2% har saal ghati hai, aur "teen mein se ek" wala figure wahin atka hua hai. WHO kehta hai ki isse yeh bahut mushkil lagta hai ki duniya 2030 tak auraton aur ladkiyon par violence khatam karne ka apna target poora kar paayegi [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]].

WHO ke pichhle round ne, jisme 2018 tak ka data tha, kareeb 736 million auratein gini thi [[who-vaw-estimates-2021]], jabki ab 840 million hain. Yeh fark koi naapi hui badhotri nahi hai: WHO saaf kehta hai ki 2023 ke estimates 2018 aur 2010 ke rounds se compare nahi kiye ja sakte, kyunki methods aur data badal gaye [[who-vaw-prevalence-report-2025]]. Trend ki asli finding 0.2% hai, yaani lagbhag seedhi line.

## Aid ka 0.2%: duniya prevention par kya kharch karti hai

2022 mein global development aid ka sirf 0.2% un programmes ko gaya jinka focus auraton par violence ko rokna tha, aur WHO ne bataya ki 2025 mein yeh funding aur gir gayi [[who-vaw-estimates-2025]].

Kuch countries mein auraton par violence ki keemat police, justice, social protection aur health services ke kharch ke roop mein GDP ke 1% se 6% tak baithti hai; yeh range kuch chune hue country studies se li gayi hai, yeh global estimate nahi hai [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. Partner violence duniya bhar mein auraton ki kharab sehat ki chauthi sabse badi wajah bhi hai [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. Dono 0.2% figures ko saath rakh kar dekho: ek paisa hai, doosra raftaar.

Itne bade numbers ek-ek ghar se bante hain. Jin Indian auraton ne violence ke baad madad maangi, unme se 60.9% apni hi family ke paas gayi aur sirf 6.3% police ke paas [[nfhs5-india-2021]], isliye pehla response aksar maa, bhai ya kisi dost se aata hai. Agar koi tumhe bataye, toh us par yakeen karo aur poochho ki use kya chahiye. Agar woh abhi khatre mein hai, toh 112 par call karo.

queer-young-adults-family-pressure-optio.en:
Imagine a 22-year-old in Kanpur whose brother has read his chats. By Sunday the family has a plan: a psychiatrist on Monday, a baba if that fails, and a rishta from the next district before winter. His phone is with his father "for safekeeping".

For many queer Indians the danger is a family plan. An adult has more legal footing than most families know, and fewer safe places to go than the law suggests. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Is my family allowed to do this to an adult?

No. If you are 18 or older, these choices are yours in law.

On 6 September 2018, a five-judge Supreme Court bench in Navtej Singh Johar read down Section 377 of the IPC, decriminalising consensual sex between adults of the same sex [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. Being gay, lesbian or bisexual is not an offence, so there is nothing for a family to "report". The same year, in Shakti Vahini, the court held that the right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]].

One limit: on 17 October 2023 the Supreme Court held that there is no fundamental right to marry and declined to recognise same-sex marriage [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. You can love and live with a same-sex partner. You cannot yet marry them.

A family cannot lock an adult in, take their phone and papers, beat them, or force treatment or a wedding. Confinement and violence are crimes whoever commits them: voluntarily causing hurt is punishable under Section 115(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) with up to 1 year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 10,000, or both [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Under 18 it is different, because parents are guardians. Beatings and forced "cures" are still abuse: call the Child Helpline on 1098.

## They want to take me to a doctor or a baba for a 'cure'. What are my rights?

You can refuse. Being queer is not an illness, so there is nothing to treat.

In June 2021 the Madras High Court, on a petition filed by a lesbian couple, directed that any attempt to medically "cure" or change sexual orientation or gender identity be prohibited, with action including withdrawal of the licence of professionals involved [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. On 25 August 2022 the National Medical Commission told all state medical councils that conducting "conversion therapy" on LGBTQIA+ persons is professional misconduct [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

If you are taken to a clinic anyway, tell the doctor, alone if you can, that you are an adult and do not consent to any treatment to change who you are. Note the doctor's name and registration number; complaints go to the state medical council. A psychiatrist's job is your distress, not your orientation, and Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 bars discrimination in mental health care on grounds that include sexual orientation [[indiacode-mhca-2017]].

Babas, "healers" and unregistered counsellors are not bound by the NMC rule. The criminal law still binds them. If anyone confines you, hits you or forces medicines on you, call 112 [[mha-erss]].

## They are fixing my marriage. Can they?

Not without your consent. Shakti Vahini puts the choice of a partner with you, not your clan.

A wedding is not a cure. It adds a second person who has been lied to. For a queer woman it adds a specific danger: Exception 2 to Section 63 of the BNS says sexual acts by a man with his own wife, if she is 18 or older, are not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. A marriage meant to "fix" her puts her where the law does not hear her refusal.

Say no early, and put it in a message to a relative so that a record exists. If a date is fixed and you are being held, call 112.

## How do I leave home safely, and where can I go?

If you are not in immediate danger, plan first. Save photos of your Aadhaar, certificates and bank papers in an account your family cannot open. Keep a bank account that only you control, and some cash. Tell one trusted person outside the house and agree on a code word. Leave when things are calm.

Shelter is the hard part. As of November 2025, India had 21 Garima Greh homes for destitute transgender persons, in 17 states [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. In August 2025, 429 people were living in the homes then running [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Women can go to a One Stop Centre: 985 were operating in July 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. We could not find a government shelter meant for gay or bisexual men. For most people the real shelter is a friend's room or a queer community group, so build those contacts early.

Families often file a missing-person complaint, or accuse a partner of kidnapping. Give the police a signed statement, with a copy of your ID, saying that you are an adult who left by choice, and keep a copy. Take a lawyer or a friend if you can: police can be hostile, and the same Madras ruling had to order their sensitisation.

Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita lets you file a Zero FIR at any police station, wherever the offence took place, and you must get a free copy [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. A woman facing violence from the family she lives with can seek a protection order under the Domestic Violence Act; breaching it is punishable with up to 1 year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 20,000, or both [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. For a free lawyer, call the National Legal Services Authority's helpline [[nalsa]].

## How do I look after my mind while I decide?

Living under watch wears anyone down. Fear, shame and exhaustion are responses to pressure, not proof that your family is right.

Tele-MANAS on 14416 is free, open round the clock and offers counselling to anyone who needs it [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Tell one person the whole truth. Do not try to settle your whole life in the week of a crisis; settle the next safe step.

If thoughts of ending your life come, treat that as an emergency: tell someone near you and call 14416 or 112. This pressure can change, and it changes faster once you are safe.

Staying for now, while you build savings, contacts and an exit, is also a plan. You do not have to come out to anyone to use any right on this page.
queer-young-adults-family-pressure-optio.hg:
Sochiye, Kanpur mein 22 saal ka ek ladka hai jiske bhai ne uske chats padh liye hain. Sunday tak family ka plan ready hai: Monday ko psychiatrist, woh kaam na aaye toh baba, aur sardiyon se pehle paas ke district se ek rishta. Uska phone papa ke paas hai, "sambhaal kar rakhne ke liye".

Bahut se queer Indians ke liye khatra family ka plan hi hota hai. Ek adult ke paas utna legal aadhaar hota hai jitna zyada tar families jaanti nahi, aur jaane ke liye utni safe jagahein nahi hoti jitni law se lagti hain. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Kya meri family ek adult ke saath yeh sab kar sakti hai?

Nahi. Agar aap 18 ya usse zyada ke hain, toh law mein yeh faisle aapke apne hain.

6 September 2018 ko Supreme Court ki five-judge bench ne Navtej Singh Johar mein IPC ke Section 377 ko read down kiya, aur same sex ke adults ke beech consensual sex ko decriminalise kar diya [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. Gay, lesbian ya bisexual hona koi offence nahi hai, isliye family ke paas "report" karne ko kuch hai hi nahi. Usi saal Shakti Vahini mein court ne kaha ki life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]].

Ek limit hai: 17 October 2023 ko Supreme Court ne kaha ki shaadi karne ka koi fundamental right nahi hai, aur same-sex marriage ko recognise karne se mana kar diya [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. Aap same-sex partner se pyaar kar sakte hain aur uske saath reh sakte hain. Abhi usse shaadi nahi kar sakte.

Family kisi adult ko band nahi kar sakti, uska phone aur papers nahi chheen sakti, use maar nahi sakti, aur us par treatment ya shaadi nahi thop sakti. Band karke rakhna aur violence crime hai, chahe koi bhi kare: voluntarily causing hurt par Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 115(2) ke under 1 saal tak ki jail, Rs 10,000 tak ka fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

18 se kam umar mein baat alag hai, kyunki maa-baap guardians hote hain. Phir bhi maar-peet aur zabardasti ka "cure" abuse hi hai: Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye.

## Woh mujhe 'cure' ke liye doctor ya baba ke paas le jaana chahte hain. Mere rights kya hain?

Aap mana kar sakte hain. Queer hona koi bimari nahi hai, isliye ilaaj karne ko kuch hai hi nahi.

June 2021 mein Madras High Court ne, ek lesbian couple ki petition par, direction diya ki sexual orientation ya gender identity ko medically "cure" karne ya badalne ki har koshish par rok lage, aur isme shaamil professionals par action ho, jisme licence wapas lena bhi shaamil hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. 25 August 2022 ko National Medical Commission ne sabhi state medical councils ko bataya ki LGBTQIA+ persons par "conversion therapy" karna professional misconduct hai [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

Agar phir bhi aapko clinic le jaya jaye, toh doctor se, ho sake toh akele mein, saaf kahiye ki aap adult hain aur khud ko badalne wale kisi bhi treatment ke liye consent nahi dete. Doctor ka naam aur registration number note kijiye; complaint state medical council ko jaati hai. Psychiatrist ka kaam aapki pareshani dekhna hai, aapki orientation nahi, aur Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ka Section 21 mental health care mein discrimination ko rokta hai, jiske grounds mein sexual orientation bhi shaamil hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]].

Babas, "healers" aur unregistered counsellors par NMC ka rule lagu nahi hota. Criminal law phir bhi un par lagu hota hai. Agar koi aapko band kare, maare ya zabardasti dawa khilaye, toh 112 call kijiye [[mha-erss]].

## Woh meri shaadi fix kar rahe hain. Kya woh aisa kar sakte hain?

Aapki consent ke bina nahi. Shakti Vahini ke hisaab se partner chunne ka faisla aapka hai, aapke khandaan ka nahi.

Shaadi koi ilaaj nahi hai. Usse bas ek aur insaan jud jaata hai, jisse jhooth bola gaya hai. Queer aurat ke liye isme ek alag khatra bhi hai: BNS ke Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki aadmi ke apni patni ke saath sexual acts, agar patni 18 ya usse zyada umar ki hai, rape nahi hain [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Jo shaadi use "theek" karne ke liye ki jaati hai, woh use aisi jagah pahuncha deti hai jahan law uski "na" sunta hi nahi.

"Na" jaldi kahiye, aur kisi rishtedaar ko message mein likh kar kahiye taaki record ban jaye. Agar date fix ho chuki hai aur aapko rok kar rakha gaya hai, toh 112 call kijiye.

## Main ghar se safely kaise niklun, aur kahan jaun?

Agar turant khatra nahi hai, toh pehle plan banaiye. Apne Aadhaar, certificates aur bank papers ki photos aise account mein save kijiye jise aapki family na khol sake. Ek bank account rakhiye jo sirf aapke control mein ho, aur kuch cash. Ghar ke bahar ke kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko bataiye aur ek code word tay kar lijiye. Tab nikliye jab maahaul shaant ho.

Sabse mushkil hissa shelter hai. November 2025 tak India mein destitute transgender persons ke liye 21 Garima Greh homes the, 17 states mein [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. August 2025 mein, us waqt chal rahe homes mein 429 log reh rahe the [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Auratein One Stop Centre ja sakti hain: July 2026 mein 985 centres chal rahe the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. Gay ya bisexual aadmiyon ke liye bana koi government shelter humein nahi mila. Zyada tar logon ke liye asli shelter kisi dost ka kamra ya koi queer community group hi hota hai, isliye yeh contacts pehle se bana kar rakhiye.

Families aksar missing-person complaint likhwa deti hain, ya partner par kidnapping ka ilzaam laga deti hain. Police ko apne ID ki copy ke saath ek signed statement dijiye ki aap adult hain aur apni marzi se ghar chhoda hai, aur uski copy apne paas rakhiye. Ho sake toh lawyer ya kisi dost ko saath le jaiye: police ka rawaiya hostile ho sakta hai, aur usi Madras ruling ko police ke sensitisation ka order dena pada tha.

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita ka Section 173 aapko kisi bhi police station mein Zero FIR file karne deta hai, chahe offence kahin bhi hua ho, aur aapko FIR ki copy free milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Jo aurat usi family se violence jhel rahi hai jiske saath woh rehti hai, woh Domestic Violence Act ke under protection order maang sakti hai; use todne par 1 saal tak ki jail, Rs 20,000 tak ka fine, ya dono ho sakte hain [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Free lawyer ke liye National Legal Services Authority ki helpline par call kijiye [[nalsa]].

## Faisla lete waqt main apne mann ka khayal kaise rakhun?

Har waqt nigrani mein rehna kisi ko bhi thaka deta hai. Darr, sharam aur thakaan pressure ka asar hain, is baat ka saboot nahi ki aapki family sahi hai.

Tele-MANAS 14416 free hai, chaubees ghante khula rehta hai aur har zarooratmand ko counselling deta hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Kisi ek insaan ko poora sach bataiye. Crisis wale hafte mein apni poori zindagi tay karne ki koshish mat kijiye; bas agla safe kadam tay kijiye.

Agar apni jaan lene ke khayal aayein, toh ise emergency maaniye: apne paas ke kisi insaan ko bataiye aur 14416 ya 112 par call kijiye. Yeh pressure badal sakta hai, aur jab aap safe hote hain toh aur jaldi badalta hai.

Abhi ke liye ghar mein rukna, jab tak aap savings, contacts aur nikalne ka raasta bana rahe hain, yeh bhi ek plan hai. Is page par likhe kisi bhi haq ko use karne ke liye aapko kisi ke saamne come out karne ki zaroorat nahi hai.

queer-youth-mental-health-data-blind-spo.en:
In 2024, 14,488 students in India died by suicide, about 80% more than a decade earlier, according to NCRB data [[thewire-student-suicides-2014-2024]]. Over the eleven years from 2014 to 2024, the total was 1,23,918. Each of those deaths sits in a police record with an age, a sex, an occupation and a recorded cause. None of them says whether the student was gay, lesbian, bisexual or questioning. India counts its students' deaths every year. It has never asked about one pressure some of them carry.

## What India measures, and what it does not

The numbers come from NCRB's annual *Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India* report. In 2023, 13,892 students died by suicide, 8.1% of all suicides and, at the time, the highest count in a decade [[careers360-ncrb-adsi-2023-students]]. India recorded 1,70,746 suicides of all kinds in 2024 [[theprint-ncrb-adsi-2024]].

For each death, police pick a cause from a fixed list: family problems, illness, marriage-related problems and many others. In 2022, family problems other than marriage, illness and marriage-related problems together accounted for 54.9% of suicides [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-snapshots]]. The report even has a column for transgender persons: it recorded 28 among those who died by suicide in 2022 [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. There is no column for sexual orientation.

The National Mental Health Survey of 2015-16 found nearly 1% of adults at high suicidal risk, rising to 1.71% in urban metros [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. The findings we could verify say nothing about sexual orientation either.

This is not evidence that queer students are dying in large numbers. It is evidence that nobody can tell. If a 17-year-old who was outed and threatened at home dies by suicide, the police record may say "family problems". It notes the trigger as police saw it, not who the person was.

## Bullying, family pressure and the 'cure' threat

Consider a 16-year-old in Indore. A classmate screenshots a private chat and drops it in the class WhatsApp group. By lunch the slurs are in the corridor. At home that night, an uncle says a doctor can fix this. Nothing in that chain will appear in any national dataset.

Police registered just 105 cases of cyber stalking or bullying of children across India in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That number tells you who goes to the police, not what happens in class groups.

The "cure" threat is real enough that a High Court ordered the medical regulator to act on it. Since August 2022, conversion therapy on LGBTQIA+ people has been professional misconduct for doctors [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. Being queer is not an illness, and between consenting adults it has not been a crime since 2018 [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. A teenager who has never been told either fact may believe something is wrong with them.

## The protections that exist on paper

Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 bars discrimination in mental health care on any basis, naming sexual orientation [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. A queer teenager who sees a psychiatrist for depression is entitled to treatment for the depression, not for being queer. Section 115 of the same Act presumes that a person who attempts suicide is under severe stress, bars punishing them, and obliges the government to provide care [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. Since 1 July 2024, the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita has had no general offence of attempted suicide [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Asking for help after an attempt will not get you prosecuted.

In June 2021 the Madras High Court ordered sensitisation of police, the judiciary, schools and health workers on LGBTQIA+ lives [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. On 16 April 2024 the Centre's committee on queer persons was asked to include modules on their mental health [[gazette-queer-committee-order-2024]]. We could find no report from it. None of these protections counts anyone, and none puts a trained counsellor in a school.

## What schools and counsellors should do

Treat anti-queer slurs and outing as bullying, and act the same day. Do not tell the targeted student to "ignore it" or to be less obvious.

Counsellors should never treat a student's orientation as the problem, and should not tell parents or classmates about it without the student's agreement. If a student is being abused or is in danger, you may have to involve others: say so honestly at the start. When a student seems low, ask plainly how they are coping, and listen.

Schools can also start counting. Record bullying incidents by type, including anti-queer bullying, without names. A blind spot closes only when someone starts writing things down.

## If you are queer and struggling: where to start

Call Tele-MANAS on 14416. It is the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock helpline, and it offers counselling to anyone, including transgender persons [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. In an emergency, call 112. If you are under 18 and unsafe at home, the Child Helpline is 1098.

Find one safe person: a friend, a cousin, a teacher. You do not have to explain everything at once. Who you are is not a disease, and the system's failure to count you is not a verdict on whether you matter.
queer-youth-mental-health-data-blind-spo.hg:
NCRB data ke mutabik, 2024 mein India mein 14,488 students ki suicide se maut hui, jo ek decade pehle se lagbhag 80% zyada hai [[thewire-student-suicides-2014-2024]]. 2014 se 2024 tak ke gyaarah saalon mein yeh total 1,23,918 tha. Har maut ek police record mein darj hai, jisme umar, sex, occupation aur ek cause likha hai. Inme se kisi mein yeh nahi likha ki student gay, lesbian, bisexual ya questioning tha. India har saal apne students ki maut ginta hai. Par usne kabhi us ek pressure ke baare mein nahi poocha jo inme se kuch log jhel rahe hote hain.

## India kya measure karta hai, aur kya nahi

Yeh numbers NCRB ki saalana report *Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India* se aate hain. 2023 mein 13,892 students ki suicide se maut hui, jo saare suicides ka 8.1% tha aur us waqt ek decade mein sabse zyada [[careers360-ncrb-adsi-2023-students]]. 2024 mein India mein kul 1,70,746 suicides record hue [[theprint-ncrb-adsi-2024]].

Har maut ke liye police ek fixed list se cause chunti hai: family problems, illness, marriage se jude problems aur kai doosre. 2022 mein marriage ke alawa family problems, illness aur marriage se jude problems milkar 54.9% suicides ke cause the [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-snapshots]]. Report mein transgender logon ka ek column bhi hai: 2022 mein suicide se marne wale logon mein 28 transgender log record hue [[ncrb-adsi-2022-hindi-ch2]]. Sexual orientation ka koi column nahi hai.

2015-16 ke National Mental Health Survey mein lagbhag 1% adults high suicidal risk par mile, aur urban metros mein yeh 1.71% tha [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. Jo findings hum verify kar paaye, unme bhi sexual orientation ke baare mein kuch nahi hai.

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki queer students badi sankhya mein mar rahe hain. Iska matlab hai ki koi bata hi nahi sakta. Agar ek 17 saal ka teenager, jise out kiya gaya aur ghar par dhamkaya gaya, suicide se mar jaata hai, toh police record mein shayad "family problems" likha jaaye. Record wahi trigger likhta hai jo police ne dekha, yeh nahi ki woh insaan kaun tha.

## Bullying, family ka pressure aur 'cure' ki dhamki

Socho, Indore mein ek 16 saal ka student hai. Ek classmate uski private chat ka screenshot lekar class ke WhatsApp group mein daal deta hai. Lunch tak corridor mein gaaliyan shuru ho jaati hain. Usi raat ghar par ek chacha kehte hain ki doctor ise theek kar dega. Is poori kahani ka kuch bhi kisi national dataset mein nahi aayega.

2024 mein poore India mein bachchon ke cyber stalking ya bullying ke sirf 105 cases police ne register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh number batata hai ki police tak kaun jaata hai, yeh nahi ki class groups mein kya hota hai.

"Cure" ki dhamki itni asli hai ki ek High Court ko medical regulator ko kadam uthane ka order dena pada. August 2022 se LGBTQIA+ logon par conversion therapy doctors ke liye professional misconduct hai [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]]. Queer hona bimaari nahi hai, aur consent wale adults ke beech 2018 se yeh crime bhi nahi hai [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. Jis teenager ko yeh dono baatein kabhi kisi ne nahi batayi, woh soch sakta hai ki usme kuch gadbad hai.

## Paper par jo protections hain

Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ki Section 21 mental health care mein kisi bhi basis par discrimination par rok lagati hai, aur sexual orientation ka naam leti hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. Agar ek queer teenager depression ke liye psychiatrist ke paas jaata hai, toh use depression ka ilaaj milna chahiye, queer hone ka nahi. Isi Act ki Section 115 maanti hai ki suicide attempt karne wala insaan bahut zyada stress mein hai, use saza dene par rok lagati hai, aur sarkar ko uski care karne ka zimma deti hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. 1 July 2024 se Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita mein attempted suicide ka koi general offence nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Attempt ke baad madad maangne par tum par case nahi chalega.

June 2021 mein Madras High Court ne police, judiciary, schools aur health workers ko LGBTQIA+ logon ki zindagi ke baare mein sensitise karne ka order diya [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. 16 April 2024 ko queer logon par bani Centre ki committee se unki mental health par modules shaamil karne ko kaha gaya [[gazette-queer-committee-order-2024]]. Humein uski koi report nahi mili. Inme se koi bhi protection kisi ko ginti nahi, aur koi bhi school mein trained counsellor nahi bithati.

## Schools aur counsellors ko kya karna chahiye

Anti-queer gaaliyon aur outing ko bullying maano, aur usi din action lo. Jis student ko target kiya gaya, use "ignore karo" ya "itna obvious mat bano" mat kaho.

Counsellors ko kabhi bhi student ke orientation ko problem nahi maanna chahiye, aur student ki marzi ke bina parents ya classmates ko iske baare mein nahi batana chahiye. Agar student ke saath abuse ho raha hai ya woh khatre mein hai, toh shayad doosron ko shaamil karna pade: yeh baat shuru mein hi imaandari se bata do. Jab koi student udaas lage, toh seedha poochho ki woh kaise sambhal raha hai, aur dhyaan se suno.

Schools ginti bhi shuru kar sakte hain. Bullying incidents ko type ke hisaab se record karo, anti-queer bullying bhi, bina naam ke. Blind spot tabhi band hota hai jab koi cheezein likhna shuru karta hai.

## Agar tum queer ho aur mushkil mein ho: shuruaat kahan se karein

Tele-MANAS 14416 par call karo. Yeh Health Ministry ki free, 24x7 helpline hai, aur yeh har kisi ko counselling deti hai, transgender logon ko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Emergency mein 112 par call karo. Agar tum 18 se kam ho aur ghar par safe nahi ho, toh Child Helpline 1098 hai.

Ek safe insaan dhoondo: koi dost, cousin ya teacher. Sab kuch ek saath samjhaana zaroori nahi. Tum jo ho, woh koi bimaari nahi hai, aur system ka tumhe na ginna is baat ka faisla nahi hai ki tum matter karte ho ya nahi.

sexual-coercion-pressure-fear-power-expl.en:
Sexual coercion does not always look like force. It can look like a boyfriend who goes silent for three days after a no. A senior who reminds you he is writing your recommendation letter. A man who promises marriage and never meant it. A husband who treats a refusal as an insult: in the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21), 19.2% of Indian men aged 15 to 49 said a husband has the right to get angry and reprimand a wife who refuses sex, and 12.2% said he may use force [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Coercion is any way of getting a yes that was never free.

## Persuasion, pressure, coercion: a spectrum, not a switch

Asking once and accepting the answer is persuasion. Asking again after a no, guilt ("if you loved me, you would"), comparisons ("everyone else does it") and sulking are pressure. Coercion begins when no starts to cost something: a breakup used as a threat, a warning to tell parents or leak chats, a lower grade, a lost job, a room taken away. At the far end sit force and threats of hurt, which the law already treats as rape.

One test cuts through all of it. Could the other person have said no and walked away without losing anything? If not, the yes was not free.

## What Section 63 says about fear, deception and intoxication

Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) treats sex as rape not only when it is against a woman's will or without her consent, but also when her yes came from fear of death or hurt to her or someone she cares about; when a man posed as her husband; when intoxication left her unable to understand what she was agreeing to; or when she cannot communicate consent at all. With a girl under 18, it is rape whatever she says [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

That impersonation is the only lie Section 63 covers. Other lies can fall under Section 69, a new and lesser crime: sex obtained by "deceitful means", or by a promise of marriage made with no intention of keeping it, including a false promise of a job or promotion, carries up to 10 years in prison [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 1,325 such cases in the code's first six months, July to December 2024; 99 were recorded as cyber crimes [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Note the line: Section 69 is about a promise made with no intention of keeping it. A relationship that ends, or a wedding that families block, is not that; a promise that was a lie from the start can be.

Men and transgender people can be pressured and coerced too, but Section 63 protects only women, and the BNS has no counterpart to IPC Section 377 for adult men or transgender people [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The harm is the same; the law's protection is not.

## Power changes the meaning of yes: bosses, teachers, seniors

When someone controls your marks, salary or next role, your yes may really be fear. The Hema Committee, whose report on Malayalam cinema was made public in August 2024, confirmed a casting couch in the industry, where junior artists were told they would get a chance in films if they complied with demands for sex [[nie-hema-report-release-2024]]. Many feared losing their jobs if they testified, a fear the panel called "well-founded" [[bbc-hema-report-2024]].

Section 68 of the BNS punishes anyone in authority, including public servants and the staff of jails, women's or children's institutions and hospitals, who abuses that position to get a woman in his custody or care to have sex with him, even short of rape: 5 to 10 years' rigorous imprisonment. Rape by a relative, guardian, teacher or anyone in a position of trust is aggravated rape: at least 10 years, up to imprisonment for the rest of the convict's natural life [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

At work, a demand or request for sexual favours has counted as sexual harassment since the Supreme Court's Vishaka guidelines of 1997 [[sc-vishaka-1997]]. Under the 2013 workplace harassment law, every employer must set up an Internal Complaints Committee (workplaces with fewer than 10 workers use the district's Local Committee), and a complaint must be filed within 3 months, extendable by up to 3 more [[indiacode-posh-2013]]. Using it is hard: the Supreme Court noted in 2023 that women facing harassment are often reluctant to report it and "many of them even drop out from their job" [[sci-posh-enforcement-judgment-2023]].

## Guilt, sulking and 'just once': the everyday script

"Just once." "You led me on." "You're so cold." Three days of silence. A threat to leave. The BNS names none of these as crimes. But a yes given to make the pressure stop is giving in, not agreeing.

A 2014 ICRW-UNFPA study classified 32% of the Indian men it surveyed as having "rigid" masculinity and only 23% as gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. Between NFHS-4 (2015-16) and NFHS-5, the share of men who rejected all four coercive responses to a wife's refusal fell from 77% to 72% [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Marriage is where the law is weakest. Exception 2 to Section 63 says sex by a man with his own wife, if she is 18 or older, is not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Yet 4.6% of ever-married women aged 18 to 49 in NFHS-5 said their husband had physically forced them into intercourse when they did not want it [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Challenges to the exception are still pending: in September 2026 the Supreme Court posted them for final hearing, but it has not ruled [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]].

## Deceit and sabotage: lies, a removed condom, hidden pills

Consent is specific. A yes to sex with a condom is not a yes to sex without one, so removing it without the partner knowing breaks the agreement and risks pregnancy and infection. Whatever the law calls it, it is a breach of consent.

Hiding or swapping pills, refusing contraception, or pushing someone to get pregnant or to end a pregnancy is known as reproductive coercion. On abortion the law is clear: an adult woman's own consent is the only consent the MTP Act requires [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

Whatever the method, ask: could they have said no without paying a price? This explainer is general information, not legal advice.
sexual-coercion-pressure-fear-power-expl.hg:
Sexual coercion hamesha force jaisa nahi dikhta. Woh ek aise boyfriend jaisa dikh sakta hai jo no sunne ke baad teen din tak baat nahi karta. Ek aise senior jaisa jo yaad dilata hai ki tumhara recommendation letter wahi likh raha hai. Ek aise aadmi jaisa jo shaadi ka promise karta hai, par use nibhane ka irada kabhi tha hi nahi. Aur ek aise husband jaisa jo refusal ko apni insult samajhta hai: National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) mein 15 se 49 saal ke 19.2% Indian men ne kaha ki agar wife sex se mana kare, toh husband ko gussa karne aur use daantne ka haq hai, aur 12.2% ne kaha ki woh force bhi kar sakta hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Coercion matlab kisi bhi tareeke se aisa yes nikalwana jo kabhi free tha hi nahi.

## Persuasion, pressure, coercion: ek spectrum, koi switch nahi

Ek baar poochna aur jo jawab mile use maan lena persuasion hai. No ke baad phir se poochna, guilt trip ("agar tum mujhse pyaar karte, toh maan jaate"), comparison ("baaki sab toh karte hain") aur sulking, yeh sab pressure hai. Coercion tab shuru hota hai jab no bolne ki keemat chukani pade: breakup ko dhamki ki tarah use karna, ghar walon ko batane ya chats leak karne ki warning, marks katne, job jaane ya rehne ka room chhin jaane ka darr. Spectrum ke last end par force aur chot ki dhamki hai, jise law pehle se hi rape maanta hai.

Ek test sab clear kar deta hai. Kya saamne wala bina kuch khoye no bolkar ja sakta tha? Agar nahi, toh woh yes free nahi tha.

## Section 63 darr, dhokhe aur nashe ke baare mein kya kehta hai

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 sex ko rape maanta hai jab woh woman ki marzi ke khilaf ho ya uske consent ke bina ho. Par baat yahin khatam nahi hoti. Tab bhi rape hai jab uska yes use ya uske kisi apne ko maut ya chot ka darr dikhakar liya gaya ho; jab koi aadmi uska husband bankar aaya ho; jab nashe ki wajah se woh samajh hi na paa rahi ho ki kis cheez ke liye haan bol rahi hai; ya jab woh consent communicate hi na kar paaye. 18 se kam umar ki ladki ke saath, woh kuch bhi kahe, yeh rape hi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Section 63 sirf ek jhooth pakadta hai: husband hone ka natak. Baaki jhooth Section 69 mein aa sakte hain, jo ek naya aur kam serious crime hai. Agar koi "deceitful means" se sex kare, ya shaadi ka aisa promise karke kare jise nibhane ka irada hi na ho, toh 10 saal tak ki jail ho sakti hai. Job ya promotion ka jhootha promise bhi isi mein aata hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Naye code ke pehle chhe mahino mein, yaani July se December 2024 tak, police ne aise 1,325 cases register kiye, aur inmein se 99 cyber crime ke roop mein record hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Line samajh lo: Section 69 us promise ke baare mein hai jise nibhane ka irada shuru se hi nahi tha. Relationship khatam ho jaana, ya family ka shaadi rok dena, woh nahi hai; jo promise shuru se hi jhooth tha, woh ho sakta hai.

Men aur transgender logon par bhi pressure aur coercion hota hai, par Section 63 sirf women ko protect karta hai, aur BNS mein adult men ya transgender logon ke liye IPC Section 377 jaisa koi section nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Nuksaan wahi hai; law ki protection wahi nahi.

## Power yes ka matlab badal deti hai: boss, teachers, seniors

Jab kisi ke haath mein tumhare marks, tumhari salary ya tumhara agla role ho, toh tumhara yes asal mein darr bhi ho sakta hai. Hema Committee, jiski Malayalam cinema par report August 2024 mein public hui, ne maana ki industry mein casting couch sach mein hai: junior artists ko kaha jaata tha ki sex ki demand maan lo, toh films mein chance milega [[nie-hema-report-release-2024]]. Kai women gawahi dene se darti thi ki unki job chali jayegi, aur panel ne is darr ko "well-founded", yaani bilkul jaayaz, kaha [[bbc-hema-report-2024]].

BNS ka Section 68 authority wale har insaan ko saza deta hai, jaise government servants aur jail, women's ya children's institutions aur hospital ka staff, jo apni position ka galat use karke apni custody ya care mein rehne wali woman ko apne saath sex ke liye raazi kare, chahe maamla rape tak na pahunche: 5 se 10 saal ki rigorous imprisonment. Aur agar koi relative, guardian, teacher ya bharose ki position wala insaan rape kare, toh woh aggravated rape hai: kam se kam 10 saal, aur convict ki baaki poori natural life tak ki jail [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Office mein sexual favours ki demand ya request 1997 ke Supreme Court ke Vishaka guidelines ke time se sexual harassment maani jaati hai [[sc-vishaka-1997]]. 2013 ke workplace harassment law ke under har employer ko ek Internal Complaints Committee banani hoti hai (10 se kam workers wali jagahon ke liye district ki Local Committee hoti hai), aur complaint 3 mahine ke andar karni hoti hai, jise 3 mahine aur badhaya ja sakta hai [[indiacode-posh-2013]]. Par ise use karna aasaan nahi: Supreme Court ne 2023 mein kaha ki harassment jhelne wali women aksar report karne se hichkichati hain, aur "many of them even drop out from their job", yaani kai toh job hi chhod deti hain [[sci-posh-enforcement-judgment-2023]].

## Guilt, sulking aur 'bas ek baar': roz ki script

"Bas ek baar." "Tumne hi toh line di thi." "Tum kitni cold ho." Teen din ki chuppi. Chhod kar jaane ki dhamki. BNS inmein se kisi ko crime ka naam nahi deta. Par pressure se peecha chhudane ke liye diya gaya yes haar maan lena hai, agree karna nahi.

2014 ki ek ICRW-UNFPA study ne survey kiye gaye 32% Indian men ki masculinity ko "rigid" maana, aur sirf 23% ko gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]]. NFHS-4 (2015-16) se NFHS-5 ke beech, wife ke mana karne par chaaron coercive reactions ko reject karne wale men ka share 77% se girkar 72% ho gaya [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Shaadi ke maamle mein law sabse kamzor hai. Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki agar wife 18 ya usse zyada umar ki hai, toh husband ka uske saath sex rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Jabki NFHS-5 mein 18 se 49 saal ki ever-married women mein se 4.6% ne bataya ki husband ne unki marzi ke khilaf physically force karke intercourse kiya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Is exception ke khilaf challenges abhi pending hain: September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne unhe final hearing ke liye list kiya, par faisla abhi nahi aaya [[livelaw-marital-rape-final-hearing-2026]].

## Dhokha aur sabotage: jhooth, chupke se hataya condom, chhupayi gayi pills

Consent specific hota hai. Condom ke saath sex ka yes, bina condom ke sex ka yes nahi hai, isliye partner ko bataye bina condom hatana us agreement ko todna hai, aur isse pregnancy aur infection ka risk bhi hota hai. Law ise jo bhi naam de, yeh consent ka breach hai.

Pills chhupana ya badal dena, contraception se mana karna, ya kisi par pregnant hone ya pregnancy khatam karne ka pressure daalna reproductive coercion kehlata hai. Abortion par law clear hai: MTP Act ke under adult woman ki apni consent hi woh akeli consent hai jiski zaroorat hai [[gazette-mtp-act-1971]].

Tareeka koi bhi ho, bas yeh poochho: kya saamne wala bina keemat chukaye no bol sakta tha? Yeh explainer general information hai, legal advice nahi.

sexual-violence-against-men-uncounted.en:
For years, anyone who wanted to know how often adult men in India reported a sexual assault had one place to look: a single row in the National Crime Records Bureau's annual tables, labelled "Unnatural Offences". It showed 987 cases in 2022 and 888 in 2023. In the 2024 tables the row holds only dashes, with a footnote: "Sections deleted in BNS" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The assaults did not stop that year. The counting did.

## The one row that counted men: Section 377 in NCRB's tables

Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code punished "carnal intercourse against the order of nature" with any man, woman or animal [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. On 6 September 2018, in Navtej Singh Johar, the Supreme Court read it down: consensual sex between adults of the same sex stopped being a crime, while non-consensual acts and bestiality stayed offences [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]].

Rape under the IPC, as under the new code, could be committed only against a woman. So after 2018, Section 377 was the charge available when a man or a transgender person was sexually assaulted by a man, and its row was the nearest thing India had to a count.

It was a rough count. NCRB did not split the row by the victim's gender or the type of case, so nobody can say how many of the 888 cases in 2023 concerned a man, a woman or an animal [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 'Deleted in BNS': the 2024 disappearance

On 1 July 2024 the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) replaced the IPC. It dropped Section 377 and added no replacement [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. Its rape provision, Section 63, speaks of an act by "a man" against "a woman", so an adult man cannot legally be a rape victim in India [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

The statistics followed the statute. Imagine a 24-year-old in a paying-guest room in Pune who is sexually assaulted by a man he knows. In 2023 his FIR could have named Section 377, and he would have been one of the 888. Today police can reach only for general offences such as hurt or wrongful confinement, depending on the facts [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. NCRB counts each FIR once, under its most serious offence [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. So he enters the national data as a hurt case, in the same row as a street fight.

## Boys in the records: 892 of 44,567

NCRB's rape table has no place for men. Of the 29,742 victims recorded under the rape head in 2024, 792 were girls under 18 and 28,950 were women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That is every one of them.

The only law that still counts male victims is the one for children. POCSO is written for "a child", meaning anyone under 18, so boys are covered [[pocso-act-2012]]. In 2024 police recorded 44,567 child victims of penetrative sexual assault under POCSO: 43,675 girls and 892 boys, about 2 boys in every 100 victims [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The 2022 edition of the table had a column for transgender children as well. It showed none among 38,444 victims: 414 boys and 38,030 girls [[ncrb-cii-2022-book1]]. A zero like that more likely measures who can walk into a police station than who is abused.

On his eighteenth birthday, a boy leaves the only table that could record him.

## What surveys find that police data cannot

Police data counts complaints. Surveys ask people directly, and they describe a different country. In 2007 the Ministry of Women and Child Development surveyed 12,447 children in 13 states. Among the children who reported sexual abuse, 52.94% were boys and 47.06% girls, and 9 of the 13 states found a higher share among boys [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

The study's sample was not random and deliberately included street and working children, who are more often boys, so 52.94% is not a national rate. But it shows why police tables look so thin. Of the children who said they had been sexually assaulted, 72.1% had told no one and only 3.4% had reported it to the police. Among young adults assaulted in childhood, only 26.8% had ever told anyone [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

UNICEF's global estimate is that 240 to 310 million boys and men alive today, around 1 in 11, were raped or sexually assaulted in childhood [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

For adult men in India there is not even an old survey. The National Family Health Survey's figure on sexual violence is about women: 6% of women aged 18-49 said in NFHS-5 that they had experienced it [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Our research found no reliable national figure for adult male survivors, from police or from any survey.

## What is not counted is not funded

Budgets follow numbers, and India's support for survivors is built around the people its tables count. The 985 One Stop Centres operational in July 2026 had assisted over 15.20 lakh women between April 2015 and June 2026 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. The law that orders every hospital to treat survivors free of cost names rape, acid attack and POCSO offences [[indiacode-bnss-2023]], and rape in Indian law has only women as victims.

None of this argues for giving women less. The problem is arithmetic. A department asking for a counsellor's post, a helpline or police training has to show how many people need it. For adult male survivors, the official answer is now a dash. A dash is worse than a zero, because a zero can at least be challenged.

The repair is not complicated: an offence that covers every adult, crime tables that record every victim's gender, and a new national survey that asks men and boys too.

This is general information, not legal advice. If it happened to you, a missing row does not make it less real. See a doctor fast: HIV PEP must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after exposure [[who-pep]]. You can still go to the police, and legal services authorities give free legal aid [[nalsa]]. If you are under 18, POCSO covers you fully and the Child Helpline is 1098. Tele-MANAS, the Health Ministry's free, round-the-clock helpline, offers counselling to anyone on 14416 [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
sexual-violence-against-men-uncounted.hg:
Saalon tak, agar kisi ko jaanna hota ki India mein adult men kitni baar sexual assault ki report karte hain, toh dekhne ki ek hi jagah thi: National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ki annual tables ki ek akeli row, jiska naam tha "Unnatural Offences". Usme 2022 mein 987 cases the aur 2023 mein 888. 2024 ki tables mein us row mein sirf dashes hain, aur neeche ek footnote: "Sections deleted in BNS" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Us saal assaults band nahi hue. Ginti band ho gayi.

## Woh ek row jo men ko ginti thi: NCRB ki tables mein Section 377

Indian Penal Code ka Section 377 kisi bhi man, woman ya animal ke saath "carnal intercourse against the order of nature" ko punish karta tha [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. 6 September 2018 ko Navtej Singh Johar case mein Supreme Court ne ise read down kiya: same sex ke adults ke beech consensual sex crime nahi raha, lekin non-consensual acts aur bestiality offence bane rahe [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]].

IPC mein rape sirf ek woman ke against ho sakta tha, aur naye code mein bhi yahi hai. Isliye 2018 ke baad, jab kisi man ya transgender insaan par koi aadmi sexual assault karta, toh Section 377 hi woh charge tha jo lag sakta tha, aur uski row hi India ke paas ginti ke sabse kareeb ki cheez thi.

Yeh ginti kachchi thi. NCRB ne is row ko victim ke gender ya case ke type ke hisaab se alag nahi kiya, isliye koi nahi bata sakta ki 2023 ke 888 cases mein se kitne ek man ke the, kitne ek woman ke aur kitne animal ke [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 'Deleted in BNS': 2024 mein row gayab

1 July 2024 ko Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ne IPC ki jagah le li. Usne Section 377 hata diya aur uski jagah kuch nahi rakha [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. Uska rape provision, Section 63, "a man" ke "a woman" ke against kiye gaye act ki baat karta hai, isliye India mein ek adult man legally rape victim ho hi nahi sakta [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Statute badla, toh statistics bhi badal gaye. Sochiye, Pune ke ek paying-guest room mein rehne wala 24 saal ka ladka, jis par uski jaan-pehchaan ka ek aadmi sexual assault karta hai. 2023 mein uski FIR mein Section 377 likha ja sakta tha, aur woh un 888 mein se ek hota. Aaj police ke paas sirf general offences hain, jaise hurt ya wrongful confinement, aur kaunsa lagega yeh facts par depend karta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. NCRB har FIR ko ek hi baar ginta hai, uske sabse serious offence ke neeche [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Toh woh national data mein ek hurt case bankar darj hota hai, usi row mein jisme sadak ki maar-peet ginti hai.

## Records mein ladke: 44,567 mein se 892

NCRB ki rape table mein men ke liye koi jagah nahi hai. 2024 mein rape head ke neeche darj 29,742 victims mein se 792 ladkiyan 18 se kam umar ki thin aur 28,950 women thin [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yaani saare ke saare.

Male victims ko ab bhi ginne wala akela law bachchon wala hai. POCSO "a child" ke liye likha gaya hai, yaani 18 se kam umar ka koi bhi, isliye ladke cover hote hain [[pocso-act-2012]]. 2024 mein police ne POCSO ke tahat penetrative sexual assault ke 44,567 child victims darj kiye: 43,675 ladkiyan aur 892 ladke, yaani har 100 victims mein kareeb 2 ladke [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Table ke 2022 wale edition mein transgender bachchon ka bhi ek column tha. 38,444 victims mein usme ek bhi nahi tha: 414 ladke aur 38,030 ladkiyan [[ncrb-cii-2022-book1]]. Aisa zero shayad yeh zyada batata hai ki police station tak kaun pahunch paata hai, yeh nahi ki abuse kiska hota hai.

Apne 18th birthday par ek ladka us akeli table se bahar ho jaata hai jo use record kar sakti thi.

## Surveys kya dikhate hain jo police data nahi dikha sakta

Police data complaints ginta hai. Surveys logon se seedha poochte hain, aur unme ek alag hi desh dikhta hai. 2007 mein Ministry of Women and Child Development ne 13 states ke 12,447 bachchon ka survey kiya. Jin bachchon ne sexual abuse report kiya, unme 52.94% ladke the aur 47.06% ladkiyan, aur 13 mein se 9 states mein ladkon ka share zyada nikla [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

Is study ka sample random nahi tha aur usme jaan-boojhkar street aur working children shaamil kiye gaye the, jo zyada tar ladke hote hain, isliye 52.94% koi national rate nahi hai. Lekin yahi study dikhati hai ki police ki tables itni khaali kyun dikhti hain. Jin bachchon ne kaha ki unke saath sexual assault hua, unme se 72.1% ne kisi ko nahi bataya tha aur sirf 3.4% ne police ko report kiya tha. Jin young adults ke saath bachpan mein assault hua tha, unme se sirf 26.8% ne kabhi kisi ko bataya tha [[mwcd-study-child-abuse-2007]].

UNICEF ka global estimate hai ki aaj zinda 240 se 310 million boys aur men, yaani har 11 mein se kareeb 1, bachpan mein rape ya sexual assault ka shikaar hue [[unicef-sexual-violence-children-2024]].

India ke adult men ke liye toh koi purana survey bhi nahi hai. National Family Health Survey ka sexual violence wala figure women ke baare mein hai: NFHS-5 mein 18-49 saal ki 6% women ne kaha ki unhone sexual violence jhela hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Hamari research ko adult male survivors ka koi reliable national figure nahi mila, na police se, na kisi survey se.

## Jo gina nahi jaata, uske liye paisa bhi nahi aata

Budget numbers ke peeche chalta hai, aur India ka survivor support unhi logon ke aas-paas bana hai jinhe uski tables ginti hain. July 2026 tak operational 985 One Stop Centres April 2015 se June 2026 ke beech 15.20 lakh se zyada women ki madad kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. Jo law har hospital ko survivors ka free treatment karne ka order deta hai, woh rape, acid attack aur POCSO offences ka naam leta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]], aur Indian law mein rape ki victim sirf women ho sakti hain.

Iska matlab yeh bilkul nahi ki women ko kam mile. Problem arithmetic ki hai. Jo department ek counsellor ki post, ek helpline ya police training maangta hai, use dikhana padta hai ki kitne logon ko iski zaroorat hai. Adult male survivors ke liye official jawab ab ek dash hai. Dash zero se bhi bura hai, kyunki zero ko kam se kam challenge toh kiya ja sakta hai.

Ilaaj mushkil nahi hai: ek aisa offence jo har adult ko cover kare, crime tables jo har victim ka gender record karein, aur ek naya national survey jo men aur boys se bhi pooche.

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Agar yeh aapke saath hua hai, toh ek row ke gayab hone se woh kam real nahi ho jaata. Jaldi doctor ko dikhaiye: HIV PEP jitni jaldi ho sake aur exposure ke 72 hours ke andar shuru honi chahiye [[who-pep]]. Aap phir bhi police ke paas ja sakte hain, aur legal services authorities free legal aid deti hain [[nalsa]]. Agar aap 18 se kam hain, toh POCSO aapko poori tarah cover karta hai aur Child Helpline 1098 hai. Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, 24x7 helpline, 14416 par kisi ko bhi counselling deti hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

shakti-vahini-right-to-choose-partner.en:
On 27 March 2018 the Supreme Court decided a petition about khap panchayats, the clan and caste councils that take it on themselves to approve or forbid marriages. The bench of Chief Justice Dipak Misra and Justices A.M. Khanwilkar and D.Y. Chandrachud held that an adult's right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty, and ordered the state to protect couples who use it [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. More than seven years later, the national capital still had none of the fast-track courts it ordered. This is general information, not legal advice.

## The case: khap panchayats and couples who chose

Shakti Vahini, the organisation the case is named after, went to court over khap panchayats' interference in inter-caste marriages [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]]. A khap has no legal power over anyone's marriage. Its power is social: it declares a match unacceptable and leaves the family and the village to enforce the verdict.

Imagine a 22-year-old woman and a 24-year-old man from different castes who marry at a registrar's office in a small town. Her uncles call a meeting. The couple are told to separate or leave. The case asked one question: when that meeting is called, whose side is the state on?

A draft answer already existed. In August 2012 the Law Commission's 242nd Report had proposed a special law against interference with couples' marriages in the name of honour. In January 2018 the court's amicus curiae, Raju Ramachandran, urged that it be implemented, noting that more than five years had passed [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]].

## What the court held about liberty and choice

The court sided with the couple. The right to choose a life partner, it held, is a facet of individual liberty, and it ordered preventive, remedial and punitive measures to safeguard couples' autonomy against honour crimes [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. The choice belongs to the two adults, not to the family, the community or the clan.

That turns the family's story upside down. In the family's telling, the couple have done wrong and the elders are restoring order. In the court's, the couple have exercised their own liberty, and it is the people threatening them whom the state must act against.

> The marriage is the right. The threat is what the state must stop.

## The directions: special cells, fast-track courts, district monitoring

The court did not stop at principle. Its directions included [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]]:

- **special cells**, so that a threatened couple has somewhere to take a complaint;
- **fast-track and special courts** for honour-crime cases;
- **district-level monitoring committees** to keep watch.

Together they form a chain: stop the violence before it happens, protect the couple if it starts, prosecute quickly when prevention fails. With no special law on the statute book, these directions are the working rulebook.

## What happened next: missing courts and an unenacted law

**The courts were not built.** In December 2025 the Delhi High Court was told that no fast-track courts for honour-killing cases had been set up in the city. It closed the petition after asking the petitioners to approach its administrative side and the Delhi government [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]].

**The law was not passed.** The Law Commission's proposal was still unimplemented in January 2018 [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]], and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which replaced the IPC in 2024, has no separate offence of honour killing [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

**Charges were diluted.** In April 2025 the Supreme Court had to set aside orders of a trial court and the Allahabad High Court that let an alleged honour killing be tried as culpable homicide instead of murder. "This is a clear case of honour killing," the bench said, and ordered a murder charge [[barandbench-honour-killing-lesser-charge-2025]].

**The count stayed small.** NCRB recorded 25 honour killings in 2020, 33 in 2021, 18 in 2022 and 38 in 2023 [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. In 2024 it recorded 36, against 1,391 murders filed under "love affairs" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In June 2026 a Madras High Court judge observed that Tamil Nadu alone had seen 59 honour killings in ten years [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. NCRB's own tables record none in Tamil Nadu from 2020 to 2023 and one in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

We could not find a published state-by-state account of how many districts have a working special cell, or how many couples asked for protection and got it.

## If your family threatens you: what you can ask police and courts for

The ruling protects adults. A marriage in which the woman is under 18 or the man under 21 is a child marriage in law [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. If either of you is under 18, call the Child Helpline 1098.

If you are both adults and are being threatened:

- **In danger now:** call 112 [[mha-erss]].
- **Ask for protection in writing.** Give the district police chief a request that names who is threatening you, says you are adults who have chosen each other, and cites Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018). Ask if the district has a special cell. Keep a stamped copy.
- **Report it.** Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) lets you file a "Zero FIR" at any police station, wherever the offence took place, or report electronically, and you must get a free copy of the FIR [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Put every threat in writing.
- **Go to the High Court** if the police do not act. Free legal aid is available through the legal services authorities [[nalsa]].
- **Prepare quietly.** Keep proof of age and identity for both of you, and tell one trusted friend where you are.

Same-sex couples cannot yet marry: in October 2023 the Supreme Court declined to recognise same-sex marriage and left it to Parliament [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. Threats against them can still be reported, and 112 and a written complaint are open to queer couples too.

Shakti Vahini settled whose decision a marriage is. It could not make a police station answer the phone. Until the cells, courts and committees exist in every district, the judgment works best for couples who know its name. Now you do.
shakti-vahini-right-to-choose-partner.hg:
27 March 2018 ko Supreme Court ne khap panchayats par ek petition ka faisla sunaya. Khap panchayats woh clan aur caste councils hain jo khud hi tay karne lagti hain ki kaun si shaadi manzoor hai aur kaun si nahi. Chief Justice Dipak Misra aur Justices A.M. Khanwilkar aur D.Y. Chandrachud ki bench ne kaha ki apna life partner chunne ka adult ka right individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur state ko order diya ki jo couples is right ka use karte hain unhe protect kare [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Saat saal se zyada baad bhi desh ki rajdhani mein un fast-track courts mein se ek bhi nahi tha jinka order diya gaya tha. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Case: khap panchayats aur woh couples jinhone khud chuna

Shakti Vahini, woh organisation jiske naam par yeh case hai, inter-caste marriages mein khap panchayats ke dakhal ke khilaf court gayi thi [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]]. Kisi ki shaadi par khap ke paas koi legal power nahi hai. Uski taaqat social hai: woh ek rishte ko na-manzoor ghoshit karti hai aur faisla lagu karne ka kaam family aur gaon par chhod deti hai.

Imagine karo ek 22 saal ki ladki aur 24 saal ka ladka, alag castes se, jo ek chhote shehar ke registrar office mein shaadi kar lete hain. Ladki ke chacha-tau meeting bulate hain. Couple se kaha jaata hai ki alag ho jao ya gaon chhod do. Case ne ek hi sawaal poochha: jab woh meeting bulayi jaati hai, tab state kiski taraf khadi hoti hai?

Ek draft jawab pehle se maujood tha. August 2012 mein Law Commission ki 242nd Report ne honour ke naam par couples ki shaadiyon mein dakhal ke khilaf ek special law ka proposal diya tha. January 2018 mein court ke amicus curiae Raju Ramachandran ne maang ki ki ise lagu kiya jaaye, aur yaad dilaya ki paanch saal se zyada beet chuke hain [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]].

## Court ne liberty aur choice par kya kaha

Court couple ki taraf khada hua. Usne kaha ki life partner chunne ka right individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur honour crimes ke khilaf couples ki autonomy bachane ke liye preventive, remedial aur punitive measures ka order diya [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Yeh choice do adults ki hai, family, community ya clan ki nahi.

Isse family ki kahani ulat jaati hai. Family ke version mein couple ne galti ki hai aur bade-buzurg order wapas la rahe hain. Court ke version mein couple ne apni liberty use ki hai, aur state ko action unke khilaf lena hai jo unhe dhamka rahe hain.

> Shaadi right hai. Dhamki woh cheez hai jise state ko rokna hai.

## Directions: special cells, fast-track courts, district monitoring

Court sirf principle par nahi ruka. Uski directions mein shaamil the [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]]:

- **special cells**, taaki jis couple ko dhamki mil rahi hai uske paas complaint le jaane ki koi jagah ho;
- honour-crime cases ke liye **fast-track aur special courts**;
- nazar rakhne ke liye **district-level monitoring committees**.

Saath mila kar yeh ek chain banate hain: violence hone se pehle roko, shuru ho jaaye toh couple ko protect karo, aur prevention fail ho toh jaldi prosecute karo. Statute book mein koi special law nahi hai, isliye yahi directions kaam-chalau rulebook hain.

## Aage kya hua: gayab courts aur woh law jo bana hi nahi

**Courts bane hi nahi.** December 2025 mein Delhi High Court ko bataya gaya ki shehar mein honour-killing cases ke liye koi fast-track court nahi bana hai. Court ne petitioners se kaha ki woh uske administrative side aur Delhi government ke paas jaayein, aur petition band kar di [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]].

**Law pass nahi hua.** Law Commission ka proposal January 2018 tak lagu nahi hua tha [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]], aur Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), jisne 2024 mein IPC ki jagah li, usme honour killing ka koi alag offence nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

**Charges halke kar diye gaye.** April 2025 mein Supreme Court ko ek trial court aur Allahabad High Court ke woh orders radd karne pade jinhone ek alleged honour killing ko murder ki jagah culpable homicide ke roop mein chalne diya tha. Bench ne kaha, "This is a clear case of honour killing," aur murder ka charge lagane ka order diya [[barandbench-honour-killing-lesser-charge-2025]].

**Ginti chhoti hi rahi.** NCRB ne 2020 mein 25 honour killings darj kin, 2021 mein 33, 2022 mein 18 aur 2023 mein 38 [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. 2024 mein usne 36 darj kin, jabki "love affairs" ke neeche 1,391 murders darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. June 2026 mein Madras High Court ke ek judge ne kaha ki akele Tamil Nadu mein das saal mein 59 honour killings hui hain [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. NCRB ki apni tables mein Tamil Nadu ke liye 2020 se 2023 tak ek bhi nahi, aur 2024 mein sirf ek darj hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Hume aisa koi published state-by-state hisaab nahi mila jo bataye ki kitne districts mein special cell sach mein kaam kar raha hai, ya kitne couples ne protection maangi aur kitnon ko mili.

## Agar family dhamki de: police aur courts se aap kya maang sakte ho

Yeh ruling adults ko protect karti hai. Jis shaadi mein ladki 18 se kam ya ladka 21 se kam umar ka ho, woh law mein child marriage hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Agar aap dono mein se koi 18 se kam hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

Agar aap dono adults ho aur aapko dhamkiyan mil rahi hain:

- **Abhi khatra hai:** 112 par call karo [[mha-erss]].
- **Protection likh kar maango.** District police chief ko ek request do jisme likha ho ki kaun dhamka raha hai, ki aap dono adults ho jinhone ek-doosre ko chuna hai, aur jisme Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018) ka zikr ho. Poochho ki district mein special cell hai ya nahi. Stamped copy apne paas rakho.
- **Report karo.** Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ka Section 173 aapko kisi bhi police station mein "Zero FIR" file karne deta hai, offence chahe kahin bhi hua ho, ya electronically report karne deta hai, aur FIR ki free copy aapko milni hi chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Har dhamki likhit mein do.
- **High Court jao** agar police kuch na kare. Legal services authorities ke through free legal aid milti hai [[nalsa]].
- **Chupchap tayyari rakho.** Dono ke age aur identity proof saath rakho, aur ek bharosemand dost ko batao ki aap kahan ho.

Same-sex couples abhi shaadi nahi kar sakte: October 2023 mein Supreme Court ne same-sex marriage ko recognise karne se mana kar diya aur faisla Parliament par chhod diya [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. Unhe mili dhamkiyon ki report phir bhi ho sakti hai, aur 112 aur likhit complaint queer couples ke liye bhi khule hain.

Shakti Vahini ne yeh tay kar diya ki shaadi kiska faisla hai. Woh yeh nahi kar saka ki police station phone uthaye. Jab tak har district mein cells, courts aur committees nahi ban jaati, yeh judgment un couples ke liye sabse achha kaam karta hai jo iska naam jaante hain. Ab aap jaante ho.

stalking-sold-as-romance-indian-cinema.en:
You know the scene, whatever language you watch films in. He sees her at a bus stop or on a college staircase and decides she is the one. She says no. He follows her scooter, learns her timetable and sends his friends to block her way. By the last song she is smiling. Off screen, Indian law has had a name for that sequence since 2013: stalking [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. Police registered 9,865 cases of it in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. What follows is general information, not legal advice.

## The pursuit script: 'no' as the start of a love story

The script has four beats. He chooses her without asking. She refuses, and the film reads the refusal as shyness, pride or a test of his sincerity. He escalates: turns up on her route, gets her number from a friend, calls at night, says he cannot live without her. She gives in, and the film calls it love. The street version fits in one line: "ladki ki na mein haan hoti hai", a girl's no hides a yes.

What the script leaves out is her side. The changed bus route. The brother sent along as an escort. The coaching class she is told to drop because "something might happen". On screen, his persistence costs nothing and wins him the heroine.

No dataset shows that a film made any particular man follow a woman, and this story does not claim it. What can be traced is the language. For decades, following and pestering women in public was called "eve teasing", as if it were mischief. Courts used the phrase too. On 16 August 2023 the Supreme Court's Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes told judges to write "street sexual harassment" instead [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

## From 'eve teasing' to a crime: what changed in 2013

Until 2013, the Indian Penal Code (IPC) had no offence called stalking. The Justice J.S. Verma Committee, set up in December 2012 after the Delhi gang rape, reported on 23 January 2013 [[thehindu-verma-2013]]. The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act that followed, deemed in force from 3 February 2013 [[indiacode-cla-2013]], created new offences: acid attack, sexual harassment (Section 354A), disrobing (354B), voyeurism (354C) and stalking (354D) [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]].

Since 1 July 2024 the offence has been Section 78 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) [[air-new-criminal-laws-2024]]. It covers a man who follows a woman and contacts her, or tries to, repeatedly, to foster personal interaction despite a clear indication that she is not interested, and a man who monitors her use of the internet, email or other electronic communication. The punishment is up to three years in prison on a first conviction and up to five on a repeat [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Being in love is not listed as a defence.

> The second act of the love story is the definition of the crime.

## What 9,865 complaints in 2024 tell us, and what they leave out

| Year | Stalking cases registered by police |
|---|---|
| 2016 | 7,190 |
| 2018 | 9,438 |
| 2021 | 9,285 |
| 2023 | 10,495 |
| 2024 | 9,865 |

The rows come from three editions of NCRB's Crime in India [[ncrb-cii-2018]] [[ncrb-cii-2021]] [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The 2024 figure works out to 1.4 cases per lakh women [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The dip in 2024 does not mean fewer women were followed. NCRB counts FIRs, not incidents, and counts each FIR once, under its most serious offence [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. An FIR in which stalking is followed by an assault or a killing is counted under the graver crime.

Most harassment never becomes an FIR at all. In 2005, 12% of households told the India Human Development Survey that unmarried girls in their neighbourhood were "sometimes" or "often" harassed, while police records implied 0.06% of households, a gap of about 200 times [[aej-iyer-political-voice-2012]].

Those who do file, wait. In 2024, courts convicted in 25.2% of the stalking trials they completed, and 52,273 stalking cases, 92.8% of those before the courts, were still pending when the year ended [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Imagine a 19-year-old in Kanpur who takes the same shared auto to coaching every morning. A man starts waiting at the stop. She says she is not interested. He gets her number from a classmate, messages every night, then stands outside her gate. Her family's answer is to stop the coaching. Everything he did after her refusal is what Section 78 describes. The only life that changed was hers.

## Who the law protects: the BNS wording and its gaps

By its wording, stalking under Section 78 can be committed only by a man, against a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. That is still the text, although the Home Ministry said in July 2024 that various offences against women and children had been made gender-neutral in the BNS, "covering all victims and perpetrators regardless of gender" [[pib-new-criminal-laws-2024]]. A man hounded by an ex-partner, or a woman pursued by another woman, is not covered.

Some cover exists elsewhere. Anyone under 18 is protected by POCSO, whatever their gender [[pocso-act-2012]]. A transgender person can use Section 18(d) of the Transgender Persons Act, which punishes abuse that endangers their safety or well-being, but only with six months to two years [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

## If you are being followed: first steps

One clear no is enough. Sent as a message, it is also a record of the "clear indication" the law asks for.

- **Write it down.** Date, time, place, what he did, who saw it. Keep copies of messages with a friend.
- **Tell people you trust.** Stalking works best on someone handling it alone.
- **Report it.** You can report at any police station, wherever it happened, or electronically, and a woman officer must record a woman's stalking complaint [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. For online stalking, also use cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930 [[pib-mha-cyber-awareness-2026]]. In immediate danger, call 112.
- **If you are his friend,** do not pass on her number or her route. Tell him the answer was no.

The film cuts from her last refusal to a wedding. Real life has no such cut. When she says no, the story is over. Following her after that has a section number.
stalking-sold-as-romance-indian-cinema.hg:
Yeh scene aapne dekha hai, film chahe kisi bhi language ki ho. Ladka ladki ko bus stop par ya college ki seedhiyon par dekhta hai aur tay kar leta hai ki yahi hai. Ladki mana karti hai. Ladka uski scooty ka peecha karta hai, uska timetable yaad kar leta hai aur apne doston ko uska raasta rokne bhejta hai. Aakhri gaane tak ladki muskura rahi hoti hai. Screen ke bahar, Indian law ke paas 2013 se is poore sequence ka ek naam hai: stalking [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. 2024 mein police ne iske 9,865 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aage jo likha hai woh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Pursuit script: jahan 'na' se love story shuru hoti hai

Is script ke chaar beats hain. Hero bina poochhe heroine ko chun leta hai. Heroine mana karti hai, aur film us 'na' ko sharm, ghamand ya hero ki sachchai ka test bana deti hai. Hero escalate karta hai: uske raaste par pahunch jaata hai, kisi dost se uska number nikalwa leta hai, raat ko call karta hai, kehta hai ki uske bina jee nahi sakta. Heroine maan jaati hai, aur film ise pyaar keh deti hai. Sadak wala version ek hi line mein aa jaata hai: "ladki ki na mein haan hoti hai".

Script mein jo nahi dikhta, woh ladki ki side hai. Badla hua bus route. Escort bana kar saath bheja gaya bhai. Woh coaching class jo use chhodne ko kaha jaata hai, kyunki "kuch ho gaya toh". Screen par hero ki zid ki koi keemat nahi hoti, aur inaam mein heroine mil jaati hai.

Koi dataset yeh nahi dikhata ki kisi film ne kisi khaas aadmi se kisi aurat ka peecha karwaya, aur yeh story aisa claim nahi karti. Jo trace ho sakti hai, woh language hai. Dashakon tak public mein auraton ka peecha karne aur unhe tang karne ko "eve teasing" kaha gaya, jaise yeh koi shararat ho. Courts ne bhi yahi phrase use kiya. 16 August 2023 ko Supreme Court ki Handbook on Combating Gender Stereotypes ne judges se kaha ki iski jagah "street sexual harassment" likhein [[sc-handbook-gender-stereotypes-2023]].

## 'Eve teasing' se crime tak: 2013 mein kya badla

2013 tak Indian Penal Code (IPC) mein stalking naam ka koi offence nahi tha. Delhi gang rape ke baad December 2012 mein bani Justice J.S. Verma Committee ne 23 January 2013 ko apni report di [[thehindu-verma-2013]]. Iske baad aaye Criminal Law (Amendment) Act ne, jo 3 February 2013 se lagu maana gaya [[indiacode-cla-2013]], naye offences banaye: acid attack, sexual harassment (Section 354A), disrobing (354B), voyeurism (354C) aur stalking (354D) [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]].

1 July 2024 se yeh offence Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 78 hai [[air-new-criminal-laws-2024]]. Isme woh aadmi aata hai jo kisi aurat ka peecha karta hai aur personal interaction badhane ke liye use baar-baar contact karta hai ya karne ki koshish karta hai, jabki aurat saaf dikha chuki hai ki use interest nahi hai. Isme woh aadmi bhi aata hai jo uske internet, email ya kisi aur electronic communication par nazar rakhta hai. Saza: pehli conviction par teen saal tak ki jail, aur dobara conviction par paanch saal tak [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Defence ki list mein "main pyaar mein tha" kahin nahi likha.

> Love story ka second act hi crime ki definition hai.

## 2024 ki 9,865 complaints kya batati hain, aur kya chhod deti hain

| Saal | Police ne stalking ke kitne cases register kiye |
|---|---|
| 2016 | 7,190 |
| 2018 | 9,438 |
| 2021 | 9,285 |
| 2023 | 10,495 |
