Kisi bhi police station ko cognizable offence ki information record karni hoti hai, chahe woh kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), aur aapko FIR ki free copy deni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. 2020 ke rules ne har state se Transgender Protection Cell banane ko kaha tha, lekin November 2025 tak sirf 20 states aur union territories mein yeh bana tha [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. Pata kijiye ki aapke state mein hai ya nahi.

Agar darr aur paperwork aapko thaka rahe hain, toh Tele-MANAS, Health Ministry ki free, 24x7 helpline, 14416 par kisi ko bhi counselling deti hai, transgender persons ko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Card ek paperwork hai. Law us paperwork se aapki apni baat nikaal sakta hai ya nahi, yeh ab Supreme Court ko decide karna hai.

transgender-violence-punishment-gap-prot.en:
In March 2026 Parliament rewrote the punishments section of the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act. It added a crime that can put a person in prison for life: kidnapping someone and causing them grievous hurt to force them to assume a transgender identity. In the same section it left the punishment for sexually abusing a transgender person where it stood in 2019, at six months to two years and a fine [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Read the two clauses side by side and you can see whose safety the law was built around.

## The new crime: 'forcing' a transgender identity

The new clauses are Sections 18(e) and 18(f). When the victim is an adult, the punishment is rigorous imprisonment that "shall not be less than ten years but which may extend to imprisonment for life", with a fine of at least Rs 2 lakh. When the victim is a child, it is life imprisonment and a fine of at least Rs 5 lakh [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

Kidnapping and grievous hurt are serious crimes, and no one should be forced into any identity. The issue is proportion. In a law named for the protection of transgender persons, the heaviest sentence punishes making someone transgender. The lighter one, as the next clause shows, is for violating someone who already is.

## The old cap: six months to two years for sexual abuse

Section 18(d) covers anyone who harms, injures or endangers a transgender person, including by "physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal and emotional abuse and economic abuse". The punishment is imprisonment of "not less than six months but which may extend to two years and with fine" [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. One clause and one range cover everything from verbal abuse to sexual abuse.

| Offence | Punishment |
|---|---|
| Kidnapping and grievous hurt to force a transgender identity on an adult, Section 18(e) | 10 years to life |
| The same offence against a child, Section 18(f) | Life imprisonment |
| Rape of a woman, Section 64 BNS | At least 10 years, up to life |
| Sexual abuse of a transgender person, Section 18(d) | 6 months to 2 years |
| Voluntarily causing hurt, Section 115(2) BNS | Up to 1 year |

Consider a hypothetical. A transgender woman in Nagpur is sexually assaulted by a man she knows. If the law counted her as a woman, he would face a rape charge. Because it does not, the specific offence on the books for what he did is Section 18(d).

> The most a court can give for sexual abuse of a transgender person is two years. The least it can give for the rape of a woman is ten.

## Why rape law does not reach trans survivors

Section 63 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) defines rape as an act by "a man" against "a woman". The code says the pronoun "he" covers any person, "whether male, female or transgender", but it defines a "woman" as a female human being, which keeps rape limited to a man assaulting a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Rape carries at least 10 years' rigorous imprisonment under Section 64 [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Until 1 July 2024 there was a fallback. Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code punished non-consensual "carnal intercourse against the order of nature" with up to life imprisonment [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. The BNS has no counterpart, so non-consensual penetrative sex against a transgender person is not rape under the new code, and no specific offence replaced it [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. What remains are general offences such as voluntarily causing hurt, which carries at most one year in prison, a fine of up to Rs 10,000, or both [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Parliament was told. On 10 November 2023 its Standing Committee on Home Affairs warned that dropping Section 377 would leave non-consensual sexual offences against men, transgender persons and animals unpunished, and recommended keeping it. The government did not [[prs-standing-committee-bns-2023]]. In 2026 Parliament reopened the very section that sets these punishments, added the forced-identity crime, and left Section 18(d) as it was.

## Protection on the ground: 20 cells, 21 shelters

Protection on the ground is thin too. The 2020 rules required every state to set up a Transgender Protection Cell. By November 2025, five years later, only 20 of India's 36 states and union territories had one, and 25 had a Transgender Welfare Board [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]].

For someone thrown out of home after an assault, the safety net is the Garima Greh, a shelter home for destitute transgender persons under the SMILE scheme. As of November 2025 there were 21 of them, in 17 states [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. In August 2025, 429 transgender persons were living in the shelters the ministry supported [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. The government's own count of the community, from Census 2011, is 4,87,803 people, and that is widely seen as an undercount [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]].

## What a transgender survivor can do today

This is general information, not legal advice. If you are in danger now, call 112 [[mha-erss]].

**Medical care first.** HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) must start as soon as possible and no later than 72 hours after exposure, and is taken for 28 days [[who-pep]]. The law that obliges every hospital to treat survivors free names rape, acid attack and POCSO offences [[indiacode-bnss-2023]], so an adult transgender survivor is not expressly covered. Go anyway, and ask for PEP by name.

**Report, if you choose to.** Any police station must record information about a cognizable offence wherever it happened (a Zero FIR) and give you a free copy [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. What police can charge depends on the facts: Section 18(d), along with general BNS offences. A victim can also apply for compensation directly to the State or District Legal Services Authority, even if the offender is never traced [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

**If the survivor is under 18.** POCSO defines a child as any person below 18, so it protects a transgender child in full [[pocso-act-2012]].

Free legal aid is available through the legal services authorities [[nalsa]], and Tele-MANAS offers free counselling round the clock on 14416, including to transgender persons [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. A two-year ceiling in a statute says something about Parliament. It says nothing about what you are owed.
transgender-violence-punishment-gap-prot.hg:
March 2026 mein Parliament ne Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act ka punishments wala section dobara likha. Usne ek aisa crime joda jo kisi ko zindagi bhar ke liye jail bhej sakta hai: kisi ko kidnap karna aur grievous hurt pahunchana, taaki woh transgender identity apnane par majboor ho. Usi section mein transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza wahin chhod di gayi jahan woh 2019 mein thi, yaani chhe mahine se do saal aur fine [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Dono clauses ko saath rakhkar padhiye, toh dikh jaata hai ki yeh law kiski safety ko dhyan mein rakhkar bana hai.

## Naya crime: transgender identity 'force' karna

Naye clauses hain Sections 18(e) aur 18(f). Jab victim adult ho, toh saza rigorous imprisonment hai jo "shall not be less than ten years but which may extend to imprisonment for life", saath mein kam se kam Rs 2 lakh ka fine. Jab victim child ho, toh saza life imprisonment aur kam se kam Rs 5 lakh ka fine hai [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

Kidnapping aur grievous hurt serious crimes hain, aur kisi ko bhi kisi identity mein zabardasti nahi dhakela jaana chahiye. Mudda proportion ka hai. Jis law ke naam mein hi transgender persons ki protection hai, usme sabse bhaari saza kisi ko transgender banane par hai. Halki saza, jaisa agla clause dikhata hai, us insaan ke saath violation par hai jo pehle se transgender hai.

## Purani limit: sexual abuse par chhe mahine se do saal

Section 18(d) har us insaan par lagu hota hai jo kisi transgender insaan ko harm, injure ya endanger karta hai, jisme "physical abuse, sexual abuse, verbal and emotional abuse and economic abuse" shamil hai. Saza hai imprisonment "not less than six months but which may extend to two years and with fine" [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Ek hi clause aur ek hi range, verbal abuse se lekar sexual abuse tak sab kuch ke liye.

| Offence | Saza |
|---|---|
| Adult ko kidnap karke aur grievous hurt dekar transgender identity force karna, Section 18(e) | 10 saal se life |
| Yahi offence child ke khilaaf, Section 18(f) | Life imprisonment |
| Woman ka rape, Section 64 BNS | Kam se kam 10 saal, life tak |
| Transgender insaan ka sexual abuse, Section 18(d) | 6 mahine se 2 saal |
| Voluntarily causing hurt, Section 115(2) BNS | 1 saal tak |

Ek hypothetical sochiye. Nagpur mein ek transgender woman par ek aisa aadmi sexual assault karta hai jise woh jaanti hai. Agar law use woman ginta, toh us aadmi par rape ka charge lagta. Law use woman nahi ginta, isliye usne jo kiya uske liye kitaabon mein jo specific offence hai, woh Section 18(d) hai.

> Transgender insaan ke sexual abuse par court zyada se zyada do saal de sakta hai. Woman ke rape par use kam se kam dus saal deni hi padti hai.

## Rape law trans survivors tak kyun nahi pahunchta

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 63 rape ko "a man" ka "a woman" ke khilaaf kiya gaya act batata hai. Code kehta hai ki pronoun "he" kisi bhi insaan ke liye hai, "whether male, female or transgender", lekin woh "woman" ko female human being define karta hai, jisse rape ek man ke ek woman par assault tak hi limited rehta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Section 64 ke tahat rape ki saza kam se kam 10 saal ki rigorous imprisonment hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

1 July 2024 tak ek fallback tha. Indian Penal Code ka Section 377 non-consensual "carnal intercourse against the order of nature" par life imprisonment tak ki saza deta tha [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. BNS mein iska koi counterpart nahi hai, isliye transgender insaan ke saath non-consensual penetrative sex naye code mein rape nahi hai, aur uski jagah koi specific offence nahi aaya [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Jo bacha hai woh general offences hain, jaise voluntarily causing hurt, jiski saza zyada se zyada ek saal jail, Rs 10,000 tak fine, ya dono hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Parliament ko bataya gaya tha. 10 November 2023 ko uski Standing Committee on Home Affairs ne warning di ki Section 377 hatane se men, transgender persons aur animals ke khilaaf non-consensual sexual offences ki koi saza nahi bachegi, aur ise rakhne ki recommendation di. Sarkar ne yeh nahi maana [[prs-standing-committee-bns-2023]]. 2026 mein Parliament ne wahi section dobara khola jo yeh punishments tay karta hai, forced-identity wala crime joda, aur Section 18(d) ko jaisa tha waisa chhod diya.

## Zameen par protection: 20 cells, 21 shelters

Zameen par protection bhi kamzor hai. 2020 ke rules ne har state se Transgender Protection Cell banane ko kaha tha. November 2025 tak, yaani paanch saal baad, India ke 36 states aur union territories mein se sirf 20 mein yeh cell tha, aur 25 mein Transgender Welfare Board tha [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]].

Assault ke baad jise ghar se nikaal diya jaaye, uske liye safety net Garima Greh hai, yaani SMILE scheme ke tahat destitute transgender persons ka shelter home. November 2025 tak aise 21 shelters the, 17 states mein [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]]. August 2025 mein ministry ke support wale shelters mein 429 transgender persons reh rahe the [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Community ki sarkar ki apni ginti, Census 2011 se, 4,87,803 log hai, aur ise aam taur par undercount maana jaata hai [[pib-transgender-rights-backgrounder-2025]].

## Aaj ek transgender survivor ke paas kya raaste hain

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Agar aap abhi khatre mein hain, toh 112 par call kijiye [[mha-erss]].

**Pehle medical care.** HIV post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) jitni jaldi ho sake aur exposure ke 72 hours ke andar shuru honi chahiye, aur 28 din tak li jaati hai [[who-pep]]. Jo law har hospital ko survivors ka free treatment karne ko kehta hai, woh rape, acid attack aur POCSO offences ka naam leta hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]], isliye ek adult transgender survivor usme saaf taur par cover nahi hai. Phir bhi jaiye, aur naam lekar PEP maangiye.

**Report kijiye, agar aap chahein.** Kisi bhi police station ko cognizable offence ki information record karni hoti hai, chahe woh kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR), aur aapko free copy deni hoti hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Police kaunsa charge laga sakti hai, yeh facts par depend karta hai: Section 18(d), saath mein general BNS offences. Compensation ke liye victim ki taraf se seedhe State ya District Legal Services Authority ko bhi apply kiya ja sakta hai, chahe offender kabhi trace na ho [[indiacode-bnss-2023]].

**Agar survivor ki umar 18 se kam hai.** POCSO 18 se kam umar ke har insaan ko child maanta hai, isliye woh ek transgender child ko poori tarah protect karta hai [[pocso-act-2012]].

Free legal aid legal services authorities ke zariye milti hai [[nalsa]], aur Tele-MANAS 14416 par free, 24x7 counselling deta hai, transgender persons ko bhi [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]]. Statute mein do saal ki ceiling Parliament ke baare mein kuch batati hai. Aapka haq kya hai, is baare mein woh kuch nahi batati.

what-queer-indians-still-cannot-do.en:
On 6 September 2018, five judges of the Supreme Court unanimously read down Section 377 of the Indian Penal Code in *Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India*. Consensual sex between adults of the same sex stopped being a crime; non-consensual acts and bestiality stayed offences [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. That day is often remembered as the day queer Indians became equal. It was the day they stopped being criminals. Equality is a longer list, and eight years later most of it is still unticked.

## What 2018 changed, and what it did not

Navtej ended a long back-and-forth. The Delhi High Court had decriminalised consensual gay sex in *Naz Foundation* on 2 July 2009. The Supreme Court reversed it on 11 December 2013 in *Suresh Kumar Koushal*, making it a crime again for nearly five years [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]].

But decriminalisation is a floor, not a set of rights. It tells the police what they may not do. It does not tell a marriage registrar, an adoption agency, a landlord or an employer what they must do. Here is where each right stands.

| Right | Where it stands in November 2026 |
|---|---|
| A consensual same-sex relationship | Not a crime since 2018 (Navtej Singh Johar) |
| Marriage | Not recognised; the Supreme Court left it to Parliament (2023) |
| Civil union | Not recognised; the Supreme Court split 3:2 against it (2023) |
| Joint adoption by a queer couple | Not allowed; the same 3:2 split (2023) |
| Protection from discrimination | Sexual orientation named only in mental health law (2017) |
| Protection from forced sex for adult men | No specific offence since 1 July 2024 |
| Protection from sexual abuse for trans people | Only a transgender-law offence, capped at two years |

## Marriage, civil unions and adoption: the 2023 refusals

On 17 October 2023, a five-judge bench in *Supriyo v. Union of India* unanimously held that there is no fundamental right to marry, and declined to recognise same-sex marriage, leaving it to Parliament [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. On civil unions, the bench split 3:2 against. Chief Justice Chandrachud and Justice Kaul would have recognised the right; Justices Bhat, Kohli and Narasimha held that it does not exist. The same 3:2 majority read the adoption rules as allowing joint adoption only by married couples, which shuts queer couples out [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]].

One door did open: the court held that a transgender person in a heterosexual relationship can marry under existing marriage laws [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. On 9 January 2025, it dismissed the review petitions, finding no error apparent in its judgment [[barandbench-supriyo-review-dismissed-2025]].

Consider two women in Pune who have shared a flat, a home loan and a dog for twelve years. In law they are two unrelated adults. They cannot marry. They cannot adopt a child together. If one dies without a will, the other has no claim as a spouse.

What the Centre set up instead, on 16 April 2024, was a six-member committee chaired by the Cabinet Secretary to recommend measures against discrimination, violence and involuntary medical treatment of queer persons [[gazette-queer-committee-order-2024]]. Its terms of reference do not mention legal recognition of couples. We could find no published report from it.

## Discrimination: where the law protects and where it is silent

Search the statute book for sexual orientation as a protected ground, and the clearest hit is a health law. Section 21 of the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 bars discrimination in mental health care on any basis, naming gender, sex and sexual orientation [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. It protects a queer person who needs mental health care. It does not reach a landlord who turns away a gay couple or an employer who sacks a lesbian manager.

Protection from the so-called cure comes from a court and a regulator, not from Parliament. In June 2021 the Madras High Court directed that any attempt to medically "cure" or change a person's sexual orientation or gender identity be prohibited, with action up to withdrawal of the professional's licence [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. In August 2022 the National Medical Commission made conversion therapy professional misconduct for doctors [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

And the one law written for gender minorities now shuts people out. Since the 2026 amendment, the transgender Act says its definition does not include "persons with different sexual orientations and self-perceived sexual identities" [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

## Sexual violence and the 2024 gap

Navtej kept Section 377 alive for one purpose: non-consensual acts. So for a gay man or a transgender person assaulted by a man, the section that had once made their relationships a crime was the one that protected them. When the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita replaced the IPC on 1 July 2024, Section 377 was dropped and nothing replaced it [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. The new rape law, Section 63, covers only a man assaulting a woman [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Police registered 888 cases under Section 377 in 2023. In the 2024 data, the row is gone [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Sexual abuse of a transgender person carries six months to two years in prison, a range the 2026 amendment left untouched [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Our myth-buster on how the "gender-neutral" new code ended up agreeing that men cannot be raped follows this gap in detail.

## What is pending: courts, committees and the 2026 amendment

In 2026 Parliament did act on gender identity, and it narrowed rights instead of widening them. The transgender amendment was introduced in the Lok Sabha on 13 March 2026 and cleared both houses by 25 March [[prs-transgender-amendment-bill-2026]]. In force since 25 May 2026, it deletes the right to self-perceived gender identity and lets a District Magistrate issue a transgender certificate only after a medical board's recommendation [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. On 17 August 2026, the Union told a Supreme Court bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant that identity cards already issued would continue to operate while the challenge is heard [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]].

On the missing sexual offence, the Delhi High Court revived a public interest case in March 2026, saying the government's decision was "nowhere in sight" [[theprint-pti-delhi-hc-restores-pil-2026]]. On marriage, the Supreme Court has spoken twice and pointed to Parliament both times.

This is general information, not legal advice. Courts removed a crime and opened a few small doors. Parliament has not legislated for queer couples at all, and in 2026 it took away transgender people's legal right to name their own gender.
what-queer-indians-still-cannot-do.hg:
6 September 2018 ko Supreme Court ke paanch judges ne *Navtej Singh Johar v. Union of India* mein Indian Penal Code ke Section 377 ko unanimously read down kiya. Same-sex adults ke beech consent wala sex crime nahi raha; bina consent wale acts aur bestiality offence bane rahe [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]]. Us din ko aksar aise yaad kiya jaata hai jaise queer Indians usi din barabar ho gaye the. Asal mein us din woh bas criminal hona band hue. Barabari ki list isse kaafi lambi hai, aur aath saal baad bhi uska zyada tar hissa adhoora pada hai.

## 2018 ne kya badla, aur kya nahi

Navtej ne ek lambi kheench-taan khatam ki. Delhi High Court ne 2 July 2009 ko *Naz Foundation* mein consent wale gay sex ko decriminalise kiya tha. Supreme Court ne 11 December 2013 ko *Suresh Kumar Koushal* mein woh faisla palat diya, aur yeh kareeb paanch saal ke liye phir se crime ban gaya [[scobserver-navtej-johar-2018]].

Lekin decriminalisation sirf ek floor hai, rights ka poora set nahi. Woh police ko batata hai ki woh kya nahi kar sakti. Woh marriage registrar, adoption agency, landlord ya employer ko yeh nahi batata ki unhe kya karna hi hoga. Har haq aaj kahan khada hai, yeh neeche dekho.

| Haq | November 2026 mein kahan khada hai |
|---|---|
| Consent wala same-sex relationship | 2018 se crime nahi (Navtej Singh Johar) |
| Shaadi | Recognised nahi; Supreme Court ne Parliament par chhoda (2023) |
| Civil union | Recognised nahi; Supreme Court 3:2 se khilaaf raha (2023) |
| Queer couple ka joint adoption | Allowed nahi; wahi 3:2 split (2023) |
| Discrimination se protection | Sexual orientation ka naam sirf mental health law mein hai (2017) |
| Adult men ke liye forced sex se protection | 1 July 2024 se koi specific offence nahi |
| Trans logon ke liye sexual abuse se protection | Sirf transgender law ka offence, maximum do saal |

## Shaadi, civil union aur adoption: 2023 ke inkaar

17 October 2023 ko *Supriyo v. Union of India* mein paanch judges ki bench ne unanimously kaha ki shaadi ka koi fundamental right nahi hai. Usne same-sex marriage ko recognise karne se mana kiya aur yeh sawaal Parliament par chhod diya [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. Civil unions par bench 3:2 se khilaaf bat gayi. Chief Justice Chandrachud aur Justice Kaul yeh haq maan lete; Justices Bhat, Kohli aur Narasimha ne kaha ki aisa koi haq hai hi nahi. Usi 3:2 majority ne adoption rules ko aise padha ki joint adoption sirf married couples kar sakte hain, aur isse queer couples bahar ho jaate hain [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]].

Ek darwaaza zaroor khula: court ne kaha ki heterosexual relationship mein ek transgender insaan maujooda marriage laws ke under shaadi kar sakta hai [[scobserver-supriyo-judgment-summary-2023]]. 9 January 2025 ko court ne review petitions dismiss kar di, kyunki use apne judgment mein koi saaf galti nahi dikhi [[barandbench-supriyo-review-dismissed-2025]].

Socho, Pune mein do auratein hain jo baarah saal se ek flat, ek home loan aur ek dog share kar rahi hain. Law ki nazar mein woh do unrelated adults hain. Woh shaadi nahi kar sakti. Saath mein bachcha adopt nahi kar sakti. Agar ek ki maut bina will ke ho jaaye, toh doosri ka spouse ke taur par koi claim nahi banta.

Iski jagah Centre ne 16 April 2024 ko jo banaya, woh thi Cabinet Secretary ki chairmanship mein chhe members ki ek committee, jise queer logon ke saath discrimination, violence aur zabardasti medical treatment ke khilaaf upaay suggest karne hain [[gazette-queer-committee-order-2024]]. Uske terms of reference mein couples ki legal recognition ka zikr tak nahi hai. Humein uski koi published report nahi mili.

## Discrimination: law kahan bachata hai aur kahan chup hai

Kanoon ki kitaabon mein dhoondho ki sexual orientation kahan ek protected ground hai, toh sabse saaf jawaab ek health law mein milta hai. Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 ka Section 21 mental health care mein kisi bhi basis par discrimination rokta hai, aur gender, sex aur sexual orientation ka naam leta hai [[indiacode-mhca-2017]]. Yeh us queer insaan ko protect karta hai jise mental health care chahiye. Yeh us landlord tak nahi pahunchta jo ek gay couple ko ghar dene se mana kar de, ya us employer tak jo ek lesbian manager ko naukri se nikaal de.

Tathakathit "cure" se protection ek court aur ek regulator se aayi hai, Parliament se nahi. June 2021 mein Madras High Court ne direction di ki kisi insaan ki sexual orientation ya gender identity ko medically "cure" karne ya badalne ki har koshish prohibit ho, aur aisa karne wale professional par action ho, jo licence withdraw karne tak ja sakta hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]]. August 2022 mein National Medical Commission ne conversion therapy ko doctors ke liye professional misconduct bana diya [[scroll-nmc-conversion-therapy-2022]].

Aur jo ek law gender minorities ke liye likha gaya tha, woh ab logon ko bahar karta hai. 2026 ke amendment ke baad transgender Act kehta hai ki uski definition mein "persons with different sexual orientations and self-perceived sexual identities" shaamil nahi hain [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]].

## Sexual violence aur 2024 ka gap

Navtej ne Section 377 ko ek kaam ke liye zinda rakha tha: bina consent wale acts. Isliye jis gay man ya transgender insaan par koi man assault karta, uske liye protection wahi section tha jo kabhi unke relationships ko crime banata tha. 1 July 2024 ko jab Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ne IPC ki jagah li, toh Section 377 hata diya gaya aur uski jagah kuch nahi aaya [[scroll-delhi-hc-unnatural-offences-bns-2024]]. Naya rape law, Section 63, sirf us case ko cover karta hai jisme ek man ek woman par assault kare [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Police ne 2023 mein Section 377 ke under 888 cases register kiye. 2024 ke data mein yeh row hi gayab hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Transgender insaan ke sexual abuse ki saza chhe mahine se do saal ki jail hai, aur 2026 ke amendment ne is range ko chhua tak nahi [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. Hamara myth-buster, jo batata hai ki "gender-neutral" kaha gaya naya code kaise is baat par raazi ho gaya ki men ka rape ho hi nahi sakta, is gap ko detail mein dekhta hai.

## Kya pending hai: courts, committees aur 2026 ka amendment

2026 mein Parliament ne gender identity par kaam zaroor kiya, lekin rights badhane ki jagah ghata diye. Transgender amendment 13 March 2026 ko Lok Sabha mein introduce hua aur 25 March tak dono houses se pass ho gaya [[prs-transgender-amendment-bill-2026]]. 25 May 2026 se lagu yeh law self-perceived gender identity ka right hata deta hai, aur District Magistrate transgender certificate tabhi de sakta hai jab medical board uski recommendation kare [[gazette-transgender-amendment-act-2026]]. 17 August 2026 ko Union ne Chief Justice Surya Kant ki bench ko bataya ki pehle se issue ho chuke identity cards challenge ki sunwai ke dauraan chalte rahenge [[scobserver-transgender-amendment-hearing-2026]].

Missing sexual offence par, Delhi High Court ne March 2026 mein ek public interest case dobara zinda kiya, yeh kehte hue ki sarkar ka decision "nowhere in sight" hai [[theprint-pti-delhi-hc-restores-pil-2026]]. Shaadi par Supreme Court do baar bol chuka hai, aur dono baar usne Parliament ki taraf ishaara kiya.

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Courts ne ek crime hataya aur kuch chhote darwaaze khole. Parliament ne queer couples ke liye aaj tak koi law nahi banaya, aur 2026 mein usne transgender logon se apna gender khud batane ka legal right bhi le liya.

young-men-calling-out-sexism-friends.en:
Imagine a college WhatsApp group of 15 boys. One posts a rape joke about a classmate. Three reply with laughing emojis. Eleven say nothing. The one who posted reads the silence as applause, and so do the eleven, each assuming he is the only one who winced. That is how the loudest voice becomes "what the boys think". National data suggest he does not speak for most men. This guide is about saying so.

## You are not alone: what most men actually think

NFHS-5 asked men what a husband may do if his wife refuses sex: get angry and reprimand her, refuse her money, use force, or have sex with another woman. Of the men surveyed, 72% rejected all four, while 12.2%, about one in eight, said he has the right to use force [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In a 2014 ICRW-UNFPA survey of 9,205 men in seven states, 32% were classed as holding "rigid" ideas of masculinity, 45% as moderate and 23% as gender-equitable [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

So the man with the joke is in a minority. But be honest about the majority, because it is softer than it sounds. The 72% was 77% in NFHS-4, and in Punjab it was 21% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In the same survey, 44% of men said a husband is justified in beating his wife in at least one of seven situations [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In the ICRW study, 60% of men said they had acted violently against a wife or partner at some point, a count that includes emotional and economic violence [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Most men reject forced sex. Many of the same men excuse other kinds of control. The large middle is where a group chat matters, because undecided men take their cue from whoever speaks.

## Where entitlement is rehearsed: jokes, ratings, forwards

Nobody starts with coercion. The attitude is practised first, in places where it costs nothing. A rape joke tests what the group will let pass. Rating classmates out of ten teaches everyone present that women are there to be scored. A forwarded private photo turns one person's trust into the group's entertainment.

Each time nobody objects, the line moves a little. The man who posted learns he is safe. The women who later hear about the group learn which of their male friends stayed quiet. And some of the silent men have been harassed or abused themselves. The joke tells them, too, what would happen if they ever spoke.

## When 'just forwarding' becomes a crime

This is general information, not legal advice. A joke in a boys' group will rarely reach a police station. An image can.

Section 66E of the IT Act punishes capturing, publishing or transmitting an image of a person's private area without consent with up to 3 years in prison, a fine of up to Rs 2 lakh, or both [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Forwarding is transmitting. Under Section 77 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), sharing a private image of a woman without her consent is voyeurism even if she agreed to the image being taken, with 1 to 3 years in prison on a first conviction [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

If the person shown is under 18, it is child sexual abuse material. Section 67B covers creating, browsing or downloading it, not only sending it [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Each forward is itself a transmission; "it was already in the group" does not undo what the forward does.

Do not expect the law to do your interrupting for you. Police registered 436 cases under Section 66E in all of India in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The friend who says "delete that" is often the only enforcement there is.

## Five ways to interrupt, from a joke to a direct no

Pick the one you can actually do. A small interruption that happens beats a speech you never give.

1. **Starve it.** No emoji, no "lol", no reply. A joke without an audience dies quickly.
2. **Tease the joke, not the woman.** "Bhai, yeh joke tere dada ke zamaane ka hai." Humour lets you object without turning the chat into a trial.
3. **Ask him to explain.** "I don't get it. What's the funny part?" Having to explain a rape joke in plain words usually ends it.
4. **Say no in one line.** "Not cool. Delete it." No lecture needed.
5. **Take it private and find one ally.** Message him directly: "That one went too far." Message another friend: "Was it just me?" It is rarely just you, and two voices change a group faster than one.

It may cost you a day of being called a simp, or a feminist as if that were an insult. That is usually the whole price. If the group cannot hold together without these jokes, leaving it, and saying why, is also an answer.

## When a friend's behaviour crosses a line

Some things are not banter. A friend who boasts that he did not stop when she said no, who threatens to leak an ex's photos, or who posts an intimate image is describing or committing a possible crime.

Do not forward or save the image. Note who posted it, where and when, because the person shown may need that to report. Tell him, in private, that it is not okay and that he must take it down. The person shown can report it at cybercrime.gov.in or on 1930 [[cybercrime-portal]], and since 20 February 2026 platforms must remove nude, sexual or morphed images within two hours of that person's complaint [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

If you know the person who was harmed, believe them, ask what they want, and let them decide the next step. Emergency 112 and the Women Helpline are there if they want them. If that person is under 18, it is not left to anyone's discretion: POCSO makes reporting child sexual abuse mandatory for anyone who knows of it [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], and the Child Helpline is 1098.

Loyalty to a friend has never meant helping him hurt someone. The loyal thing is to stop him early, while what you are stopping is still a joke.
young-men-calling-out-sexism-friends.hg:
Sochiye, college ka ek WhatsApp group jisme 15 ladke hain. Ek ladka kisi classmate par rape joke post karta hai. Teen log laughing emoji bhejte hain. Gyarah kuch nahi kehte. Jisne post kiya, woh is chuppi ko taaliyan samajhta hai, aur woh gyarah bhi yahi samajhte hain, kyunki har ek ko lagta hai ki bura sirf use laga. Isi tarah sabse loud awaaz "ladke yahi sochte hain" ban jaati hai. National data bataata hai ki woh zyada tar men ki taraf se nahi bolta. Yeh guide yahi baat kehne ke baare mein hai.

## Aap akele nahi hain: zyada tar men asal mein kya sochte hain

NFHS-5 ne men se poochha ki agar wife sex se mana kare toh husband kya kar sakta hai: gussa hokar daantna, paise dena band karna, zabardasti karna, ya kisi aur aurat ke saath sex karna. Survey kiye gaye men mein se 72% ne chaaron reject kiye, jabki 12.2%, yaani kareeb har aath mein se ek, ne kaha ki husband ko zabardasti karne ka haq hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. 2014 ke ICRW-UNFPA survey mein, jo saat states ke 9,205 men par hua, 32% ko masculinity ke "rigid" ideas wala, 45% ko moderate aur 23% ko gender-equitable maana gaya [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Yaani joke wala aadmi minority mein hai. Lekin majority ke baare mein bhi imaandaar rahiye, kyunki woh utni mazboot nahi jitni sunne mein lagti hai. Yeh 72% NFHS-4 mein 77% tha, aur Punjab mein 21% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Usi survey mein 44% men ne kaha ki saat mein se kam se kam ek situation mein husband ka wife ko maarna justified hai [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. ICRW study mein 60% men ne kaha ki unhone kabhi na kabhi apni wife ya partner ke saath violent behaviour kiya hai, aur is ginti mein emotional aur economic violence bhi shaamil hai [[icrw-unfpa-masculinity-ipv-son-preference-2014]].

Zyada tar men forced sex ko reject karte hain. Unhi mein se kai doosri tarah ke control ko sahi thehra dete hain. Group chat ka asar isi bade beech wale hisse par padta hai, kyunki jo men abhi tay nahi kar paaye, woh usi se cue lete hain jo bolta hai.

## Entitlement ki rehearsal kahan hoti hai: jokes, ratings, forwards

Koi bhi coercion se shuru nahi karta. Yeh attitude pehle wahan practise hota hai jahan iski koi keemat nahi lagti. Rape joke yeh test karta hai ki group kya chalne dega. Classmates ko das mein se rate karna wahan maujood har kisi ko sikhata hai ki women score dene ki cheez hain. Forward ki gayi private photo ek insaan ke bharose ko group ka entertainment bana deti hai.

Har baar jab koi nahi tokta, line thodi aur khisak jaati hai. Jisne post kiya, woh seekhta hai ki woh safe hai. Jin women ko baad mein is group ka pata chalta hai, woh seekhti hain ki unke kaun se male friends chup rahe. Aur chup rehne wale kuch men khud harassment ya abuse jhel chuke hain. Joke unhe bhi bata deta hai ki agar woh kabhi bole toh kya hoga.

## 'Bas forward kiya tha' kab crime ban jaata hai

Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi. Ladkon ke group ka joke shayad hi kabhi police station pahunchega. Image pahunch sakti hai.

IT Act ka Section 66E kisi insaan ke private area ki image bina consent capture, publish ya transmit karne par 3 years tak ki jail, Rs 2 lakh tak ka fine, ya dono ki saza deta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Forward karna transmit karna hi hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 77 ke tahat, kisi woman ki private image uski consent ke bina share karna voyeurism hai, chahe image khinchne ke liye usne haan kahi ho, aur pehli conviction par 1 se 3 years ki jail hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

Agar image mein dikhne wala insaan 18 se kam ka hai, toh yeh child sexual abuse material hai. Section 67B sirf bhejne ko nahi, ise banane, browse karne ya download karne ko bhi cover karta hai [[indiacode-it-act-2000]]. Har forward apne aap mein ek transmission hai; "yeh toh pehle se group mein tha" kehne se forward ka asar khatam nahi hota.

Yeh ummeed mat rakhiye ki tokne ka kaam law aapke liye kar dega. 2024 mein poore India mein police ne Section 66E ke tahat 436 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aksar "delete kar" kehne wala dost hi akela enforcement hota hai.

## Tokne ke paanch tareeke, joke se lekar seedhe 'no' tak

Woh tareeka chuniye jo aap sach mein kar sakte hain. Jo chhota sa interruption ho jaaye, woh us speech se behtar hai jo aap kabhi dete hi nahi.

1. **Use bhookha rakhiye.** Na emoji, na "lol", na reply. Bina audience ka joke jaldi mar jaata hai.
2. **Joke ka mazaak udaiye, ladki ka nahi.** "Bhai, yeh joke tere dada ke zamaane ka hai." Humour ke saath aap chat ko adalat banaye bina tok sakte hain.
3. **Use explain karne ko kahiye.** "Samajh nahi aaya. Isme funny kya hai?" Rape joke ko seedhe shabdon mein samjhana pade, toh woh aksar wahin khatam ho jaata hai.
4. **Ek line mein mana kijiye.** "Not cool. Delete it." Lecture ki zaroorat nahi.
5. **Private mein baat kijiye aur ek ally dhundhiye.** Use seedha message kijiye: "Yeh wala zyada ho gaya." Kisi aur dost ko message kijiye: "Kya sirf mujhe bura laga?" Aisa shayad hi hota hai ki bura sirf aapko laga ho, aur do awaazein group ko ek ke mukable jaldi badalti hain.

Ho sakta hai aapko ek din "simp" sunna pade, ya "feminist", jaise woh koi gaali ho. Aam taur par poori keemat itni hi hoti hai. Agar group in jokes ke bina tik nahi sakta, toh use chhod dena, aur wajah bata dena, yeh bhi ek jawaab hai.

## Jab dost ka behaviour line cross kar de

Kuch cheezein banter nahi hoti. Jo dost shekhi maare ki ladki ke mana karne par bhi woh nahi ruka, jo apni ex ki photos leak karne ki dhamki de, ya jo koi intimate image post kare, woh ek possible crime bata raha hai ya kar raha hai.

Image ko na forward kijiye, na save. Yeh note kar lijiye ki kisne, kahan aur kab post ki, kyunki jis insaan ki image hai use report karne ke liye iski zaroorat pad sakti hai. Dost ko private mein kahiye ki yeh theek nahi hai aur use ise hatana hoga. Jis insaan ki image hai, woh cybercrime.gov.in par ya 1930 par report kar sakta hai [[cybercrime-portal]], aur 20 February 2026 se platforms ko us insaan ki complaint ke do ghante ke andar nude, sexual ya morphed images hatani hoti hain [[meity-it-amendment-rules-2026]].

Agar aap us insaan ko jaante hain jise nuksaan hua, toh uski baat par yakeen kijiye, poochhiye ki woh kya chahta ya chahti hai, aur agla step use hi tay karne dijiye. Agar woh chahe, toh Emergency 112 aur Women Helpline maujood hain. Agar woh insaan 18 se kam ka hai, toh yeh kisi ki marzi par nahi chhoda gaya: POCSO ke tahat child sexual abuse ke baare mein jaanne wale har insaan ke liye report karna mandatory hai [[indiacode-pocso-2012]], aur Child Helpline 1098 hai.

Dost ke saath loyalty ka matlab kabhi yeh nahi tha ki kisi ko chot pahunchane mein uski madad ki jaaye. Loyal kaam yeh hai ki use jaldi roka jaaye, jab tak rokne wali cheez sirf ek joke hai.
